text:
Azab ka shoq jald pura ho ga. Allah Ta'ala Qiyamat ki nazdiki ki khabar de raha hai aur goya ke woh qaim ho chuki. Is liye mazi ke lafz se bayan farmata hai jaise farman hai: Logon ka hisab qareeb aachuka phir bhi woh ghaflat ke sath munh mode hue hain. Aur ayat mein hai: Qiyamat aachuki, chand phat gaya. Phir farmaya is qareeb wali cheez ke aur qareeb hone ki tamannaein na karo. Ha (h) ki zameer ka marja ya to lafz Allah hai yani Allah se jaldi na chaho ya azab hain yani azabon ki jaldi na machao. Dono ma'ani ek dusre ke lazim malzum hain. Jaise aur ayat mein hai: Yeh log azab ki jaldi macha rahe hain magar hamari taraf se is ka waqt muqarrar na hota to beshak in par azab aajate lekin azab in par aayega zaroor aur woh bhi nagahan in ki ghaflat mein. Yeh azabon ki jaldi karte hain aur Jahannam in sab kafiron ko ghere hue hai. 

Zahhak ؒ ne is ayat ka ek ajeeb matlab bayan kiya hai yani woh kehte hain ke murad hai ke Allah faraiz aur hudood nazil ho chuke. Imam Ibn Jareer ne isay khoob radd kiya hai aur farmaya hai ek shakhs bhi to hamare ilm mein aisa nahi jis ne shari'at ke wajood se pehle ise mangne mein ujlat ki ho. Murad is se azabon ki jaldi hai jo kafiron ki aadat thi kyunki woh inhen mante hi na the. Jaise Quran-e-Pak ne farmaya hai ayat: (Yasta'jilu bihal-lazina la yu'minuna biha) (Surah Ash-Shura: 18). Be-eeman to is ki jaldi macha rahe hain aur eeman-dar un se larzan-o-tarsan hain kyunki woh inhen bar-haq mante hain. Baat yeh hai ke Azab-e-Ilahi mein shaq karne wale door ki gumrahi mein ja padte hain. 

Ibn Abi Hatim mein Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain: Qiyamat ke qareeb maghrib ki janib se dhal ki tarah ka siyah abr namoodaar hoga aur woh bohat jald aasman par chadhega phir is mein se ek manadi karega, log taajjub se ek dusre se kahenge: Miyan kuch suna bhi? Baaz haan kahenge aur baaz baat ko uda denge. Woh phir dobara nida karega aur kahega: Ae logon! Ab to sab kahenge ke haan sahib aawaz to aayi. Phir woh teesri dafa manadi karega aur kahega: Ae logon! Amr-e-Ilahi aa-pohuncha, ab jaldi na karo. Allah ki qasam do shakhs jo kisi kapde ko phailaye hue honge sametne bhi na payenge ke Qiyamat qaim ho jayegi. Koi apne hoz ko theek kar raha hoga abhi pani bhi pila na payega ke Qiyamat aa jayegi. Doodh dohne wale pee bhi na sakenge ke Qiyamat aajayegi, har ek nafsi nafsi mein lag jayega. 

Phir Allah Ta'ala apne nafs-e-kareem se shirk aur ibadat-e-ghair ki pakeezgi bayan farmata hai. Fi-l-waqia woh in tamam baaton se paak, bohat door aur bohat buland hai. Yehi mushrik hain jo munkir-e-Qiyamat bhi hain. Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala in ke shirk se paak hai.

Wahi kya hai? Ruh se murad yahan wahi hai jaise ayat (Wa kazalika awhainaka ruhan min amrina ma kunta tadri ma al-kitabu wa la al-imana wa lakin ja'alnahu nuran nahdi bihi man nasha'u min 'ibadina wa innaka la-tahdi ila siratin mustaqim) (42. Ash-Shura: 52) Hum ne isi tarah teri taraf apne hukm se wahi nazil farmai halanki tujhe to yeh bhi pata na tha kya thi kitab aur kya tha iman? Haan hum ne ise nur bana kar jise chaha apne bando mein se rasta dikha diya.

Yahan farman hai ke hum jin bando ko chahein paighambari ata farmate hain humein hi is ka pura ilm hai ke is ke laiq kaun? Hum hi farishto mein se bhi is aala mansab ke farishte chhant lete hain aur insano mein se bhi. Allah apni wahi apne hukm se apne bando mein se jis par chahta hai utarta hai taaki mulaqat ke din se hoshyar kardein jis din sab ke sab Allah ke samne honge koi cheez is se makhfi na hogi. Us din mulk kis ka hoga? Sirf Allah Wahid-ul-Qahhar ka.

Yeh is liye ke woh logo mein Wahdaniyat-e-Rabb ka elan kardein aur parsai se door mushriko ko darayein aur logo ko samjhayein ke woh mujh se darte raha karein.

Aalam-e-Ulwi aur Sifli ka Khaliq Allah Karim hi hai. Buland aasmaan aur pheli hui zameen ma'tamam makhlooq ke usi ki paida ki hui hai aur yeh sab batour-e-haq hai na batour-e-abas. Nekon ko jaza aur badon ko saza hogi. Woh tamam doosre maboodon aur mushrikin se bari aur bezaar hai. Wahid hai, la shareek hai, akela hi Khaliq-e-Kul hai. Isi liye akela hi saza-war-e-ibadat hai. Insaan haqeer-o-zaleel lekin Khaliq ka intehai na-farman hai. Us ne insaan ka silsila nutfe se jari rakha hai jo aik pani hai. Haqeer-o-zaleel yeh jab theek thaak bana diya jata hai toh akad-fon mein aa jata hai, Rabb se jhagadne lagta hai, rasoolon ki mukhalifat par tul jata hai. Banda tha, chahiye toh yeh tha ke bandagi mein laga rehta lekin yeh toh zindagi karne laga. Aur ayat mein hai, Allah ne insaan ko pani se banaya, is ka nasb aur susraal qaim kiya. Allah Qadir hai, Rabb ke siva yeh un ki pooja karne lage hain jo be-nafa aur be-z zarar hain. Kafir kuch Allah se poshida nahi. Surah Yaseen mein farmaya, kya insaan nahi dekhta ke hum ne use nutfe se paida kiya phir woh toh bada hi jhagralu nikla. Hum par bhi baten banane laga aur apni paidaish bhool gaya, kehne laga ke in gali sari haddiyon ko koun zinda karega? Ae Nabi ﷺ tum un se keh do ke unhein woh Khaliq-e-Akbar paida karega jis ne unhein pehli baar paida kiya, woh toh har tarah ki makhlooq ki paidaish ka poora aalim hai. Musnad Ahmad aur Ibn Majah mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne apni hatheli par thook kar farmaya ke Janab-e-Bari farmata hai ke ae insaan tu mujhe kya aajiz kar sakta hai, main ne toh tujhe is thook jaisi cheez se paida kiya hai, jab tu zindagi pa gaya, tano-mand ho gaya, libas-o-makan mil gaya, toh laga sametne aur meri rah se rokne? Aur jab dam gale mein atka toh tu kehne laga ke ab main sadqa karta hoon, Allah ki rah mein deta hoon. Bas ab sadqa-o-khairaat ka waqt nikal gaya.

Chupaye aur Insaan:

Jo chupaye Allah Ta'ala ne paida kiye hain aur insaan un se mukhtalif fayede utha raha hai, is naemat ko Rabb-ul-Alameen farma raha hai jaise oont, gaye, bakri. Jiska mufassil bayaan Surah An-Aam ki aayat mein aath qismoon se kiya hai. Inke baal, oon, soof waghera ka garam libaas aur jadaawal banti hai, doodh peete hain, gosht khatay hain. Shaam ko jab woh char-chug kar wapas aatay hain, bhari hui kokhon walay, bhare huay thanon walay, oonchi kohanon walay, kitne bhalay maaloom hotay hain aur jab chiragah ki taraf jaate hain kaise pyare maaloom hotay hain, phir tumhare bhaari bhaari bojh aik shehar se doosre shehar tak apni kamar par laad kar le jaate hain ke tumhara wahan pahunchna baghair aadhee jaan kiye mushkil tha. Hajj-o-Umrah ke, jihad ke, tijarat ke aur aise hi aur safar unhi par hotay hain, tumhe le jaate hain, tumhare bojh dhotay hain. Jaise aayat (Wa inna lakum fil-an'ami la 'ibratan nusqikum mimma fi butunihi min baini farthin wa damin labanan khalisans sa'ighan lish-sharibin) (16 An-Nahl: 66) mein hai ke yeh chupaye janwar bhi tumhare ibrat ka baais hain, inke pait se hum tumhe doodh pilate hain aur in se bohat se fayede pohanchatay hain, inka gosht bhi tum khatay ho, in par sawariyan bhi kartay ho. Samandar ki sawari ke liye kashtiyan hum ne bana di hain. Aur aayat mein hai: (Allahul-lazi ja'ala lakumul-an'ama litarkabu minha wa minha ta'kulun) (40 Ghafir: 79) Allah Ta'ala ne tumhare liye chupaye paida kiye hain ke tum in par sawari karo, inhein khao, nafa uthao, dili haajatein poori karo aur tumhe kashtiyon par bhi sawar karaya aur bohat si nishaniyan dikhayin, pas tum hamare kis kis nishaan ka inkaar karoge?

Yahan bhi apni yeh naematein jata kar farmaya ke tumhara woh Rab jisne isko tumhara mutee' bana diya hai, woh tum par bohat hi shafqat-o-rahmat wala hai. Jaise Surah Yasin mein farmaya: Kya woh nahi dekhte ke hum ne un ke liye apne hathon chupaye banaye aur unhein unka maalik bana diya aur unhein unka mutee' bana diya ke baaz ko khayein, baaz par sawar hon. Aur aayat mein: (Wallazi khalaqal-azwaja kullaha wa ja'ala lakum minal-fulki wal-an'ama ma tarkabun) (43 Az-Zukhruf: 12) Us Allah ne tumhare liye kashtiyan bana di aur chupaye paida kar diye ke tum in par sawar ho kar apne Rab ka fazl-o-shukr karo aur kaho woh paak hai jisne inhein hamara matahet kar diya halanki hum mein yeh taaqat na thi, hum mantey hain ke hum usi ki jaanib lautenge.

Duf ke maani kapra aur manafa se murad khana-peena, nasal hasil karna, sawari karna, gosht khana, doodh peena hai.

Sawari ke Janwaron ki Hurmat  Apni aik aur naamat bayaan farma raha hai ke zeenat ke liye aur sawari ke liye usne ghoray, khachar aur gadhey paida kiye hain, bara maqsad in janwaron ki paidaish se insan ka hi faida hai. Inhein aur chopayon par fazilat di aur alag zikr kiya, is wajah se baaz ulama ne ghore ke gosht ki hurmat ki daleel is ayat se li hai. Jaise Imam Abu Hanifa aur unki muwafiqat karne wale fuqaha kehte hain ke khachar aur gadhe ke sath ghore ka zikr hai aur pehle ke dono janwar haram hain isliye yeh bhi haram hua. Chunacha khachar aur gadhe ki hurmat ahadees mein aayi hai aur aksar ulama ka mazhab bhi hai. Ibn Abbas R.A se in teeno ki hurmat aayi hai. Woh farmate hain ke is ayat se pehle ki ayat mein chopayon ka zikr kar ke Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya hai ke inhein toh khate ho bas yeh hue khane ke janwar aur in teeno ka bayaan kar ke farmaya ke in par tum sawari karte ho bas yeh hue sawari ke janwar. Musnad ki hadith mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne ghoron ke, khachron ke aur gadhon ke gosht ko mana farmaya hai lekin uske rawiyon mein aik rawi Salih bin Yahya bin Miqdam hain jin mein kalam hai. Musnad ki aur hadith mein Miqdam bin Ma'di Karib se manqool hai ke hum Hazrat Khalid bin Waleed R.A ke sath Sayiqa ki jang mein thay, mere paas mere sathi gosht laye, mujh se aik patthar manga main ne diya. Unhone farmaya hum Rasool Allah ﷺ ke sath Ghazwa-e-Khaibar mein thay, logon ne yahudiyon ke kheton par jaldi kardi, Huzoor ﷺ ne mujhe hukum diya ke logon mein neda kar dun ke namaz ke liye aajayein aur musalmanon ke siwa koi na aaye, phir farmaya ke aye logo tum ne yahudiyon ke baghat mein ghusne ki jaldi ki, suno muahda ka maal baghair haq ke halal nahi aur paltu gadhon ke aur ghoron ke aur khachron ke gosht aur har aik kachliyon wala darinda aur har aik panje se shikaar khelne wala parinda haram hai. Huzoor ﷺ ki mamanat yahud ke baghat se shayad us waqt thi jab unse muahda ho gaya tha. Pas agar yeh hadith sahih hoti toh beshak ghore ki hurmat ke bare mein toh nas thi lekin is mein Bukhari aur Muslim ki hadith ke muqable ki quwat nahi jis mein Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A se manqool hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne paltu gadhon ke gosht ko mana farma diya aur ghoron ke gosht ki ijazat di. Aur hadith mein hai ke hum ne Khaibar wale din ghora aur khachar aur gadha zabah kiye toh hamein Huzoor ﷺ ne khachar aur gadhe ke gosht se toh mana kar diya lekin ghore ke gosht se nahi roka. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein Hazrat Asma bint Abi Bakr R.A se marwi hai ke hum ne Madine mein Huzoor ﷺ ki mojoodgi mein ghora zabah kiya aur uska gosht khaya. Pas yeh sab se bari, sab se qawi aur sab se zyada saboot wali hadith hai aur yahi mazhab jamhor ulama ka hai. Malik, Shafi'i, Ahmad aur unke sab sathi aur aksar salaf-o-khalaf yahi kehte hain. Wallahu A'lam. Ibn Abbas R.A ka bayaan hai ke pehle ghoron mein wehshat aur jangli pan tha Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Ismail A.S ke liye ise mutee kar diya.

Wahab ne Israili riwayaton mein bayan kiya hai ke janubi hawa se ghore paida hote hain. Wallahu A'lam. In teenon janwaroon par sawari lene ka jawaz toh Quran ke lafzon se sabit hai, Huzoor ﷺ ko ek khachar hadiye mein diya gaya tha jis par aap sawari karte the, haan yeh aap ne mana farmaya hai ke ghoron ko gadhiyon se milaya jaye. Yeh mamanat is liye hai ke nasl munqata na ho jaye. Hazrat Dihya Kalbi R.A ne Huzoor ﷺ se daryaft kiya ke agar aap ijazat dein toh hum ghore aur gadhi ke milap se khachar lein aur aap is par sawar hoon, aap ne farmaya yeh kaam woh karte hain jo ilm se kore hain.

Taqwa behtareen zad-e-rah hai. Duniyawi rahein tay karne ke asbab bayan farma kar ab deeni rah chalne ke asbab bayan farmata hai. Mahsoosat se ma'nawiyat ki taraf rujoo karta hai. Quran mein aksar bayanate is qism ke mojood hain. Safar-e-Hajj ke toshe ka zikr kar ke taqwe ke toshe ka jo aakhirat mein kaam de bayan hua hai. Zahari libas ka zikr farma kar libas-e-taqwa ki achhai bayan ki hai. Isi tarah yahan haiwanat se duniya ke kathhan raaste aur daraz safar tay hone ka bayan farma kar aakhirat ke raaste deeni rahein bayan farmayen ke sacha raasta Allah se milane wala hai. Rab ki seedhi rah wahi hai usi par chalo, doosre raaste par na chalo warna behak jaoge aur seedhi rah se alag ho jaoge. 

Farmaya meri taraf pahunchne ki seedhi rah yahi hai jo main ne batai hai. Tareeq jo Allah se milane wala hai Allah ne zahir kar diya hai aur woh deen-e-Islam hai jise Allah ne wazeh kar diya hai aur sath hi doosre raaston ki gumrahi bhi bayan farma di hai. Pas sacha raasta ek hi hai jo Kitabullah aur Sunnat-e-Rasoolullah ﷺ se sabit hai. Baaqi aur rahein ghalat rahein hain, haq se alag-thalag hain, logon ki apni ijad hain jaise yahoodiyat, nasraniyat, majoosiyat waghera. 

Phir farmata hai ke hidayat Rab ke qabze ki cheez hai, agar chahe to roo-e-zameen ke logon ko naik rah par laga de, zameen ke tamam bashindey momin ban jayen, sab log ek hi deen ke amil ho jayen lekin yeh ikhtilaf baaqi hi rahega magar jis par Allah raham farmaye. Isi ke liye unhein paida kiya hai. Tere Rab ki baat poori ho kar hi rahegi ke Jannat-o-Dozakh insan se bhar jaye.

Tumhare faidon ke saaman chaupaye aur doosray janwaron ki paidaish ka ehsaan bayan farma kar mazeed ehsaano ka zikr farmata hai ke oopar se pani wohi barsata hai jis se tum faida uthate ho aur tumhare faide ke janwar bhi is se faida uthate hain. Meetha saaf shafaf khushgwaar achhe zaiqe ka pani tumhare peene ke kaam aata hai, is ka ehsaan na ho toh woh khaari aur kadwa bana de. Isi aab-e-baran se darakht ugtay hain aur woh darakht tumhare janwaron ka chara bante hain. "Saum" ke maana charne ke hain, isi wajah se ahl-e-saimah charne walon oonton ko kehte hain. Ibn-e-Majah ki Hadees mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne sooraj nikalne se pehle charane ko mana farmaya. Phir is ki qudrat dekho ke aik hi pani se mukhtalif mazay ke, mukhtalif shakal-o-soorat ke, mukhtalif khushboo ke tarah tarah ke phal phool woh tumhare liye paida karta hai, pas yeh sab nishaniyan aik shakhs ko Allah ki wahdaniyat janne ke liye kafi hain. Isi ka bayan aur ayaton mein is tarah hua hai ke aasman-o-zameen ka khaliq, badalon se pani barsane wala, un se haray bhare baaghat paida karne wala, jin ke paida karne se tum aajiz thay Allah hi hai, is ke sath aur koi mabood nahi phir bhi log haq se idhar udhar ho rahe hain.

Suraj chand ki gardish mein poshida fawaid: Allah Ta'ala apni aur naqmeatein yaad dilata hai ke din raat barabar tumhare faide ke liye aate jaate hain. Suraj chand gardish mein hain, sitare chamak chamak kar tumhein roshni pohncha rahe hain, har ek aisa sahi andaza Allah ne muqarrar kar rakha hai jis se woh na idhar udhar hon na tumhein koi nuqsan ho. Har ek Rab ki qudrat mein aur us ke ghalbe tale hai. Us ne chhe din mein asman zameen paida kiya phir arsh par mustawi huwa din raat barabar pe dar pe aate rehte hain suraj chand sitare us ke hukm se kaam mein lage hue hain khalq o amr ka malik wahi hai woh Rab-ul-Aalameen badi barkaton wala hai. Jo soch samajh rakhta ho us ke liye to is mein Allah ki qudrat o saltanat ki badi nishaniyan hain. In asmani cheezon ke baad ab tum zamini cheezein dekho ke haiwan, kan, nabatat, jamadat, waghaira mukhtalif rang roop ki cheezein beshumar fawaid ki cheezein usi ne tumhare liye zameen par paida kar rakhi hain. Jo log Allah ki naqmeton ko sochein aur qadr karein un ke liye to yeh zabardast nishani hai.

Allah Ta'ala apni aur meharbani jatata hai ke samandar par darya par bhi isne tumhein qabiz kar diya bawajood apni gehrai ke aur apni maujon ke woh tumhara tabe hai, tumhari kashtiyan ismein chalti hain. Isi tarah ismein se machhliyan nikal kar aur lulu aur jawahar isne tumhare liye ismein paida kiye hain jinhein tum saholat se nikal lete ho aur bataur zewar ke apne kaam mein lete ho phir is kashtiyan hawaon ko hatati pani ko cheerati apne seene ke bal tirti chali jati hain. Sab se pehle Hazrat Nuh (Alaihis Salam) kashti mein sawar hue unhi ko kashti banana Allah Alam ne sikhaya phir log barabar banate chale aaye aur unhein par darya ke lambe lambe safar taye hone lage is paar ki cheezein us paar aur us paar ki is paar aane jane lagin. Isi ka bayan is mein hai ke tum Allah ka fazal yaani apni rozi tijarat ke zariye dhoondo aur uski naemat aur ehsaan ka shukar mano aur qadr dani karo. 

Musnad Bazzar mein Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) se marwi hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne maghribi darya se kaha ke main apne bandon ko tujh mein sawar karne wala hoon tu unke sath kya karega? Usne kaha dubo doonga farmaya teri tezi tere kinaron par hai aur unhein mein apne hath par unhein uthaunga aur jis tarah maa apne bachche ki khabar geeri karti hai main inki karta rahunga pas ise Allah Ta'ala ne zewar bhi diye aur shikaar bhi. Is hadith ka rawi sirf Abdur Rahman bin Abdullah hai aur woh Munkar-ul-Hadith hai. Abdullah bin Abi Amro se bhi yeh riwayat marfu'an marwi hai. 

Iske baad zameen ka zikr ho raha hai ke iske thehrane aur hilne jhulne se bachane ke liye is par mazboot aur wazni pahad jama diye ke iske hilne ki wajah se is par rehne walon ki zindagi dushwaar na hojaye. Jaise farman hai ayat (Wal-jibala arsawha 79. An-Nazi'at: 32). Hazrat Hasan (Rahimahullah) ka qaul hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala ne zameen banayi toh woh hil rahi thi yahan tak ke farishton ne kaha is par toh koi thehra hi nahi sakta. Subah dekhte hain ke pahad is par gaad diye gaye hain aur iska hilna mauqoof hogaya pas farishton ko yeh bhi na maloom hosaka ke pahad kis cheez se paida kiye gaye hain. Qais bin Ubadah se bhi yehi marwi hai. 

Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain ke zameen ne kaha tu mujh par Bani Adam ko basata hai jo meri peeth par gunah karenge aur khabasat phailayenge woh kaanpne lagi pas Allah Ta'ala ne pahad ko is par jama diya jinhein tum dekh rahe ho aur baaz ko dekhte hi nahi ho. Yeh bhi iska karam hai ke isne nahrein chashme aur darya charon taraf baha diye. Koi tez hai koi sust, koi lamba hai koi mukhtasar, kabhi kam pani hai kabhi zyada, kabhi bilkul sookha pada hai. Pahadon par, jangalon mein, reet mein, patharon mein barabar yeh chashme bahte rehte hain aur rail peel kardehte hain yeh sab iska fazal-o-karam, lutf-o-rahm hai. Na iske siwa koi parwardigar na iske siwa koi laaiq-e-ibadat, wohi Rab hai, wohi Ma'bood hai.

Usi ne raaste bana diye hain khushki mein, tari mein, pahaad mein, basti mein, ujaad mein har jagah us ke fazl-o-karam se raaste maujood hain ke udhar se udhar log ja asakein koi tang raasta hai koi wasee koi aasan koi sakht. Aur bhi alamatein us ne muqarrar kardin jaise pahaad hain teele hain waghera waghera. Jin se tari khushki ke rahro-o-musafir raah maloom kar lete hain. Aur bhatke hue seedhe raste lag jaate hain. Sitaray bhi rehnumayi ke liye hain raat ke andhere mein unhi se raasta aur samt maloom hoti hai Malik se marwi hai ke nujoom se muraad pahaad hain. Phir apni azmat-o-kibriyai ka bayaan karta hai aur farmata hai ke laayq-e-ibadat us ke siwa aur koi nahi. Allah ke siwa jin jin ki log ibadat karte hain woh mahz be-bas hain, kisi cheez ke paida karne ki unhein taqat nahi aur Allah Ta'ala sab ka khaliq hai, zahir hai ke khaliq aur ghair khaliq yaksan nahi, phir dono ki ibadat karna kis qadar sitam hai? Itna bhi behosh hojana shayan-e-insaniyat nahi. Phir apni nematon ki farawani aur kasrat bayaan farmata hai ke tumhari ginti mein bhi nahi asaktein, itni nematein main ne tumhein de rakhi hain yeh bhi tumhari taqat se baahar hai ke meri nematon ki ginti kar sako, Allah Ta'ala tumhari khataon se darguzar farmata rehta hai agar apni tamam tar nematon ka shukr bhi tum sab talab kare to tumhare bas ka nahi. Agar in nematon ke badle tum se chahe to tumhari taqat se kharij hai suno agar woh tum sab ko azab kare to bhi woh zalim nahi lekin woh Ghafoor-o-Raheem Allah tumhari buraiyon ko maaf farma deta hai, tumhari taqseeron se tajawuz kar leta hai. Tauba, ruju, itaat aur talab-e-raza-mandi ke sath jo gunah hojayein un se chashm-poshi kar leta hai. Bada hi Raheem hai, tauba ke baad azab nahi karta.

Iske baad zameen ka zikr ho raha hai ke iske thehrane aur hilne jhulne se bachane ke liye is par mazboot aur wazni pahad jama diye ke iske hilne ki wajah se is par rehne walon ki zindagi dushwaar na hojaye. Jaise farman hai ayat (Wal-jibala arsawha 79. An-Nazi'at: 32). Hazrat Hasan (Rahimahullah) ka qaul hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala ne zameen banayi toh woh hil rahi thi yahan tak ke farishton ne kaha is par toh koi thehra hi nahi sakta. Subah dekhte hain ke pahad is par gaad diye gaye hain aur iska hilna mauqoof hogaya pas farishton ko yeh bhi na maloom hosaka ke pahad kis cheez se paida kiye gaye hain. Qais bin Ubadah se bhi yehi marwi hai. 

Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain ke zameen ne kaha tu mujh par Bani Adam ko basata hai jo meri peeth par gunah karenge aur khabasat phailayenge woh kaanpne lagi pas Allah Ta'ala ne pahad ko is par jama diya jinhein tum dekh rahe ho aur baaz ko dekhte hi nahi ho. Yeh bhi iska karam hai ke isne nahrein chashme aur darya charon taraf baha diye. Koi tez hai koi sust, koi lamba hai koi mukhtasar, kabhi kam pani hai kabhi zyada, kabhi bilkul sookha pada hai. Pahadon par, jangalon mein, reet mein, patharon mein barabar yeh chashme bahte rehte hain aur rail peel kardehte hain yeh sab iska fazal-o-karam, lutf-o-rahm hai. Na iske siwa koi parwardigar na iske siwa koi laaiq-e-ibadat, wohi Rab hai, wohi Ma'bood hai.

Usi ne raaste bana diye hain khushki mein, tari mein, pahaad mein, basti mein, ujaad mein har jagah us ke fazl-o-karam se raaste maujood hain ke udhar se udhar log ja asakein koi tang raasta hai koi wasee koi aasan koi sakht. Aur bhi alamatein us ne muqarrar kardin jaise pahaad hain teele hain waghera waghera. Jin se tari khushki ke rahro-o-musafir raah maloom kar lete hain. Aur bhatke hue seedhe raste lag jaate hain. Sitaray bhi rehnumayi ke liye hain raat ke andhere mein unhi se raasta aur samt maloom hoti hai Malik se marwi hai ke nujoom se muraad pahaad hain. Phir apni azmat-o-kibriyai ka bayaan karta hai aur farmata hai ke laayq-e-ibadat us ke siwa aur koi nahi. Allah ke siwa jin jin ki log ibadat karte hain woh mahz be-bas hain, kisi cheez ke paida karne ki unhein taqat nahi aur Allah Ta'ala sab ka khaliq hai, zahir hai ke khaliq aur ghair khaliq yaksan nahi, phir dono ki ibadat karna kis qadar sitam hai? Itna bhi behosh hojana shayan-e-insaniyat nahi. Phir apni nematon ki farawani aur kasrat bayaan farmata hai ke tumhari ginti mein bhi nahi asaktein, itni nematein main ne tumhein de rakhi hain yeh bhi tumhari taqat se baahar hai ke meri nematon ki ginti kar sako, Allah Ta'ala tumhari khataon se darguzar farmata rehta hai agar apni tamam tar nematon ka shukr bhi tum sab talab kare to tumhare bas ka nahi. Agar in nematon ke badle tum se chahe to tumhari taqat se kharij hai suno agar woh tum sab ko azab kare to bhi woh zalim nahi lekin woh Ghafoor-o-Raheem Allah tumhari buraiyon ko maaf farma deta hai, tumhari taqseeron se tajawuz kar leta hai. Tauba, ruju, itaat aur talab-e-raza-mandi ke sath jo gunah hojayein un se chashm-poshi kar leta hai. Bada hi Raheem hai, tauba ke baad azab nahi karta.

Allah Ta'ala apni aur meharbani jatata hai ke samandar par darya par bhi isne tumhein qabiz kar diya bawajood apni gehrai ke aur apni maujon ke woh tumhara tabe hai, tumhari kashtiyan ismein chalti hain. Isi tarah ismein se machhliyan nikal kar aur lulu aur jawahar isne tumhare liye ismein paida kiye hain jinhein tum saholat se nikal lete ho aur bataur zewar ke apne kaam mein lete ho phir is kashtiyan hawaon ko hatati pani ko cheerati apne seene ke bal tirti chali jati hain. Sab se pehle Hazrat Nuh (Alaihis Salam) kashti mein sawar hue unhi ko kashti banana Allah Alam ne sikhaya phir log barabar banate chale aaye aur unhein par darya ke lambe lambe safar taye hone lage is paar ki cheezein us paar aur us paar ki is paar aane jane lagin. Isi ka bayan is mein hai ke tum Allah ka fazal yaani apni rozi tijarat ke zariye dhoondo aur uski naemat aur ehsaan ka shukar mano aur qadr dani karo. 

Musnad Bazzar mein Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) se marwi hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne maghribi darya se kaha ke main apne bandon ko tujh mein sawar karne wala hoon tu unke sath kya karega? Allah Khaliq-e-Kul. Chhupa khula sab kuch Allah jaanta hai, dono is par yaksaan har aamil ko uske amal ka badla Qiyamat ke din dega, nekoon ko jaza badoon ko saza. Jin ma'بودan-e-batil se log apni haajatein talab karte hain woh kisi cheez ke khaliq nahi balki woh khud makhlooq hain. Jaise ke Khalil-ur-Rahman Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ne apni kaum se farmaya tha ke ayat: (Qala a ta'buduuna ma tan-hituun) (37. Al-Saffat: 95) tum unhe pujte ho jinhe khud banate ho. Darhaqeeqat tumhara aur tumhare kaamo ka khaliq sirf Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala hai. Balki tumhare ma'bud jo Allah ke siva jamadaat, be-rooh cheezein, sunte seekhte aur shaoor nahi rakhte unhe to yeh bhi nahi maloom ke Qiyamat kab hogi? To unse nafa ki ummeed aur sawab ki tawaqqua kaise rakhte ho? Yeh ummeed to us Allah se honi chahiye jo har cheez ka aalim aur tamam kainat ka khaliq hai.

Allah hi Ma'bud-e-Barhaq hai, Us ke siwa koi laayiqa-e-ibadat nahi, woh Wahid hai, Ahad hai, Fard hai, Samad hai. Kafirun ke dil bhali baat se inkar karte hain, woh is haq kalme ko sun kar sakht hairat-zada hojate hain. Allah Wahid ka zikar sun kar un ke dil murjha jate hain. Haan auron ka zikar ho toh khul jate hain, yeh Allah ki ibadat se magrour hain. Na un ke dil mein iman, na ibadat ke aadi. Aise log zillat ke sath Jahannam mein dakhil honge. Yaqinan Allah Ta'ala har chhupe khule ka aalim hai, har amal par jaza aur saza dega, woh magrour logon se bezar hai.

Quran Hakim ke irshadaat ko derina kehna kufr ki alamat hai. In munkirin-e-Quran se jab sawal kiya jaye ke Kalamullah mein kya nazil hua toh asl jawab se hat kar bak dete hain ke siwaye guzre hue afsano ke kya rakha hai? Wohi likh liye hain aur subh-o-sham dohra rahe hain. Pas Rasul ﷺ par iftara bandhte hain, kabhi kuch kehte hain, kabhi uske khilaf aur kuch kehne lagte hain. Darasal kisi baat par jam hi nahi sakte aur yeh bahut buri daleel hai un ke tamam aqwal ke batil hone ki. Har ek jo haq se hat jaye woh yunhi mara mara behka behka phirta hai, kabhi Huzoor Rasul ﷺ ko jadugar kehte, kabhi shair, kabhi kahin, kabhi majnoon. Phir un ke buddhe guru Waleed bin Mugheera Makhzoomi ne unhe bare ghor-o-khwoz ke baad kaha ke sab mil kar is kalam ko moassir jadoo kaha karo. Un ke is qaul ka natija bad hoga aur hum ne unhe is rah par is liye laga diya hai ke yeh apne pure gunaho ke sath un ke bhi kuch gunah apne upar ladain jo un ke muqallid hain aur un ke piche piche chal rahe hain. Hadith Sharif mein hai, hidayat ki dawat dene wale ko apne ajr ke sath apne matabai logo ka ajr bhi milta hai lekin un ke ajr kam nahi hote aur burai ki taraf bulane walo ko un ke manne walo ke gunah bhi milte hain lekin manne walo ke gunah kam ho kar nahi. Quran Karim ki aur ayat mein hai: (Wa layahmilunna asqalahum wa asqalan ma'a asqalihim wa layus'alunna yaumal-qiyamati amma kanu yaftaroon) (29. Al-Ankabut: 13). Yeh apne gunaho ke bojh ke sath hi sath aur bojh bhi uthayenge aur un ke iftara ka sawal un se qiyamat ke din hona zaruri hai. Pas manne walo ke bojh go un ki gardano par hain lekin woh bhi halke nahi honge.

Namrood ka tazkirah: Baaz toh kehte hain is makkar se murad Namrood hai jis ne baalakhana tayyar kiya tha. Sab se pehle sab se badi sarkashi usi ne zameen mein ki. Allah Ta'ala ne use halak karne ko ek machhar bheja jo uske nathne mein ghus gaya aur chaar sau saal tak uska bheja chaatta raha, is muddat mein use us waqt qadray sukoon maloom hota tha jab uske sar par hathode maare jayein, khoob fasaad phailaya tha. Baaz kehte hain uske sar par hathode padte rehte the. Us ne chaar sau saal tak saltanat bhi ki thi aur khoob fasaad phailaya tha. Baaz kehte hain isse murad Bakht-e-Nasr hai yeh bhi bada makkar tha lekin Allah ko koi kya nuqsaan pahuñcha sakta hai? Go uska makr pahadon ko bhi apni jagah se sarka dene wala ho. Baaz kehte hain yeh toh kafiron aur mushrikon ne Allah ke sath jo gairoñ ki ibadat ki unke amal ki barbadi ki misaal hai jaise Hazrat Noh (Alaihis Salam) ne farmaya tha aayat: (Wamakaroo makraw wa makarna makraw wa hum la yash'uroon) (Surah An-Naml: 50). Un kafiron ne bada hi makr kiya, har heelay se logon ko gumrah kiya, har waseele se unhe shirk par aamada kiya. Chunacha unke cheele Qiyamat ke din unse kahenge ke tumhara raat din ka makr ke hum se kufr-o-shirk ke liye kehna, al-kh. Unki imarat ki jad aur buniyad se azaab-e-Ilahi aaya yaani bilkul hi khoo diya asl se kaat diya jaise farman hai jab ladai ki aag bhadkana chahte hain Allah Ta'ala use bujha deta hai. Aur farman hai unke paas Allah aisi jagah se aaya jahan ka unhe khayal bhi na tha, unke dilon mein aisa rob daal diya ke yeh apne hathon apne makanat tabaah karne lage aur doosri jaanib se mominoñ ke hathon mite, aql mando! Ibrat hasil karo. Yahan farmaya ke Allah ka azaab unki imarat ki buniyad se aa gaya aur un par upar se chhat aa padi aur nadanista jagah se un par azaab utar aaya. Qiyamat ke din ki ruswai aur fazihat abhi baqi hai, us waqt chhupa hua sab khul jayega, andar ka sab bahar aa jayega. Sara mamla tasht-e-az-bam ho jayega. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain har ghaddar ke liye uske paas hi jhanda gaad diya jayega jo uske ghadr ke mutabiq hoga aur mashhoor kar diya jayega ke falan ka yeh ghadr hai jo falan ka ladka tha. Isi tarah in logon ko bhi maidan-e-mahshar mein sab ke samne ruswa kiya jayega. Unse unka parwardigar daant-dapat kar daryaft farmayega ke jin ki himayat mein tum mere bandon se ulajhte rehte the woh aaj kahan hain? Tumhari madad kyun nahi karte? Aaj be-yaar-o-madadgar kyun ho? Yeh chup ho jayenge, kya jawab dein? La-chaar ho jayenge, kaun si jhoothi daleel pesh karein? Us waqt ulama-e-kiram jo duniya aur akhirat mein Allah ke aur makhlooq ke paas izzat rakhte hain jawab denge ke ruswai aur azaab aaj kafiron ko ghere hue hain aur unke ma'boodan-e-batil unse munh phere hue hain.

Unse unka parwardigar daant-dapat kar daryaft farmayega ke jin ki himayat mein tum mere bandon se ulajhte rehte the woh aaj kahan hain? Tumhari madad kyun nahi karte? Aaj be-yaar-o-madadgar kyun ho? Yeh chup ho jayenge, kya jawab dein? La-chaar ho jayenge, kaun si jhoothi daleel pesh karein? Us waqt ulama-e-kiram jo duniya aur akhirat mein Allah ke aur makhlooq ke paas izzat rakhte hain jawab denge ke ruswai aur azaab aaj kafiron ko ghere hue hain aur unke ma'boodan-e-batil unse munh phere hue hain.

Mushrikin ki jaan kani ka alam: Mushrikin ki jaan kani ke waqt ka haal bayan ho raha hai ke jab farishte in ki jaan lene ke liye aate hain, toh yeh us waqt sunne, amal karne aur maan lene ka ikraar karte hain. Sath hi apne kartoot chhupate hue apni beganahi bayan karte hain. Qiyamat ke din Allah ke saamne bhi qasmein kha kar apna mushrik na hona bayan karenge. Jis tarah duniya mein apni beganahi par logon ke saamne jhooti qasmein khate the. Inhein jawab milega ke jhoote ho, bad-aamaliyan jee khol ke kar chuke ho, Allah ghafil nahi jo baaton mein aa jaye har ek amal us par roshan hai. Ab apne kartooton ka khumiyaza bhugtu aur jahannam ke darwazon se ja kar hamesha isi buri jagah mein pade raho. Maqam bura, makan bura, zillat aur ruswai wala, Allah ki aayaton se takabbur karne ka aur us ke rasoolon ki ittiba se jee churane ka yahi badla hai. Marte hi in ki roohein jahannam raseed ho jaein aur jismon par qabron mein jahannam ki garmi aur us ki lapak aane lagi. Qiyamat ke din roohein jismon se mil kar naar-e-jahannam mein gayin ab na maut na takhfeef. Jaise farman-e-bari hai ayat (Wa makaru makran wa makarna makran wa hum la yash'urun) (Surah Al-Ghafir: 40-46). Yeh dozakh ki aag ke saamne har subh-o-sham laye jaate hain. Qiyamat ke qaim hote hi 'Ae Aal-e-Firaun tum sakht-tr azaab mein chale jao.

Muttaqiyon ke liye behtareen jaza: Buron ke halat bayan farma kar nekondon ke halat jo unke bilkul bar-aks hain, bayan farma raha hai. Bure logon ka jawab toh yeh tha ke Allah ki utari hui kitab sirf guzray logon ke fasane ki naqal hai lekin yeh naik log jawab dete hain ke woh sarasar barkat aur rahmat hai, jo bhi ise mane aur is par amal kare woh barkat-o-rahmat se mala-maal ho jayega. Phir khabar deta hai ke main apne rusoolon se wada kar chuka hoon ke nekondon ko dono jahan ki khushi hasil hogi. Jaise farman hai ke jo shakhs naik amal kare, khwah mard ho khwah aurat, haan yeh zaruri hai ke woh momin ho toh hum use badi pak zindagi ata farmayenge aur uske behtareen aamal ka badla bhi zaroor denge, dono jahan mein woh jaza payega. Yad rahe ke Dar-e-Akhirat, Dar-e-Duniya se bahut hi afzal-o-ahsan hai. Wahan ki jaza nihayat aala aur daimi hai, jaise Qarun ke maal ki tamanna karne walon se ulama-e-kiram ne farmaya tha ke sawab-e-ilahi behtar hai, al-kh. Quran farmata hai: Wa ma 'indallahi khairun lil-abrar (Surah Ali 'Imran: 198) Allah ke paas ki cheezein nek-karon ke liye bahut aala hain. Phir farmata hai, Dar-e-Akhirat muttaqiyon ke liye bahut hi achcha hai. Jannat-e-Adan badal hai Dar-ul-Muttaqin ka, yani unke liye akhirat mein Jannat-e-Adan hai jahan woh rahenge, jiske darakhton aur mahalon ke niche se barabar chashmey har waqt jari hain, jo chahenge payenge. Ankhon ki har thandak maujood hogi aur woh bhi hamishgi wali. Hadith mein hai ahl-e-jannat baithe honge, sar par abr uthega aur jo khwahish yeh karenge woh unko ata karega yahan tak ke koi kahega is ko ham-umr kanwarian milen toh yeh bhi hoga. Parheizgar taqwa-shiar logon ke badle Allah aise hi deta hai jo iman dar hon, darne wale hon aur naik amal hon. Unke intiqal ke waqt yeh shirk ki gandagi se pak hote hi farishte aate hain, salam karte hain, jannat ki khushkhabri sunate hain. Jaise farman-e-aali shan hai: Inna alladhina qalu rabbunallah thumma istaqamu tatanazzalu 'alayhimu al-mala-ikatu alla takhafu wala tahzanu wa abshiru bi-al-jannati allati kuntum tu'adun (Surah Fussilat: 30) Jin logon ne Allah ko Rab mana, phir is par jame rahe, unke paas farishte aate hain aur kehte hain tum koi gham na karo, jannat ki khushkhabri suno, jiska tumse wada tha, hum duniya akhirat mein tumhare wali hain, jo tum chahoge paoge jo mango ge milega. Tum to Allah Ghafoor-o-Raheem ke mehmaan ho. Is mazmoon ki hadeethein hum Ayat: Yuthabbitu Allahu alladhina amanu bi-al-qawli al-thabiti fi al-hayati al-dunya wa fi al-akhirati wa yudillu Allahu al-zalimina wa yaf'alu Allahu ma yashau (Surah Ibrahim: 27) ki tafsir mein bayan kar chuke hain.

Ulta Soch  

Mushrikin ki ulti soch dekhiye, gunah karein, shirk par arein, halal ko haram karein, jaise janwaro ko apne maboodo ke naam se mansoob karna aur taqqad-e-hijrat banayein aur kahein ke agar Allah ko hamare aur hamare baro ke yeh kaam bure lagte toh humein usi waqt saza milti. Unhein jawab diya jata hai ke yeh hamara dastur nahi, humein tumhare yeh kaam sakht napasand hain aur unki napasandigi ka izhar hum apne sachche paigambaro ki zubani kar chuke. Sakht takeedi taur par tumhein un se rok chuke, har basti, har jamaat, har shehar mein apne paigam bheje, sab ne apna farz ada kiya. Bandgan-e-Rab mein uske ahkaam ki tabligh saaf kardi. Sab se keh diya ke ek Allah ki ibadat karo, us ke siva dusre ko na pojo, sab se pehle jab shirk ka zuhoor zameen par hua Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Nuh (Alaihis Salam) ko khilat-e-nabuwat de kar bheja aur sab se aakhir Khatam-ul-Mursaleen ka laqab de kar Rahmatullil Alamin ko apna Nabi banaya, jinn o ins ke liye zameen ke is kone se us kone tak thi jaise farman hai ayat (Wa ma arsalna min qablika min rasulin illa nuhi ilaihi annahu la ilaha illa ana fa'budun) (21. Al-Anbiya: 25). Yani tujh se pehle jitne rasool bheje, sab ki taraf wahi nazil farmai ke mere siva koi aur mabood nahi, pas tum sirf meri hi ibadat karo. Ek aur ayat mein hai, tu apne se pehle ke rasoolo se pooch le ke kya hum ne un ke liye siva apne aur mabood muqarrar kiye the, jin ki woh ibadat karte hon? Yahan bhi farmaya har ummat ke rasoolo ki dawat tauheed ki taleem aur shirk se bezari hi rahi. Pas mushrikin ko apne shirk par, Allah ki chahat, us ki shariat se maloom hoti hai aur woh ibtida hi se shirk ki bekh-kani aur tauheed ki mazbooti ki hai. Tamam rasoolo ki zubani us ne yehi paigam bheja. Haan, unhein shirk karte hue chhor dena yeh aur baat hai jo qabil-e-hujjat nahi. Allah ne jahannam aur jahannami bhi toh banaye hain. Shaitan, kafir sab usi ke paida kiye hue hain aur apne bando se un ke kufr par razi nahi. Is mein bhi us ki hikmat-e-tamma aur hujjat-e-balighah hai, phir farmata hai ke rasoolo ke aagah kar dene ke baad duniyawi sazayein bhi kafiro aur mushriko par ayin. Baaz ko hidayat bhi hui, baaz apni gumrahi mein hi behkte rahe. Tum rasoolo ke mukhalifin ka, Allah ke sath shirk karne walo ka anjam zameen mein chal phir kar khud dekh lo, guzishta waqeat ka jinhe ilm hai un se daryaft kar lo ke kis tarah azab-e-ilahi ne mushriko ko gharat kiya. Us waqt ke kafiro ke liye un kafiro mein misalein aur ibrat mojood hai. Dekh lo Allah ke inkar ka natija kitna muhlik hua? Phir apne Rasul (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se farmata hai ke go aap un ki hidayat ke kaise hi harees hon lekin befayda hai. Rab un ki gumrahiyo ki wajah se unhein dar-e-rahmat se door daal chuka hai. Jaise farman hai ayat (Wa man yuridillahu fitnatahu falan tamlika lahu minallahi shai'a) (5: 41).

Al-Ma'idah: 41) Jise Allah hi fitne mein dalna chahe toh use kuch bhi toh nafa nahi pohncha sakta. Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ne apni kaum se farmaya tha agar Allah ka irada tumhein behkane ka hai toh meri nasihat aur khair-khwahi tumhare liye mahz besud hai. Is ayat mein bhi farmata hai ki jise Allah Ta'ala behkawe use koi hidayat nahi de sakta. Woh din-ba-din apni sarkashi aur behkawe mein barhte rehte hain. Farman hai ayat (Inna alladhina haqqat 'alayhim kalimat rabbika la yu'minun) (10. Yunus: 96) Jin par tere Rab ki baat sabit ho chuki hai unhein iman nasib nahi hone ka. Go tamam nishaniyan unke paas ajayen yahan tak ki azab-e-alim ka munh dekh lein. Pas Allah ya'ani uski shan, ka amr. Is liye ki jo woh chahta hai hota hai jo nahi chahta nahi hota. Pas farmata hai ki woh apne gumrah kiye hue ko rah nahi dikhata na koi aur uski rahbari kar sakta hai na koi uski madad ke liye uth sakta hai ki azab-e-Ilahi se bacha sake. Khalq-o-Amr Allah hi ka hai woh Rabb-ul-Alamin hai, uski zat babarkat hai, wahi sacha mabud hai.

Pas farmata hai ki woh apne gumrah kiye hue ko rah nahi dikhata na koi aur uski rahbari kar sakta hai na koi uski madad ke liye uth sakta hai ki azab-e-Ilahi se bacha sake. Ulta Soch  

Mushrikin ki ulti soch dekhiye, gunah karein, shirk par arein, halal ko haram karein, jaise janwaro ko apne maboodo ke naam se mansoob karna aur taqqad-e-hijrat banayein aur kahein ke agar Allah ko hamare aur hamare baro ke yeh kaam bure lagte toh humein usi waqt saza milti. Unhein jawab diya jata hai ke yeh hamara dastur nahi, humein tumhare yeh kaam sakht napasand hain aur unki napasandigi ka izhar hum apne sachche paigambaro ki zubani kar chuke. Sakht takeedi taur par tumhein un se rok chuke, har basti, har jamaat, har shehar mein apne paigam bheje, sab ne apna farz ada kiya. Bandgan-e-Rab mein uske ahkaam ki tabligh saaf kardi. Sab se keh diya ke ek Allah ki ibadat karo, us ke siva dusre ko na pojo, sab se pehle jab shirk ka zuhoor zameen par hua Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Nuh (Alaihis Salam) ko khilat-e-nabuwat de kar bheja aur sab se aakhir Khatam-ul-Mursaleen ka laqab de kar Rahmatullil Alamin ko apna Nabi banaya, jinn o ins ke liye zameen ke is kone se us kone tak thi jaise farman hai ayat (Wa ma arsalna min qablika min rasulin illa nuhi ilaihi annahu la ilaha illa ana fa'budun) (21. Al-Anbiya: 25). Yani tujh se pehle jitne rasool bheje, sab ki taraf wahi nazil farmai ke mere siva koi aur mabood nahi, pas tum sirf meri hi ibadat karo. Ek aur ayat mein hai, tu apne se pehle ke rasoolo se pooch le ke kya hum ne un ke liye siva apne aur mabood muqarrar kiye the, jin ki woh ibadat karte hon? Yahan bhi farmaya har ummat ke rasoolo ki dawat tauheed ki taleem aur shirk se bezari hi rahi. Pas mushrikin ko apne shirk par, Allah ki chahat, us ki shariat se maloom hoti hai aur woh ibtida hi se shirk ki bekh-kani aur tauheed ki mazbooti ki hai. Tamam rasoolo ki zubani us ne yehi paigam bheja. Haan, unhein shirk karte hue chhor dena yeh aur baat hai jo qabil-e-hujjat nahi. Allah ne jahannam aur jahannami bhi toh banaye hain. Shaitan, kafir sab usi ke paida kiye hue hain aur apne bando se un ke kufr par razi nahi. Is mein bhi us ki hikmat-e-tamma aur hujjat-e-balighah hai, phir farmata hai ke rasoolo ke aagah kar dene ke baad duniyawi sazayein bhi kafiro aur mushriko par ayin. Baaz ko hidayat bhi hui, baaz apni gumrahi mein hi behkte rahe. Tum rasoolo ke mukhalifin ka, Allah ke sath shirk karne walo ka anjam zameen mein chal phir kar khud dekh lo, guzishta waqeat ka jinhe ilm hai un se daryaft kar lo ke kis tarah azab-e-ilahi ne mushriko ko gharat kiya. Us waqt ke kafiro ke liye un kafiro mein misalein aur ibrat mojood hai. Dekh lo Allah ke inkar ka natija kitna muhlik hua? Phir apne Rasul (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se farmata hai ke go aap un ki hidayat ke kaise hi harees hon lekin befayda hai. Rab un ki gumrahiyo ki wajah se unhein dar-e-rahmat se door daal chuka hai. Jaise farman hai ayat (Wa man yuridillahu fitnatahu falan tamlika lahu minallahi shai'a) (5: 41).

Al-Ma'idah: 41) Jise Allah hi fitne mein dalna chahe toh use kuch bhi toh nafa nahi pohncha sakta. Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ne apni kaum se farmaya tha agar Allah ka irada tumhein behkane ka hai toh meri nasihat aur khair-khwahi tumhare liye mahz besud hai. Qiyamah yaqinan qaim hogi kyunki kafir Qiyamah ke qayil nahi is liye doosron ko bhi is aqeedah se hatane ke liye woh poori koshish karte hain iman faroshi kar ke Allah ki takeedi qasmein kha kar kehte hain ke Allah Ta'ala murdon ko zindah nah karega. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke Qiyamah zaroor aayegi Allah ka yeh waada barhaq hai lekin aksar log wajah apni jahalat aur la-ilmi ke Rasoolon ke khilaf karte hain, Allah ki baaton ko nahi mante aur kufr ke garhe mein girte hain. Phir Qiyamah ke aane aur jismon ke dobara zindah hone ki baaz hikmatein zahir farmata hai jin mein se aik yeh hai ke duniyavi ikhtilafat mein haq kya tha woh zahir hojaye, buron ko saza aur nekoon ko jaza mile. Kafiron ka apne aqeedah, apne qool, apni qasam mein jhoota hona khul jaye. Us waqt sab dekh lenge ke unhein dhakke de kar Jahannam mein jhonka jayega aur kaha jayega ke yahi hai woh Jahannam jis ka tum inkar karte rahe ab batao yeh jadoo hai ya tum andhe ho? Is mein ab pare raho. Sabr se raho ya haye waaye karo, sab barabar hai, aamal ka badla bhugtna zaroori hai. Allah har cheez par Qadir hai phir apni be-andazah qudrat ka bayan farmata hai ke jo woh chahe us par Qadir hai koi baat use aajiz nahi kar sakti, koi cheez us ke ikhtiyar se kharij nahi, woh jo karna chahe farma deta hai ke hoja usi waqt woh kaam hojata hai. Qiyamah bhi us ke farman ka amal hai jaise farmaya aik aankh jhapakne mein us ka kaha hojaye ga tum sab ka paida karna aur marne ke baad zindah kar dena us par aisa hi hai jaise aik ko ishar kaha hoja udhar hogaya. Is ko dobara kehne ya takeed karne ki bhi zaroorat nahi us ke irada se murad juda nahi. Koi nahi jo us ke khilaf kar sake, us ke hukum ke khilaf zaban hila sake. Woh Wahid-o-Qahhar hai, woh azmaton aur izzaton wala hai, saltanat aur jabroot wala hai. Us ke siva na koi mabood na hakim na Rabb na Qadir. Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ka irshad hai ke Ibn-e-Adam mujhe galiyan deta hai use aisa nahi chahiye tha. Woh mujhe jhutla raha hai halanki yeh bhi use layak na tha. Us ka jhutlana to yeh hai ke sakht qasmein kha kar kehta hai ke Allah murdon ko phir zindah na karega mein kehta hoon yaqinan zindah hoon ge. Yeh barhaq waada hai lekin aksar log jaante nahi aur us ka mujhe galiyan dena yeh hai ke kehta hai Allah teen mein ka teesra hai halanki mein Ahad hoon, mein Allah hoon, mein Samad hoon, jis ka ham-jins koi aur nahi. Ibn Abi Hatim mein to hadees mauqoofan marwi hai. Bukhari o Muslim mein doosre lafzon ke sath marfoo'an riwayat bhi aayi hai.

Deen ki pasbani mein hijrat: Jo log Allah ki raah mein tark-e-watan kar ke, dost, ahbab, rishte daar, kunbe tijarat ko Allah ke naam par tark kar ke Deen-e-Rabbani ki pasbani mein hijrat kar jaate hain un ke ajar bayan ho rahe hain ki dono jahan mein yeh Allah ke haan moazzaz-o-muhtaram hain. 

Bohat mumkin hai ki sabab-e-nuzool is ka Muhajireen-e-Habash hon jo Makkah mein mushrikeen ki sakht ezaayein sahne ke baad hijrat kar ke Habash chale gaye ki azaadi se Deen-e-Haq par aamil rahein. Un ke behtareen log yeh thay: Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A), aap ke sath aap ki biwi sahiba Hazrat Ruqayyah (R.A) bhi thin jo Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki sahibzadi thin aur Hazrat Jafar bin Abi Talib (R.A) jo Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke chacha zaad bhai thay aur Hazrat Abu Salmah bin Abdul Asad (R.A) waghera. 

Qareeb qareeb assi aadmi thay mard bhi aur aurtein bhi jo sab Siddiq aur Siddiqa thay, Allah un sab se khush ho aur unhein bhi khush rakhe. Pas Allah Ta'ala aise sachche logon se wada farmata hai ki unhein woh achchi jagah inayat farmayega. Jaise Madinah aur paak rozi, maal ka bhi badla mila aur watan ka bhi. Haqeeqat yeh hai ki jo shakhs Allah ke khauf se jaisi cheez ko chhore Allah Ta'ala usi jaisi balki us se kahin behtar, paak aur halal cheez use ata farmata hai. In ghareeb-ul-watan Muhajireen ko dekhiye ki Allah Ta'ala ne unhein hakim-o-badshah kar diya aur duniya par un ko saltanat ata ki. Abhi aakhirat ka ajr-o-sawab baaki hai. Pas hijrat se jaan churane wale Muhajireen ke sawab se waqif hote to hijrat mein sabqat karte. 

Allah Ta'ala Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam (R.A) se khush ho ki aap jab kabhi kisi muhajir ko us ka hissa-e-ghaneemat waghera dete to farmate: "Lo Allah tumhein barkat de, yeh to duniya ka Allah ka wada hai aur abhi ajr-e-aakhirat jo bohat azeem-ush-shan hai, baaki hai." Phir usi ayat-e-mubaraka ki tilawat karte. 

In paakbaaz logon ka aur wasf bayan فرماتا hai ki jo takleefein Allah ki raah mein unhein pahunchti hain yeh unhein jheel lete hain aur Allah Ta'ala par jo unhein tawakkul hai, us mein kabhi farq nahi aata, isi liye dono jahan ki bhalaayiyan yeh log apne dono haathon se samet lete hain.

Insaan aur Mansab-e-Risalat par Ikhtilaf:

Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke jab Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Muhammad Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ko Rasool bana kar bheja toh Arab ne saaf inkar kar diya aur kaha ke Allah ki shaan is se bahut aala aur baala hai ke woh kisi insaan ko apna Rasool banaye, jis ka zikr Quran mein bhi hai. Farmata hai ayat (A kaana lin-naasi ‘ajaban) al-kh, kya logon ko is baat par taajub maaloom hua ke hum ne kisi insaan ki taraf apni wahi nazil farmayi ke woh logon ko aagah kar de. Aur farmaya hum ne tujh se pehle bhi jitne Rasool bheje sabhi insaan thay jin par hamari wahi aati thi. Tum pehli aasmani kitab walon se pooch lo ke woh insaan thay ya farishte? Agar woh bhi insaan hon toh phir apne is قول se baaz aao, haan agar sabit ho ke silsila-e-nubuwwat farishton mein hi raha toh beshak is Nabi ka inkar karte hue tum acche lago ge. Aur ayat mein "min ahlil-qura" ka lafz bhi farmaya, yaani woh Rasool bhi zameen ke bashindey thay, aasmaan ki makhlooq na thay.

Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain murad ahl-e-zikr se ahl-e-kitab hain. Mujahid (R.H) aur A'mash (R.H) ka qaul bhi yehi hai. Abdur Rahman (R.H) farmate hain zikr se murad Quran hai, jaise ayat (Inna nahnu nazzalna-zzikra wa inna lahu lahafizoon) (15. Al-Hijr: 9) mein hai. Yeh qaul bajaye khud theek hai lekin is ayat mein zikr se murad Quran lena durust nahi kyunke Quran ke toh woh log munkar thay. Phir Quran walon se pooch kar un ki tashfi kaise ho sakti thi?

Isi tarah Abu Ja'far Baqir Rahimahullah Ta'ala se marwi hai ke hum ahl-e-zikr hain, yaani yeh ummat. Yeh qaul bhi apni jagah durust hai, fi-al-waqi yeh ummat tamam agli ummaton se zyada ilm wali hai aur ahl-e-bait ke ulema aur digar ulema se badarja barh kar hain, jab ke woh sunnat-e-mustaqeem par sabit qadam hon. Jaise Ali, Ibn Abbas, Hasan, Husain, Muhammad bin Hanafiyyah, Ali bin Husain Zainul Abideen, Abdullah bin Abbas, Abu Ja'far Baqir, Muhammad bin Ali bin Husain aur un ke sahibzade Ja'far aur un jaise aur buzurg hazraat. Allah ki rahmat-o-riza unhein haasil ho, jo ke Allah ki rassi ko mazboot thame hue aur sirat-e-mustaqeem par qadam jamaye hue aur har haqdaar ke haq baja laane wale aur har ek ko us ki sachi jagah utaarne wale, har ek ki qadr-o-izzat karne wale thay aur khud woh Allah ke tamam naik bandon ke dilon mein apni maqbooliyat rakhte hain.

Yeh beshak sahi toh hai lekin is ayat mein yeh murad nahi. Yahan bayan ho raha hai ke aap bhi insaan hain aur aap se pehle bhi anbiya bani adam mein se hote rahe hain. Jaise farman hai ayat (Qul subhana Rabbi hal kuntu illa basharan Rasoola) (17. Al-Isra: 93) keh de ke mera Rab paak hai, main sirf ek insaan hoon jo Allah ka Rasool hoon. Log mahz yeh bahana kar ke Rasoolon ka inkar kar baithe ke kaise mumkin hai ke Allah Ta'ala kisi insaan ko apni risalat de. Aur ayat mein hai tujh se pehle jitne Rasool hum ne bheje sabhi khane peene aur bazaron mein chalne phirne wale thay.

Aur aayat mein hai hum ne un ke jism aise nahi banaye thay ke woh khane peene se be-niyaaz hon ya yeh ke marne wale hi na hon. Aur jagah irshad hai aayat (Qul ma kuntu bid'an minar-rusuli wa ma adri ma yuf'alu bi wa la bikum) (46. Al-Ahqaf: 9) mein koi shuru ka aur pehla aur naya rasul to nahi? Ek aur aayat mein hai main tum jaisa insan hoon meri jaanib wahi utari jaati hai al-kh. Pas yahan bhi irshad huwa ke pehli kitabon walon se pooch lo ke nabi insan hote thay ya ghair insan? Phir yahan farmata hai ke rasul ko woh dalelein de kar hujjein ata farma kar bhejta hai kitabein un par nazil farmata hai sahife unhe ata farmata hai. Zubur se murad kitabein hain jaise Quran mein aur jagah hai aayat (Wa kullu shai'in fa'aluhu fiz-zubur) (54. Al-Qamar: 52) jo kuch unho ne kiya kitabon mein hai. Aur aayat mein hai (Laqad katabna fiz-zubur) hum ne zubur mein likh diya al-kh. Phir farmata hai hum ne teri taraf zikr nazil farmaya yani Quran is liye ke chunke tu is ke ma'ani matlab se achchi tarah waqif hai ise logon ko samjha bujha de. Haqiqatan ae nabi aap hi is par sab se zyada haris hain aap hi is ke sab se bare aalim hain aur aap hi is ke sab se zyada aamil hain. Is liye ke aap afzal-ul-khalaq hain. Aulad-e-Adam ke sardar hain. Jo ajmal is kitab mein hai is ki tafseel aap ke zimme hai, logon par jo mushkil ho aap ise samjha dein taake woh sojein samjhein rah payein aur phir nijat aur dono jahan ki bhalayi hasil karein.

Insaan aur Mansab-e-Risalat par Ikhtilaf:

Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke jab Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Muhammad Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ko Rasool bana kar bheja toh Arab ne saaf inkar kar diya aur kaha ke Allah ki shaan is se bahut aala aur baala hai ke woh kisi insaan ko apna Rasool banaye, jis ka zikr Quran mein bhi hai. Farmata hai ayat (A kaana lin-naasi ‘ajaban) al-kh, kya logon ko is baat par taajub maaloom hua ke hum ne kisi insaan ki taraf apni wahi nazil farmayi ke woh logon ko aagah kar de. Aur farmaya hum ne tujh se pehle bhi jitne Rasool bheje sabhi insaan thay jin par hamari wahi aati thi. Tum pehli aasmani kitab walon se pooch lo ke woh insaan thay ya farishte? Agar woh bhi insaan hon toh phir apne is قول se baaz aao, haan agar sabit ho ke silsila-e-nubuwwat farishton mein hi raha toh beshak is Nabi ka inkar karte hue tum acche lago ge. Aur ayat mein "min ahlil-qura" ka lafz bhi farmaya, yaani woh Rasool bhi zameen ke bashindey thay, aasmaan ki makhlooq na thay.

Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain murad ahl-e-zikr se ahl-e-kitab hain. Mujahid (R.H) aur A'mash (R.H) ka qaul bhi yehi hai. Abdur Rahman (R.H) farmate hain zikr se murad Quran hai, jaise ayat (Inna nahnu nazzalna-zzikra wa inna lahu lahafizoon) (15. Al-Hijr: 9) mein hai. Yeh qaul bajaye khud theek hai lekin is ayat mein zikr se murad Quran lena durust nahi kyunke Quran ke toh woh log munkar thay. Phir Quran walon se pooch kar un ki tashfi kaise ho sakti thi?

Isi tarah Abu Ja'far Baqir Rahimahullah Ta'ala se marwi hai ke hum ahl-e-zikr hain, yaani yeh ummat. Yeh qaul bhi apni jagah durust hai, fi-al-waqi yeh ummat tamam agli ummaton se zyada ilm wali hai aur ahl-e-bait ke ulema aur digar ulema se badarja barh kar hain, jab ke woh sunnat-e-mustaqeem par sabit qadam hon. Jaise Ali, Ibn Abbas, Hasan, Husain, Muhammad bin Hanafiyyah, Ali bin Husain Zainul Abideen, Abdullah bin Abbas, Abu Ja'far Baqir, Muhammad bin Ali bin Husain aur un ke sahibzade Ja'far aur un jaise aur buzurg hazraat. Allah ki rahmat-o-riza unhein haasil ho, jo ke Allah ki rassi ko mazboot thame hue aur sirat-e-mustaqeem par qadam jamaye hue aur har haqdaar ke haq baja laane wale aur har ek ko us ki sachi jagah utaarne wale, har ek ki qadr-o-izzat karne wale thay aur khud woh Allah ke tamam naik bandon ke dilon mein apni maqbooliyat rakhte hain.

Yeh beshak sahi toh hai lekin is ayat mein yeh murad nahi. Yahan bayan ho raha hai ke aap bhi insaan hain aur aap se pehle bhi anbiya bani adam mein se hote rahe hain. Jaise farman hai ayat (Qul subhana Rabbi hal kuntu illa basharan Rasoola) (17. Al-Isra: 93) keh de ke mera Rab paak hai, main sirf ek insaan hoon jo Allah ka Rasool hoon. Log mahz yeh bahana kar ke Rasoolon ka inkar kar baithe ke kaise mumkin hai ke Allah Ta'ala kisi insaan ko apni risalat de. Aur ayat mein hai tujh se pehle jitne Rasool hum ne bheje sabhi khane peene aur bazaron mein chalne phirne wale thay.

Aur aayat mein hai hum ne un ke jism aise nahi banaye thay ke woh khane peene se be-niyaaz hon ya yeh ke marne wale hi na hon. Aur jagah irshad hai aayat (Qul ma kuntu bid'an minar-rusuli wa ma adri ma yuf'alu bi wa la bikum) (46. Al-Ahqaf: 9) mein koi shuru ka aur pehla aur naya rasul to nahi? Allah Azza wa Jalla ka Ghazab. Allah Ta'ala Khaliq-e-Kainaat aur Malik-e-Arz-o-Samawat apne hilm ke bawajood, ilm ke bawajood aur apni meharbani ke bawajood ghusse ke bayan farmata hai ke woh agar chahe apne gunahgar bad-kirar bandon ko zameen mein dhunsa sakta hai. Be-khabri mein un par azab la sakta hai lekin apni ghayat meharbani se dar-guzar kiye hue hai jaise Surah Tabarak mein farmaya: Allah jo aasman mein hai kya tum uske ghab se nahin darte? Ke kahin zameen ko daldal bana kar tumhein us mein dhunsa na de ke woh tumhein hachkole hi lagati raha kare, kya tumhein aasmanon wale Allah se dar nahin lagta ke kahin woh tum par aasman se patthar na barsa de. Us waqt tumhein maloom ho jaye ke mera darana kaisa tha. 

Aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke Allah Ta'ala aise makkar, bad-kirar logon ko unke chalte-phirte, aate, khate, kamate hi pakad le. Safar-o-hazar, raat-din jis waqt chahe, pakad le jaise farman hai: Afa amina ahlul-qura an yatiyahum basuna bayatanw wahum na-imin (7:97), kya basti wale is se nadar ho gaye hain ke unke paas hamara azab raat mein unke sote-salate hi aa jaye. Ya din chadhe unke khel-kood ke waqt hi aa jaye. Allah ko koi shakhs aur koi kaam aajiz nahin kar sakta, woh harne wala, thakne wala aur nakaam hone wala nahin. 

Aur yeh bhi mumkin hai ke bawajood dar-khauf ke unhein pakad le to dono azab ek sath ho jayein, dar aur phir pakad. Ek ko achanak maut aa jaye, dusra dare aur phir mare. Lekin Rabbul-Ala, Rabbul-Kainaat bada hi Rauf-o-Rahim hai is liye jaldi nahin pakadata. Bukhari o Muslim mein hai khilaf-e-tab' baatein sun kar sabar karne mein Allah se badh kar koi nahin. Log uski aulaad thharate hain aur woh unhein rizq aur aafiyat inayat farmata hai. Bukhari Muslim mein hai Allah Ta'ala zalim ko muhlat deta hai lekin jab pakad nazil farmata hai phir achanak tabaah ho jata hai, phir Huzoor ﷺ ne ayat: Wa kazalika akhzu rabbika iza akhazal-qura wa hiya zalimathun inna akhzahu aleemun shadeed (11:102), padhi. Aur ayat mein hai: Wa kaayyin min qaryatin amlaitu laha wa hiya zalimathun thumma akhaztuha wa ilaiyal-maseer (22:48), bahut si bastiyan hain jinhein maine kuch muhlat di lekin aakhir unke zulm ki bina par unhein giraftar kar liya. Lautna to meri hi jaanib hai.

Arsh se farsh tak Allah Ta'ala Zul-Jalal wal-Ikram ki azmat-o-jalalat, kibriyai aur be-himtai ka khayal kijiye ke saari makhlooq arsh se farsh tak us ke samne mutee aur ghulam. Jamadaat-o-haywanat, insan aur jinnaat, farishtey aur kul kainat, us ki farman-bardar, har cheez subh-o-sham us ke samne har tarah se apni aajizi aur be-kasi ka saboot pesh karne wali, jhuk jhuk kar us ke samne sajde karne wali. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain suraj dhalte hi tamam cheezein Allah ke samne sajde mein gir parti hain har ek Rabb-ul-Alameen ke samne zaleel-o-past hai, aajiz-o-be-bas hai. Pahaad waghera ka sajda un ka saya hai, samandar ki maujein us ki namaz hai. Unhe goya zawi-ul-uqool samajh kar sajde ki nisbat un ki taraf ki. Aur farmaya zameen-o-asman ke kul jandar us ke samne sajde mein hain. Jaise farman hai ayat (Wa lillahi yasjudu man fis-samawati wal-ardi tau'an wa karhan wa zilaluhum bil-guduwi wal-asal) (Surah Ar-Ra'ad: 15). Khushi na-khushi har cheez Rabb-ul-Alameen ke samne sar-ba-sujood hai, un ke saaye subh-o-sham sajda karte hain. Farishtey bhi bawajood apni qadr-o-manzalat ke Allah ke samne past hain, us ki ibadat se tang nahi aa sakte Allah Ta'ala Jalla wa Ala se kaampte aur larzte rehte hain aur jo hukm hai us ki baja-awari mein mashghool hain na nafarmani karte hain na susti karte hain.

Har cheez ka wahid malik wahi hai. Allah wahid ke siva koi mustahiq-e-ibadat nahi, woh la shareek hai, woh har cheez ka khaliq hai, malik hai, palanhar hai. Usi ki khalis ibadat daimiyan aur wajib hai. Us ke siva dusron ki ibadat ke tareeqe na ikhtiyar karne chahiyen. Aasman-o-Zameen ki tamam makhlooq khushi ya na khushi is ki matahat hai. Sab ko lautaya jana usi ki taraf hai, khulus ke sath usi ki ibadat karo. Us ke sath dusron ko shareek karne se bacho. Deen-e-Khalis sirf Allah hi ka hai. Aasman-o-Zameen ki har cheez ka malik wahi tanha hai. Nafa nuqsan usi ke ikhtiyar mein hai, jo kuch naamatein bando ke hath mein hain sab usi ki taraf se hain, rizq, naamatein, afiyat, tasarruf usi ki taraf se hain, usi ke fazl-o-ehsan bandon par hain. Aur ab bhi in naamatein ke pane ke baad bhi tum us ke waise hi mohtaj ho, museebatein ab bhi sar par mandla rahi hain. Sakhti ke waqt wahi yaad aata hai aur gidgida kar poori aajizi ke sath kathin waqt mein usi ki taraf jhukte ho. Khud mushrikeen-e-Makkah ka bhi yahi haal tha ke jab samandar mein ghir jate, baad-e-mukhalif ke jhonke kashti ko patte ki tarah hichkole dene lagte toh apne thakron, devtaon, buton, faqeerin, waliyon, nabiyon sab ko bhool jate aur khalis Allah se lau laga kar khulus-e-dil se us se bachao aur najat talab karte. Lekin kinare par kashti ke par lagte hi apne purane Allah sab yaad aa jate aur mabood-e-haqiqi ke sath phir un ki puja paat hone lagti. Is se barh kar bhi nashukri, kufr aur naamaton ki faramoshi aur kya ho sakti hai? Yahan bhi farmaya ke matlab nikal jate hi bohat se log ankhein pher lete hain. Likafru ka lam lam-e-aqibat hai aur lam-e-taleel bhi kaha gaya hai yaani hum ne yeh khaslat in ki is liye kar di hai ki woh Allah ki nemat par parde dalein aur is ka inkar karein halanki darasal naamaton ka dene wala, museebaton ka dafa karne wala is ke siva koi nahi. Phir unhein darata hai ki acha duniya mein to apna kaam chala lo, mamooli sa faida yahan ka utha lo lekin is ka anjam abhi abhi maloom ho jayega.

Lekin kinare par kashti ke par lagte hi apne purane Allah sab yaad aa jate aur mabood-e-haqiqi ke sath phir un ki puja paat hone lagti. Is se barh kar bhi nashukri, kufr aur naamaton ki faramoshi aur kya ho sakti hai? Yahan bhi farmaya ke matlab nikal jate hi bohat se log ankhein pher lete hain. Likafru ka lam lam-e-aqibat hai aur lam-e-taleel bhi kaha gaya hai yaani hum ne yeh khaslat in ki is liye kar di hai ki woh Allah ki nemat par parde dalein aur is ka inkar karein halanki darasal naamaton ka dene wala, museebaton ka dafa karne wala is ke siva koi nahi. Phir unhein darata hai ki acha duniya mein to apna kaam chala lo, mamooli sa faida yahan ka utha lo lekin is ka anjam abhi abhi maloom ho jayega.

Sab ko lautaya jana usi ki taraf hai, khulus ke sath usi ki ibadat karo. Us ke sath dusron ko shareek karne se bacho. Deen-e-Khalis sirf Allah hi ka hai. Aasman-o-Zameen ki har cheez ka malik wahi tanha hai. Baz-purs lazmi hogi. Mushrikin ki be-aqli aur be-dhangi bayan ho rahi hai ke dene wala Allah hai, sab kuch usi ka diya hua aur yeh is mein se apne jhoote ma'aboodon ke naam kar dete hain jinka sahi ilm bhi inhein nahi, phir is mein sakhti aisi karte hain ke Allah ke naam ka toh chahe inke ma'aboodon ke ho jaye, lekin inke ma'aboodon ke naam kiya gaya Allah ke naam na ho sake. Aise logon se zaroor baz-purs hogi aur is iftira ka badla inhein poora poora milega. Jahannam ki aag hogi aur yeh wahan honge. Phir inki doosri be-insaafi aur himaqat bayan ho rahi hai ke Allah ke muqarrab ghulam farishte inke nazdeek Allah ki betiyan hain, yeh khata kar ke phir inki ibadat karte hain jo khata par khata hai. Yahan teen jurm inse sarzad hue: awwal toh Allah ke liye aulad thehrana jo is se yaksar pak hai, phir aulad mein se bhi woh qism ise dena jise khud apne liye bhi pasand nahi karte yaani larkiyan. Kya hi ulti baat hai ke apne liye aulad ho? Phir aulad bhi woh jo inke nazdeek nihayat raddi aur zaleel cheez hai. Kya himaqat hai ke inhein toh Allah larke de aur apne liye larkiyan rakhe? Allah is se balke aulad se pak hai. Inhein jab khabar mile ke inke han larki hui toh maare nadamat aur sharm ke munh kala par jaye, zuban band ho jaye, gham se kamar jhuk jaye, zehar ke ghoont pi kar khamosh ho jaye, logon se munh chhupata phere, isi soch mein rahe ke ab kya karoon, agar larki ko zinda chhodta hoon toh badi ruswai hai, na woh waris bane na koi cheez samjhi jaye, larke ko is par tarjeeh di jaye, gharz zinda rakhe toh nihayat zillat se, warna saaf baat hai ke jeete ji gadha khoda aur daba di. Yeh halat toh apni hai, phir Allah ke liye yehi cheez sabit karte hain. Kaise bure faisle karte hain? Kitni be-hayai ki taqseem karte hain Allah ke liye jo beti sabit karein use apne liye sakht tar baa'is-e-tauheen-o-tazleel samjhein. Asl yeh hai ke buri misaal aur nuqsaan inhi kaf

Woh bandon ko muhlat deta hai. Allah Ta'ala ke hilm-o-karam, lutf-o-rahm ka bayaan ho raha hai ke bandon ke gunah dekhta hai aur phir bhi unhein muhlat deta hai. Agar foran hi pakray to aaj zameen par koi chalta phirta nazar na aaye. Insanon ki khataon mein janwar bhi halak ho jaaein. Gehoon ke sath ghan bhi pis jaye. Buron ke sath bhaley bhi pakar mein aa jaaein. Lekin Allah Subhana wa Ta'ala apne hilm-o-karam, lutf-o-rahm se parda poshi kar raha hai, dar-guzar farma raha hai, maafi de raha hai. Ek khas waqt tak ki muhlat diye huwe hain, warna keeray aur bhangay bhi na bachtay. Bani Adam ke gunahon ki kasrat ki wajah se azab-e-ilahi aise aate ke sab ko gharat kar jaate. Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A ne suna ke koi sahib farma rahe hain: "Zalim apna hi nuqsan karta hai," to aap ne farmaya: "Nahin nahin, balki parind apne ghoslon mein wajah is ke zulm ke halak ho jaate hain." Abu Darda R.A farmate hain ke hum ek martaba An-Hazrat ﷺ ke samne kuch zikr kar rahe thay ke aap ne farmaya: "Allah kisi nafs ko dheel nahi deta, umr ki ziyadti naik aulad se hoti hai jo Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ko inayat farmata hai, phir un bachon ki duaein un ki qabar mein unhein pahunchti rehti hain, yahi un ki umr ki ziyadti hai."

Apne liye yeh zalim larkiyan napasand karein, shirkat na chahein aur Allah ke liye yeh sab rawa rakhein. Phir yeh khayal karein ke yeh duniya mein bhi achhaiyan sametne wale hain aur agar qiyamat qaim hui to wahan bhi bhalai un ke liye hai. Yeh kaha karte thay ke nafa ke mustahiq is duniya mein to hum hain hi aur sahi baat to yeh hai ke qiyamat ne aana nahi. Bilfarz aayi bhi to wahan ki behtari bhi hamare liye hi hai. In kuffar ko anqareeb sakht azab chakhne parenge, hamari aayton se kufr phir aarzu yeh ke maal-o-aulad hamein wahan bhi miley. Surah Al-Kahf mein do sathiayon ka zikr karte huwe Quran ne farmaya hai ke woh zalim apne bagh mein jaate huwe apne naik sathi se kehta hai: "Main to ise halak hone wala janta hi nahi, na qiyamat ka qayil hoon aur agar bilfarz main dobara zinda kiya gaya to wahan is se bhi behtar cheez diya jaunga." 

Kaam bure karein, aarzu neki ki rakhein. Kantay boein aur phal chahein. Kehte hain Ka'batullah Sharif ki emarat ko naye saron se banane ke liye jab dhaya to bunyadon mein se ek patthar nikla, jis par ek katba likha hua tha, jis mein yeh bhi likha tha ke: "Tum buraiyan karte ho aur nekiyon ki umeed rakhte ho, yeh aisa hi hai jaise kantay bo kar angoor ki umeed rakhna." 

Pas un ki umeedien thin ke duniya mein bhi unhein jah-o-hashmat aur londi ghulam milein aur aakhirat mein bhi. Allah farmata hai darasal un ke liye aatish-e-dosh tayyar hai. Wahan yeh rehmat-e-Rab se bhula diye jaenge aur zaya aur barbaad ho jaenge. Aaj yeh hamare ahkam bhulaaye baithe hain, kal unhein hum apni naimton se bhula denge, yeh jaldi hi jahannam nasheen hone wale hain.

Buron ke sath bhaley bhi pakar mein aa jaaein. Lekin Allah Subhana wa Ta'ala apne hilm-o-karam, lutf-o-rahm se parda poshi kar raha hai, dar-guzar farma raha hai, maafi de raha hai. Ek khas waqt tak ki muhlat diye huwe hain, warna keeray aur bhangay bhi na bachtay. Bani Adam ke gunahon ki kasrat ki wajah se azab-e-ilahi aise aate ke sab ko gharat kar jaate. Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A ne suna ke koi sahib farma rahe hain: "Zalim apna hi nuqsan karta hai," to aap ne farmaya: "Nahin nahin, balki parind apne ghoslon mein wajah is ke zulm ke halak ho jaate hain." Abu Darda R.A farmate hain ke hum ek martaba An-Hazrat ﷺ ke samne kuch zikr kar rahe thay ke aap ne farmaya: "Allah kisi nafs ko dheel nahi deta, umr ki ziyadti naik aulad se hoti hai jo Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ko inayat farmata hai, phir un bachon ki duaein un ki qabar mein unhein pahunchti rehti hain, yahi un ki umr ki ziyadti hai."

Apne liye yeh zalim larkiyan napasand karein, shirkat na chahein aur Allah ke liye yeh sab rawa rakhein. Phir yeh khayal karein ke yeh duniya mein bhi achhaiyan sametne wale hain aur agar qiyamat qaim hui to wahan bhi bhalai un ke liye hai. Yeh kaha karte thay ke nafa ke mustahiq is duniya mein to hum hain hi aur sahi baat to yeh hai ke qiyamat ne aana nahi. Bilfarz aayi bhi to wahan ki behtari bhi hamare liye hi hai. In kuffar ko anqareeb sakht azab chakhne parenge, hamari aayton se kufr phir aarzu yeh ke maal-o-aulad hamein wahan bhi miley. Surah Al-Kahf mein do sathiayon ka zikr karte huwe Quran ne farmaya hai ke woh zalim apne bagh mein jaate huwe apne naik sathi se kehta hai: "Main to ise halak hone wala janta hi nahi, na qiyamat ka qayil hoon aur agar bilfarz main dobara zinda kiya gaya to wahan is se bhi behtar cheez diya jaunga." 

Kaam bure karein, aarzu neki ki rakhein. Kantay boein aur phal chahein. Kehte hain Ka'batullah Sharif ki emarat ko naye saron se banane ke liye jab dhaya to bunyadon mein se ek patthar nikla, jis par ek katba likha hua tha, jis mein yeh bhi likha tha ke: "Tum buraiyan karte ho aur nekiyon ki umeed rakhte ho, yeh aisa hi hai jaise kantay bo kar angoor ki umeed rakhna." 

Pas un ki umeedien thin ke duniya mein bhi unhein jah-o-hashmat aur londi ghulam milein aur aakhirat mein bhi. Allah farmata hai darasal un ke liye aatish-e-dosh tayyar hai. Wahan yeh rehmat-e-Rab se bhula diye jaenge aur zaya aur barbaad ho jaenge. Aaj yeh hamare ahkam bhulaaye baithe hain, kal unhein hum apni naimton se bhula denge, yeh jaldi hi jahannam nasheen hone wale hain.

Shaitan ke dost

Aap Nabi ﷺ aap tasalli rakhein. Aap ko aap ki kaum ka jhutlana koi anokhi baat nahi, kaun sa nabi aaya jo jhutlaya na gaya? Baqi rahe jhutlane wale woh shaitan ke mureed hain. Buraiyan unhein shaitani waswasay se bhalaiyan dikhai deti hain. Un ka wali shaitan hai, woh unhein koi nafa pohchanay wala nahi. Hamesha ke liye museebat-afza azabon mein chhor kar un se alag ho jaye ga. 

Quran Haq-o-Batil mein, sach jhoot mein tamiz karane wali kitab hai, har jaghra aur har ikhtilaf ka faisla is mein maujood hai. Yeh dilon ke liye hidayat hai aur imandar jo is par amil hain, un ke liye rahmat hai. Is Quran se kis tarah murda dil ji uthtey hain, is ki misaal murda zameen aur barish ki hai. Jo log baat ko sunein, samjhein, woh to is se bohat kuch ibrat hasil kar sakte hain.

Khushgawar doodh Allah Ta'ala ki azmat ka gawah hai. Oont, gaye, bakri waghera bhi apne khaliq ki qudrat-o-hikmat ki nishaniyan hain. "Botonihā" mein zameer ko ya to na'mat ke ma'ani par lotaya hai ya haiwan par, chopaye bhi haiwan hi hain. In janwaron ke pait mein jo alā balā bhari hui hoti hai, usi mein se Parwardigar-e-Alam tumhe nihayat khush zaiqa, lateef aur khushgawar doodh pilata hai. Dusri ayat mein "Botonihā" hai, donon baten jaiz hain. Jaise ayat (Kallā innahā tazkirah, faman shā'a zakarah) (80. Abasa: 11-12) mein hai aur jaise ayat (Wa innī mursilatun ilaihim bi-hadiyyatin fanāziratun bima yarji'ul-mursalūn) (27. An-Naml: 35) mein hai, pas "jā'a" mein muzakkar laye. Murad is se maal hai. Janwar ke batin mein jo gobar, khoon waghera hai, maide mein ghiza pohnchi, wahan se khoon ragon ki taraf dor gaya, doodh than ki taraf pohnch gaya, peshab ne masane ka rasta pakra, gobar apne makhraj ki taraf jama hua, na ek dusre se mile na ek dusre ko badle. Yeh khalis doodh jo pine wale ke halq mein ba-aram utar jaye, is ki khas na'mat hai. Is na'mat ke bayan ke sath hi dusri na'mat bayan farmai ke khajoor aur angoor ke shire se tum sharab bana lete ho. Yeh sharab ki hurmat se pehle hai. Aur is se maloom hota hai ke in donon cheezon ki sharab ek hi hukum mein hai, jaise Malik R.H, Shafi'i R.H, Ahmad aur jumhoor ulama ka mazhab hai aur yahi hukum hai aur sharabon ka jo gehoon, jau, jwar aur shahed se banai jayen, jaise ke ahadeeb mein mfassal aachuka hai. Yeh jagah is ki tafseel ki nahi. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain: Sharab banate ho jo haram hai aur aur tarah khate pite ho jo halal hai, masalan khushk khajooren, kishmish waghera aur nabeed sharbat bana kar, sirka bana kar aur kayi aur tareeqon se. Pas jin logon ko aql ka hissa diya gaya hai, woh Allah ki qudrat-o-azmat ko in cheezon aur in na'maton se bhi pehchan sakte hain. Darasal jauhar-e-insaniyat aql hi hai. Isi ki nigahbani ke liye Shariat-e-Mutahira ne nashe wali sharaben is ummat par haram kar din. Isi na'mat ka bayan Surah Yaseen ki ayat (Wa ja'alnā fīhā jannātin min nakhīlin wa a'nābin wa fajjarnā fīhā minal-uyoon) (36. Yaseen: 34) mein hai, yaani zameen mein hum ne khajooron aur angooron ke bagh laga diye aur un mein pani ke chashme baha diye taake log is ka phal khayen, yeh un ke apne banaye hue nahi. Kya phir bhi yeh shukr guzari nahi karenge? Woh zat-e-pak hai jis ne zameen ki pedawar mein aur khud insanon mein aur us makhlooq mein jise yeh jante hi nahi, har tarah ki jor jor cheezein paida kar di hain.

Shahad ki makkhiyon ko Allah ki janib se yeh baat samjhai gayi ke woh paharon mein, darakhton mein aur chaton mein shahad ke chatte banaye. Is zaif makhlooq ke is ghar ko dekhiye kitna mazboot kaisa khoobsurat aur kaisi kari-gari ka hota hai. Phir ise hidayat ki aur iske liye muqarrar kar diya ke yeh phalon, phoolon aur ghas-paat ke ras chosti phire aur jahan chahe jaye, aaye lekin wapas lautte waqt seedhi apne chatte ko pahunch jaye. Chahe buland pahar ki choti ho, chahe biyaban ke darakht hon, chahe abadi ke buland makanat aur veerane ke sunsan khandahar hon, yeh na rasta bhoole, na bhatakti phire, khwah kitni hi door nikal jaye. Laut kar apne chatte mein apne bachhon, andon aur shahad mein pahunch jaye. Apne paron se mom banaye. Apne munh se shahad jama kare aur doosri jagah se bache.

Zulala ki tafsir itaat-guzar aur maskhar se bhi ki gayi hai, pas yeh haal hoga salika ka jaise Quran mein ayat (وَذَلَّــلْنٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوْبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَاْكُلُوْنَ) (Surah Yaseen: 72) mein bhi yahi maani murad hai. Iski ek daleel yeh bhi hai ke log shahad ke chatte ko ek shehar se doosre shehar tak le jate hain. Lekin pehla qaul bahut zyada zahir hai yaani yeh iske tareeq ka haal hai. Ibn Jarir donon qaul sahih batlate hain.

Abu Ya'la Mosuli mein hai Rasulullah ﷺ farmate hain makkhi ki umar chalis din ki hoti hai siwaye shahad ki makkhi ke. Kayi makkhiyan aag mein bhi hoti hain. Shahad ke rang mukhtalif hote hain safed, zard, surkh waghaira jaise phal phool aur jaisi zameen. Is zahiri khoobi aur rang ki chamak ke sath is mein shifa bhi hai, bahut si bimariyon ko Allah Ta'ala is se door kar deta hai. Yahan "fihi shifa-ul-linas" nahi farmaya warna har bimari ki dawa yahi thehirti, balke farmaya is mein shifa hai logon ke liye, pas yeh sard bimariyon ki dawa hai. Ilaaj hamesha bimariyon ke khilaf hota hai, pas shahad garm hai sardi ki bimari mein mufeed hai.

Mujahid aur Ibn Jarir se manqool hai ke is se murad Quran hai yaani Quran mein shifa hai. Yeh qaul go apne taur par sahih hai aur waqai Quran shifa hai lekin is ayat mein yeh murad lena siyaq ke mutabiq nahi. Is mein to shahad ka zikr hai, isi liye Mujahid ke is qaul ki iqtida nahi ki gayi. Haan Quran ke shifa hone ka zikr ayat (وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ الْقُرْاٰنِ مَا هُوَ شِفَاۗءٌ) (Surah Al-Isra: 82) mein hai aur ayat (وَشِفَاۗءٌ لِّمَا فِي الصُّدُوْرِ وَهُدًى وَّرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ) (Surah Yunus: 57) mein hai. Is ayat mein to murad shahad hai, chunancha Bukhari Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke kisi ne aa kar Rasulullah ﷺ ki khidmat mein arz kiya ke mere bhai ko dast aa rahe hain. Aap ne farmaya ise shahad pilao, woh gaya, shahad diya, phir aaya aur kaha Huzoor ﷺ ise to bimari aur barh gayi. Aap ne farmaya ja aur shahad pilao.

Us ne ja kar phir pilaya, phir hazir ho kar yehi arz kiya ke dast aur barh gaye aap ne farmaya Allah sacha hai aur tere bhai ka pait jhoota hai, ja phir shehd de. Teesri martaba shehd se ba-fazl-e-Ilahi shifa hasil ho gayi. Baaz atibba ne kaha hai mumkin hai ke uske pait mein fazle ki ziyadti ho, shehd ne apni garmi ki wajah se uski tehleil kar di. Fazla kharij hona shuru hua. Dast barh gaye. A'arabi ne use marz ka barh jana samjha. Huzoor ﷺ se shikayat ki. Aap ﷺ ne aur shehd dene ko farmaya is se zor se fazla kharij hona shuru hua phir shehd diya, pait saaf ho gaya, bala nikal gayi aur kamil shifa ba-fazl-e-Ilahi hasil ho gayi aur Huzoor ﷺ ki baat jo ba-isharat-e-Ilahi poori ho gayi. Bukhari aur Muslim ki aik aur hadith mein hai ke Sarwar-e-Rusul ﷺ ko mithaas aur shehd se bohat ulfat thi. Aap ka farman hai ke teen cheezon mein shifa hai, pachhne lagane mein, shehd ke peene mein aur dagh lagwane mein lekin main apni ummat ko dagh lagwane se rokta hoon. Bukhari Sharif ki hadith mein hai ke tumhari dawaon mein se kisi mein agar shifa hai to pachhne lagane mein, shehd ke peene mein aur aag se daghwane mein jo beemari ke munasib ho lekin main ise pasand nahi karta. Muslim ki hadith mein hai main ise pasand nahi karta balki na-pasand rakhta hoon. Ibn Majah mein hai tum in dono shfaon ki qadar karte raho shehd aur Quran. Ibn Jareer mein Hazrat Ali ؓ ka farman hai ke jab tum mein se koi shifa chahe to Quran Kareem ki kisi aayat ko kisi sahife par likh le aur use barish ke pani se dho le aur apni biwi ke maal se uski apni razamandi se paise le kar shehd khareed le aur use pee le pas is mein kayi wajah se shifa aa jayegi Allah Ta'ala Azza wa Jalla ka farman hai aayat (Wa nunazzilu minal-Qur'ani ma huwa shifa'un wa rahmatun lil-mu'minina wa la yaziduz-zalimina illa khasara) (17. Al-Isra: 82) yani hum ne Quran mein woh nazil farmaya hai jo momineen ke liye shifa hai aur rehmat hai aur aayat mein hai aayat (Wa nazzalna minas-sama'i ma'an mubarakan fa anbatna bihi jannatin wa habbal-hasid) (50. Qaf: 9) hum aasman se babarkat pani barsate hain. Aur farman hai aayat (Wa atun-nisa'a sadaqatihin nihlaten fa in tibna lakum 'an shai'in minhu nafsa fa kuluha hani'an mari'an) (4. An-Nisa: 4) yani agar auratein apne maal-e-mahar mein se apni khushi se tumhe kuch de dein to beshak tum ise khao piyo sehta-pachta. Shehd ke bare mein farman-e-Ilahi hai fihi shifa'un lin-nas shehd mein logon ke liye shifa hai. Ibn Majah mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain jo shakhs har mahine mein teen din subh ko shehd chaat le use koi bari bala nahi pohnchegi. Is ka aik rawi Zubair bin Saeed matrook hai. Ibn Majah ki aur hadith mein aap ka farman hai ke tum sana aur sanoot ka istemal kiya karo in mein har beemari ki shifa hai siwaye saam ke. Logon ne poocha saam kya? Farmaya maut.

Sanut ke maana sabit ke hain aur logon ne kaha hai sanut shehd hai jo ghee ki mashk mein rakha hua ho. Shair ke shair mein yeh lafz is maana mein aaya hai phir farmata hai ke makhi jaisi betaqat cheez ka tumhare liye shehd aur mom banana uska is tarah aazadi se phirna apne ghar ko na bhoolna waghera yeh sab cheezein ghor-o-fikr karne walon ke liye meri azmat, khaliqiyat aur malikiyat ki badi nishaniyan hain.
