Is ayat mein to murad shahad hai, chunancha Bukhari Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke kisi ne aa kar Rasulullah ﷺ ki khidmat mein arz kiya ke mere bhai ko dast aa rahe hain. Aap ne farmaya ise shahad pilao, woh gaya, shahad diya, phir aaya aur kaha Huzoor ﷺ ise to bimari aur barh gayi. Aap ne farmaya ja aur shahad pilao.

Us ne ja kar phir pilaya, phir hazir ho kar yehi arz kiya ke dast aur barh gaye aap ne farmaya Allah sacha hai aur tere bhai ka pait jhoota hai, ja phir shehd de. Teesri martaba shehd se ba-fazl-e-Ilahi shifa hasil ho gayi. Baaz atibba ne kaha hai mumkin hai ke uske pait mein fazle ki ziyadti ho, shehd ne apni garmi ki wajah se uski tehleil kar di. Fazla kharij hona shuru hua. Dast barh gaye. A'arabi ne use marz ka barh jana samjha. Huzoor ﷺ se shikayat ki. Aap ﷺ ne aur shehd dene ko farmaya is se zor se fazla kharij hona shuru hua phir shehd diya, pait saaf ho gaya, bala nikal gayi aur kamil shifa ba-fazl-e-Ilahi hasil ho gayi aur Huzoor ﷺ ki baat jo ba-isharat-e-Ilahi poori ho gayi. Bukhari aur Muslim ki aik aur hadith mein hai ke Sarwar-e-Rusul ﷺ ko mithaas aur shehd se bohat ulfat thi. Aap ka farman hai ke teen cheezon mein shifa hai, pachhne lagane mein, shehd ke peene mein aur dagh lagwane mein lekin main apni ummat ko dagh lagwane se rokta hoon. Bukhari Sharif ki hadith mein hai ke tumhari dawaon mein se kisi mein agar shifa hai to pachhne lagane mein, shehd ke peene mein aur aag se daghwane mein jo beemari ke munasib ho lekin main ise pasand nahi karta. Muslim ki hadith mein hai main ise pasand nahi karta balki na-pasand rakhta hoon. Ibn Majah mein hai tum in dono shfaon ki qadar karte raho shehd aur Quran. Ibn Jareer mein Hazrat Ali ؓ ka farman hai ke jab tum mein se koi shifa chahe to Quran Kareem ki kisi aayat ko kisi sahife par likh le aur use barish ke pani se dho le aur apni biwi ke maal se uski apni razamandi se paise le kar shehd khareed le aur use pee le pas is mein kayi wajah se shifa aa jayegi Allah Ta'ala Azza wa Jalla ka farman hai aayat (Wa nunazzilu minal-Qur'ani ma huwa shifa'un wa rahmatun lil-mu'minina wa la yaziduz-zalimina illa khasara) (17. Al-Isra: 82) yani hum ne Quran mein woh nazil farmaya hai jo momineen ke liye shifa hai aur rehmat hai aur aayat mein hai aayat (Wa nazzalna minas-sama'i ma'an mubarakan fa anbatna bihi jannatin wa habbal-hasid) (50. Qaf: 9) hum aasman se babarkat pani barsate hain. Aur farman hai aayat (Wa atun-nisa'a sadaqatihin nihlaten fa in tibna lakum 'an shai'in minhu nafsa fa kuluha hani'an mari'an) (4. An-Nisa: 4) yani agar auratein apne maal-e-mahar mein se apni khushi se tumhe kuch de dein to beshak tum ise khao piyo sehta-pachta. Shehd ke bare mein farman-e-Ilahi hai fihi shifa'un lin-nas shehd mein logon ke liye shifa hai. Ibn Majah mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain jo shakhs har mahine mein teen din subh ko shehd chaat le use koi bari bala nahi pohnchegi. Is ka aik rawi Zubair bin Saeed matrook hai. Ibn Majah ki aur hadith mein aap ka farman hai ke tum sana aur sanoot ka istemal kiya karo in mein har beemari ki shifa hai siwaye saam ke. Logon ne poocha saam kya? Farmaya maut.

Sanut ke maana sabit ke hain aur logon ne kaha hai sanut shehd hai jo ghee ki mashk mein rakha hua ho. Shair ke shair mein yeh lafz is maana mein aaya hai phir farmata hai ke makhi jaisi betaqat cheez ka tumhare liye shehd aur mom banana uska is tarah aazadi se phirna apne ghar ko na bhoolna waghera yeh sab cheezein ghor-o-fikr karne walon ke liye meri azmat, khaliqiyat aur malikiyat ki badi nishaniyan hain. Isi se log apne Allah ke Qadir, Hakim, Alim, Karim, Rahim hone par daleel hasil kar sakte hain.

Behtareen Dua

Tamaam bandon par qabza Allah Ta'ala ka hai, wahi unhein adam se wujud mein laya hai, wahi unhein phir faut karega. Baaz logon ko bohat bari umar tak pohanchata hai ke woh phir se bachon jaise natawan ban jaate hain. Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain pachattar saal ki umar mein umoman insan aisa hi hojata hai, taqat khatam hojati hai, hafiza jaata rehta hai. Ilm ki kami hojati hai, aalim hone ke baad be-ilm hojata hai. 

Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apni dua mein farmate thay: 
(Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-bukhli wal-kasali wal-harami wa ardhali-l-'umuri wa 'adhabil-qabri wa fitnatid-dajjali wa fitnatil-mahya wal-mamat) 
Yaani: "Aya Allah! Main بخیلی (bakhili) se, aajzi se, barhapa se, zaleel umar se, qabr ke azab se, Dajjal ke fitne se, zindagi aur maut ke fitne se Teri panah talab karta hoon." 

Zuhair bin Abu Salma ne bhi apne mashhoor qasida-e-mu'allaqa mein is umar ko ranj-o-gham ka makhzan aur manba bataya hai.

Mushrikeen ki Jahalat ka Aik Andaaz: Mushrikeen ki jahalat aur unke kufr ka bayaan ho raha hai ke apne ma'boodon ko Allah ke ghulam janne ke bawajood unki ibadat mein lage hue hain. Chunacha Hajj ke mauqe par woh kaha karte the dua: (Labbayka la sharika laka illa sharikan huwa laka tamlukuha wa ma malak - yani, "Aye Allah! Main tere paas hazir hoon, tera koi sharik nahi magar woh jo khud tere ghulam hain, unka aur unki mathat cheezon ka asli malik tu hi hai"). Phir Allah Ta'ala unhe ilzam deta hai ke jab tum apne ghulamon ki apni barabari aur apne maal mein shirkat pasand nahi karte toh phir mere ghulamon ko meri uluhiyat mein kaise sharik tehra rahe ho? Yahi mazmoon ayat (Daraba lakum masalan min anfusikum) (Surah Ar-Room: 28) mein bayaan hua hai ke jab tum apne ghulamon ko apne maal mein, apni biwiyon mein apna sharik banane se nafrat karte ho toh phir mere ghulamon ko meri uluhiyat mein kaise sharik samajh rahe ho? Yahi Allah ki nematon se inkar hai ke Allah ke liye woh pasand karna, jo apne liye bhi pasand na ho. Yeh hai misaal ma'boodan-e-batil ki. Jab tum khud is se alag ho phir Allah toh is se bahut zyada bezar hai. Rabb ki nematon ka kufr aur kya hoga ke khetiyan, chaupaye aik Allah ke paida kiye hue hain aur tum unhe uske siva auron ke naam se mansoob karo. 

Hadrat Umar bin Khattab R.A ne Hadrat Abu Musa Ash'ari R.A ko aik risala likha ke apni rozi par qanaat ikhtiyar karo, Allah Ta'ala ne aik se zyada ameer kar rakha hai, yeh bhi uski taraf se aik aazmaish hai ke woh dekhe ke ameer-ul-umara kis tarah shukr-e-Ilahi ada karte hain aur jo huquq doosron ke un par Janab-e-Bari ne muqarrar kiye hain, kahan tak unhe ada karte hain.

Bandon Par Allah Ta'ala Ka Ehsan

Apne bandon par apna ek aur ehsan jatata hai ke unhi ki jins se unhi ki ham-shakal, ham-wazaq aurtein hum ne un ke liye paida keen. Agar jins aur hoti to dili mel-jool, mohabbat-o-mawaddat qaim na rehti lekin apni rehmat se us ne mard-aurat ham-jins banaye. Phir us jore se nasl barhai, aulaad phailai, larke hue, larkon ke larke hue, hafdah ke ek ma’ni to yahi poton ke hain, doosre ma’ni khadim aur madadgar ke hain, pas larke aur pote bhi ek tarah khidmat-guzar hote hain aur arab mein yahi dastoor bhi tha. 

Ibn Abbas (R.A) kehte hain insan ki biwi ke sabiqah ghar ki aulaad us ki nahi hoti. Hafdah us shakhs ko bhi kehte hain jo kisi ke samne us ke liye kaam-kaaj kare. Yeh ma’ni bhi kiye gaye hain ke is se murad damadi rishta hai, is ke ma’ni ke tahet mein yeh sab dakhil hain, chunacha qunoot mein jumla aata hai "Walika nas’aa wa nahfid" hamari sa'i, koshish aur khidmat tere liye hi hai aur yeh zahir hai ke aulaad se, ghulam se, sasraal walon se khidmat hasil hoti hai, in sab ke paas se ne'mat-e-ilahi humein milti hai. 

Haan jin ke nazdeek "wa hafdah" ka taalluq azwajan se hai, un ke nazdeek to murad aulaad aur aulaad ki aulaad aur damad aur biwi ki aulaad hain. Pas yeh sab basa-auqat usi shakhs ki hifazat mein, us ki god mein aur us ki khidmat mein hote hain aur mumkin hai ke yahi matlab samne rakh kar An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ho ke aulaad teri ghulam hai. Jaise ke Abu Dawood mein hai aur jinhon ne hafdah se murad khadim liya hai, un ke nazdeek yeh matoof hai Allah ke farman ayat: 

(وَاللّٰهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِّنْ اَنْفُسِكُمْ اَزْوَاجًا وَّجَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِّنْ اَزْوَاجِكُمْ بَنِيْنَ وَحَفَدَةً وَّرَزَقَكُمْ مِّنَ الطَّيِّبٰتِ) (16۔ النحل :72) 

Par, yaani Allah Ta'ala ne tumhari biwiyon aur aulaad ko khadim bana diya hai aur tumhein khane peene ki behtareen zaiqedar cheezein inayat farmai hain. Pas baatil par yaqeen rakh kar Allah ki ne'mon ki nashukri na karni chahiye. Rabb ki ne'moton par parda daal diya aur un ki doosron ki taraf nisbat kar di. 

Sahih hadith mein hai ke qiyamat ke din Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala apne bandon par apne ehsan jatate hue farmayega: Kya main ne tujhe biwi nahi di thi? Main ne tujhe zi-izzat nahi banaya tha? Main ne ghoron aur onton ko tere tabe nahi kiya tha aur main ne tujhe sardari mein aur aaram mein nahi chora tha?

Tauhid ki Takeed: Nematain dene wala, paida karne wala, rozi pohchane wala, sirf Allah Ta'ala akela Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu hai. Aur yeh mushrikeen uske sath auron ko poojte hain jo na asman se barish barsa saken, na zameen se khet aur darakht uga saken. Woh agar sab mil kar bhi chahein toh bhi na ek boond barish barsane par qadir, na ek patte ke paida karne mein un mein sakat. Pas tum Allah ke liye misalein na bayan karo. Uske shareek-o-saheem aur us jaisa doosron ko na samjho. Allah 'Alim hai aur woh apne ilm ki bina par apni tauhid par gawahi deta hai. Tum jahil ho, apni jahalat se doosron ko Allah ke shareek thehra rahe ho.

Tum jahil ho, apni jahalat se doosron ko Allah ke shareek thehra rahe ho.

Momin aur Kafir Mein Farq: Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) wagaira farmate hain yeh kafir aur momin ki misal hai. Pas malkiyat ke ghulam se murad kafir aur achhi rozi wale aur kharch karne wale se murad momin hai. Mujahid farmate hain is misal se but ki aur Allah Ta'ala ki judai samjhana maqsood hai ki yeh aur woh barabar ke nahi. Is misal ka farq is qadar wazeh hai jis ke batane ki zaroorat nahi, ishi liye farmata hai ki tareefon ke layak Allah hi hai. Aksar mushrik be-ilmi par tule hue hain.

Gonge but mushrikeen ke ma'bood ho sakta hai ke yeh misal bhi us farq ke dikhane ki ho jo Allah Ta'ala mein aur mushrikeen ke buton mein hai. Yeh but gonge hain na kalam kar saken na koi bhali baat keh saken, na kisi cheez par qudrat rakhein. Qaul-o-fiL dono se khali. Phir mahz bojh, apne malik par baar, kahin bhi jaye koi bhalai na laye. Pas ek barabar ho jayenge? 

Ek qaul hai ke ek gonga Hazrat Usman R.A ka ghulam tha. Aur ho sakta hai ke yeh misal bhi kafir-o-momin ki ho jaise is se pehle ki ayat mein thi. Kehte hain ke Quraysh ke ek shakhs ke ghulam ka zikr pehle hai aur dusre shakhs se murad Hazrat Usman bin Affan R.A hain. Aur ghulam gonge se murad Hazrat Usman R.A ka woh ghulam hai jis par aap kharch karte the jo aap ko takleef pohanchata rehta tha aur aap ne use kaam-kaaj se azad kar rakha tha lekin phir bhi yeh Islam se chirta tha, munkir tha aur aap ko sadqa karne aur nekiyan karne se rokta tha, un ke bare mein yeh ayat nazil hui hai.

Allah Ta'ala apne kamal-e-ilm aur kamal-e-qudrat ko bayan farma raha hai ke zamin aasman ka ghaib wahi janta hai, koi nahi jo ghaib dan ho Allah jise chahe, jis cheez par chahe, ittela de de. Har cheez uski qudrat mein hai na koi iska khilaf kar sake. Na koi ise rok sake jis kaam ka jab irada kare, qadir hai poora ho kar hi rehta hai aankh band kar ke kholne mein to tumhe kuch dair lagti hogi lekin hukm-e-ilahi ke poora hone mein itni dair bhi nahi lagti. Qayamat ka aana bhi us par aisa hi aasan hai, woh bhi hukm hote hi aa jayegi. Ek ka paida karna aur sab ka paida karna us par yaksan hai. Allah ka ehsan dekho ke us ne logon ko maon ke peton se nikala yeh mahz nadan the phir unhein kaan diye jis se woh sunein, aankhein dein jis se dekhein, dil diye jis se sochein aur samjhein. Aql ki jagah dil hai aur dimagh bhi kaha gaya hai. Aql se hi nafa nuqsan maloom hota hai yeh quwa aur hawas insan ko badar-tarij thode thode ho kar milte hain umr ke sath sath uski barhotri bhi hoti rehti hai. Yahan tak ke kamal ko pahunch jayein. Yeh sab is liye hai ke insan apni in taqaton ko Allah ki marifat aur ibadat mein lagaye rahe. Sahih Bukhari mein Hadith-e-Qudsi hai ke jo mere doston se dushmani karta hai woh mujh se lrai ka elan karta hai. Mere faraiz ki baja aawari se jis qadar banda meri qurbat hasil kar sakta hai itni kisi aur cheez se nahi kar sakta. Nawafil bakasrat padhte padhte banda mere nazdeek aur mera mehboob ho jata hai. Jab main us se mohabbat karne lagta hoon to main hi us ke kaan ban jata hoon, jin se woh sunta hai aur uski nigah ban jata hoon jis se woh dekhta hai aur uske hath ban jata hoon jin se woh thamta hai aur uske pair ban jata hoon jin se woh chalta hai. Woh agar mujh se mange main deta hoon, agar dua kare main qabool karta hoon, agar panah chahe main panah deta hoon aur mujhe kisi kaam ke karne mein itna taraddud nahi hota jitna momin ki rooh ke qabz karne mein maut ko naپسand karta hai. Main use naraz karna nahi chahta aur maut aisi cheez hi nahi jis se kisi zi-rooh ko nijat mil sake. Is hadith ka matlab yeh hai ke jab momin ikhlas aur itaat mein kamil ho jata hai to uske tamam afaal mahz Allah ke liye ho jate hain woh sunta hai Allah ke liye, dekhta hai Allah ke liye, yaani shariat ki baatein sunta hai, shariat ne jin cheezon ka dekhna jaiz kiya hai, unhi ko dekhta hai, usi tarah uska hath badhana, paon chalana bhi Allah ki raza-mandi ke kaamon ke liye hi hota hai. Allah par uska bharosa rehta hai usi se madad chahta hai, tamam kaam iske Allah Ta'ala ke raza-joi ke hi hote hain. Is liye baaz ghair sahih ahadith mein is ke baad yeh bhi aaya hai ke phir woh mere hi liye sunta hai aur mere hi liye dekhta hai aur mere liye pakadta hai aur mere liye hi chalta phirta hai.

Aayat mein bayaan hai ke maa ke pait se woh nikalta hai, kaan, aankh, dil, dimaag woh deta hai taake tum shukr ada karo aur aayat mein farman hai: (Qul Huwal-lazii ansha-akum wa ja'ala lakumus-sam'a wal-absara wal-af-idah, qalilan ma tashkurun) (67. Al-Mulk: 23) yaani Allah hi ne tumhein paida kiya hai aur tumhare liye kaan aur aankhein aur dil banaye hain lekin tum bahut hi kam shukr-guzaari karte ho, usi ne tumhein zameen mein phaila diya hai aur usi ki taraf tumhara hashar kiya jaane wala hai. Phir Allah Pak Rabbul-Alamin apne bando se farmata hai ke un parindo ki taraf dekho jo aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan ki fiza mein parwaaz karte phirte hain, unhein Parvardigar hi apni qudrat-e-kaamila se thame hue hain. Yeh quwwat-e-parwaaz usi ne unhein de rakhi hai aur hawaon ko unka mutee bana rakha hai. Surah Mulk mein bhi yehi farman hai ke kya woh apne saron par udte hue parindo ko nahi dekhte? Jo par khole hue hain aur par samete hue bhi hain unhein bajuz Allah Rahman-o-Rahim ke kaun thamta hai? Woh Allah tamaam makhlooq ko ba-khoobi dekh raha hai, yahan bhi khatame par farmaya ke is mein imandaaron ke liye bahut se nishaan hain.

Allah Ta'ala apne kamal-e-ilm aur kamal-e-qudrat ko bayan farma raha hai ke zamin aasman ka ghaib wahi janta hai, koi nahi jo ghaib dan ho Allah jise chahe, jis cheez par chahe, ittela de de. Har cheez uski qudrat mein hai na koi iska khilaf kar sake. Na koi ise rok sake jis kaam ka jab irada kare, qadir hai poora ho kar hi rehta hai aankh band kar ke kholne mein to tumhe kuch dair lagti hogi lekin hukm-e-ilahi ke poora hone mein itni dair bhi nahi lagti. Qayamat ka aana bhi us par aisa hi aasan hai, woh bhi hukm hote hi aa jayegi. Ek ka paida karna aur sab ka paida karna us par yaksan hai. Allah ka ehsan dekho ke us ne logon ko maon ke peton se nikala yeh mahz nadan the phir unhein kaan diye jis se woh sunein, aankhein dein jis se dekhein, dil diye jis se sochein aur samjhein. Aql ki jagah dil hai aur dimagh bhi kaha gaya hai. Aql se hi nafa nuqsan maloom hota hai yeh quwa aur hawas insan ko badar-tarij thode thode ho kar milte hain umr ke sath sath uski barhotri bhi hoti rehti hai. Yahan tak ke kamal ko pahunch jayein. Yeh sab is liye hai ke insan apni in taqaton ko Allah ki marifat aur ibadat mein lagaye rahe. Sahih Bukhari mein Hadith-e-Qudsi hai ke jo mere doston se dushmani karta hai woh mujh se lrai ka elan karta hai. Mere faraiz ki baja aawari se jis qadar banda meri qurbat hasil kar sakta hai itni kisi aur cheez se nahi kar sakta. Nawafil bakasrat padhte padhte banda mere nazdeek aur mera mehboob ho jata hai. Jab main us se mohabbat karne lagta hoon to main hi us ke kaan ban jata hoon, jin se woh sunta hai aur uski nigah ban jata hoon jis se woh dekhta hai aur uske hath ban jata hoon jin se woh thamta hai aur uske pair ban jata hoon jin se woh chalta hai. Woh agar mujh se mange main deta hoon, agar dua kare main qabool karta hoon, agar panah chahe main panah deta hoon aur mujhe kisi kaam ke karne mein itna taraddud nahi hota jitna momin ki rooh ke qabz karne mein maut ko naپسand karta hai. Main use naraz karna nahi chahta aur maut aisi cheez hi nahi jis se kisi zi-rooh ko nijat mil sake. Is hadith ka matlab yeh hai ke jab momin ikhlas aur itaat mein kamil ho jata hai to uske tamam afaal mahz Allah ke liye ho jate hain woh sunta hai Allah ke liye, dekhta hai Allah ke liye, yaani shariat ki baatein sunta hai, shariat ne jin cheezon ka dekhna jaiz kiya hai, unhi ko dekhta hai, usi tarah uska hath badhana, paon chalana bhi Allah ki raza-mandi ke kaamon ke liye hi hota hai. Allah par uska bharosa rehta hai usi se madad chahta hai, tamam kaam iske Allah Ta'ala ke raza-joi ke hi hote hain. Is liye baaz ghair sahih ahadith mein is ke baad yeh bhi aaya hai ke phir woh mere hi liye sunta hai aur mere hi liye dekhta hai aur mere liye pakadta hai aur mere liye hi chalta phirta hai.

Aayat mein bayaan hai ke maa ke pait se woh nikalta hai, kaan, aankh, dil, dimaag woh deta hai taake tum shukr ada karo aur aayat mein farman hai: (Qul Huwal-lazii ansha-akum wa ja'ala lakumus-sam'a wal-absara wal-af-idah, qalilan ma tashkurun) (67. Al-Mulk: 23) yaani Allah hi ne tumhein paida kiya hai aur tumhare liye kaan aur aankhein aur dil banaye hain lekin tum bahut hi kam shukr-guzaari karte ho, usi ne tumhein zameen mein phaila diya hai aur usi ki taraf tumhara hashar kiya jaane wala hai. Phir Allah Pak Rabbul-Alamin apne bando se farmata hai ke un parindo ki taraf dekho jo aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan ki fiza mein parwaaz karte phirte hain, unhein Parvardigar hi apni qudrat-e-kaamila se thame hue hain. Yeh quwwat-e-parwaaz usi ne unhein de rakhi hai aur hawaon ko unka mutee bana rakha hai. Surah Mulk mein bhi yehi farman hai ke kya woh apne saron par udte hue parindo ko nahi dekhte? Jo par khole hue hain aur par samete hue bhi hain unhein bajuz Allah Rahman-o-Rahim ke kaun thamta hai? Woh Allah tamaam makhlooq ko ba-khoobi dekh raha hai, yahan bhi khatame par farmaya ke is mein imandaaron ke liye bahut se nishaan hain.

Ahsanat-e-Ilahi ki Ek Jhalak
Qadeem aur bohat bare an-ginit ahsanat wa inamat wala Allah apni aur naqmatein zahir farma raha hai. Isi ne Bani Adam ke rehne sehne aaram aur rahat hasil karne ke liye unhein makanat de rakhe hain. Isi tarah chaupaye, janwaron ki khalon ke khaimay, dere, tambu us ne ata farma rakhe hain ke safar mein kaam aayein, na le jana dushwar, na lagana mushkil, na akherne mein koi takleef. Phir bakriyon ke baal, oonton ke baal, bheron aur dumbon ki oon, tijarat ke taur par ise tumhare liye banaya hai. Woh ghar ke bartne ki cheez bhi hai us se kapre bhi bante hain, farsh bhi tayar hote hain, tijarat ke taur par maal-e-tijarat hai. Faide ki cheez hai jis se log muqarrara waqt tak sood-mand hote hain. Darakhton ke saye us ne tumhare faide aur rahat ke liye banaye hain. Paharon par ghar, qile waghera us ne tumhe de rakhe hain ke un mein panah hasil karo. Chupne aur rehne sehne ki jagah bana lo. Sooti, oonni aur baalon ke kapre us ne tumhe de rakhe hain ke pehn kar sardi garmi ke bachao ke sath hi apna satr chhupao aur zeb-o-zeenat hasil karo aur us ne tumhe zarhein, khud baktar ata farmai hain jo dushmanon ke hamle aur larai ke waqt tumhein kaam dein. Isi tarah woh tumhe tumhari zarurat ki poori poori naqmatein diye jata hai ke tum rahat-o-aram pao aur itminan se apne munim-e-haqiqi ki ibadat mein lage raho.
Taslimoon ki doosri qirat taslamoon bhi hai. Yani tum salamat raho. Aur pehli qirat ke ma'ani taake tum farmanbardar ban jao. Is soorah ka naam Soorah An-Na'am bhi hai. Lam ke zabar wali qirat se yeh bhi murad hai ke tum ko us ne larai mein kaam aane wali cheezein din ke tum salamat raho, dushman ke war se bacho.
Be-shak jangal aur biyaban bhi Allah ki bari naqmat hain lekin yahan paharon ki naqmat is liye bayan ki ke jin se kalam hai woh paharon ke rehne wale the to un ki malumat ke mutabiq un se kalam ho raha hai isi tarah chunke woh bher bakriyon aur oonton wale the unhein yehi naqmatein yaad dilayen halanke un se barh kar Allah ki naqmatein makhlooq ke hathon mein aur bhi beshumar hain aur yehi wajah hai ke sardi ke utaarne ka ehsan bayan farmaya halanke is se aur bare ahsanat maujood hain. Lekin yeh un ke samne aur un ki jani pehchani cheez thi. Isi tarah chunke yeh larne bharne wale jangju log the, larai ke bachao ki cheez bataur naqmat un ke samne rakhi halanke is se sadha darje bari aur naqmatein bhi makhlooq ke hath mein maujood hain. Isi tarah chunke un ka mulk garam tha farmaya ke libas se tum garmi ki takleef zail karte ho warna kya is se behtar us munim-e-haqiqi ki aur naqmatein bandon ke paas nahi? Isi liye in naqmaton aur rahmaton ke izhar ke baad hi farmata hai ke agar ab bhi yeh log meri ibadat aur tauhid ke aur mere be-payan ahsanon ke qayil na hon to tujhe in ki aisi pari hai? Chhor de apne kaam mein lag ja tujh par to sirf tabligh hi hai woh kiye ja.

Yeh khud jaante hain ke Allah Ta'ala hi nematon ka dene wala hai aur us ki beshumar nematein un ke hathon mein hain lekin bawajood ilm ke munkir ho rahe hain aur us ke sath dusron ki ibadat karte hain balke us ki nematon ko dusron ki taraf mansoub karte hain samajhte hain ke madadgar falan hai rizq dene wala falan hai, yeh aksar log kafir hain, Allah ke nashukre hain. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke ek A'rabi Rasulullah ﷺ ke pas aya, ap ne is ayat ki tilawat ki us ne tumhen chopayon ki khalon ke kheme diye us ne kaha yeh bhi sach hai, usi tarah ap in ayaton ko padhte gaye aur woh har ek nemat ka ikrar karta raha akhir mein ap ne padha is liye ke tum musalman aur muti' ho jao us waqt woh peeth pher kar chal diya. To Allah Ta'ala ne akhri ayat utari ke ikrar ke bad inkar kar ke kafir ho jate hain.

Har ummat ka gawah uska nabi - Qiyamat ke din mushrikon ki jo buri halat banegi us ka zikr ho raha hai ke us din har ummat par uska nabi gawahi dega ke us ne Allah ka paigham unhein pohncha diya tha, kafiron ko kisi uzr ki bhi ijazat na milegi kyunke unka batlan aur jhoot bilkul zahir hai. Surah Al-Mursalat mein bhi yahi farman hai ke us din na woh bolenge, na unhein kisi uzr ki ijazat milegi. Mushrikeen azab dekhenge lekin phir koi kami na hogi, ek saat bhi azab halka na hoga, na unhein koi mohlat milegi, achanak pakad liye jayenge. Jahannam amujood hogi jo sattar hazar lagamon wali hogi. Jis ki ek lagam par sattar hazar farishte honge. Us mein se ek gardan niklegi jo is tarah phan phailayegi ke tamam ahl-e-mahshar khauf-zada ho kar bal-e-gir parenge. Us waqt jahannam apni zaban se ba-awaz-e-buland ailan karegi ke main is har ek sarkash ziddi ke liye muqarrar ki gayi hoon. Jis ne Allah ke sath kisi aur ko sharik kiya ho aur aise aise kaam kiye hon, chunacha woh kayi qism ke gunehgaron ka zikr karegi. Jaise ke hadith mein hai phir woh un tamam logon ko lipat jayegi aur maidan-e-mahshar mein se unhein lapak legi jaise ke parinda dana chugta hai. Jaise ke farman-e-bari hai ayat (Iza ra-aitum) al-kh jab ke woh door se dikhayi degi toh uska shor-o-ghal, kadakna, bhadakna yeh sunne lagenge aur jab us ke tang-o-tarik makanon mein jhonk diye jayen toh maut ko pukarenge. Aaj ek chhod kayi ek mauton ko bhi pukarenge toh kya ho sakta hai? Aur ayat mein hai (Wa ra-al-mujrimu-nannara fazannu annahum muwaqi-uha wa lam yajidu anha masrifan) (18. Al-Kahf: 53) Gunehgar jahannam ko dekh kar samajh lenge ke woh us mein jhonk diye jayenge lekin koi bachao na payenge. Aur ayat mein hai (Lau ya'lamul-lazina kafaru) Kash ke kafir us waqt ko jaan lete jab ke woh apne chehron par se aur apni kamron par se jahannam ki aag ko door na kar sakenge, na kisi ko madadgar payenge, achanak azab-e-ilahi unhein haka-baka kar denge, na unhein unke dafa karne ki taqat hogi, na ek minute ki mohlat milegi. Us waqt unke ma'budan-e-batil jin ki umr bhar ibadatein aur nazrein niyazein karte rahe un se bilkul be-niyaz ho jayenge aur un ki ehtiyaj ke waqt unhein mutlaqan kaam na aayenge. Unhein dekh kar yeh kahenge ke اے اللہ (Aey Allah) yeh hain jinhein hum duniya mein pujte rahe toh woh kahenge jhoote ho hum ne kab tum se kaha tha ke Allah chhod kar hamari parastish karo? Isi ko janab-e-bari ne farmaya ayat (Wa man adallu mimman yadu min dunillahi man la yastajibu lahu ila yaumil-qiyamati wa hum an du'aihim ghafilun) (46. Al-Ahqaf: 5) Yani is se zyada koi gumrah nahi jo Allah ke siwa unhein pukarta hai jo use qiyamat tak jawab na dein balki woh un ke pukarne se bhi be-khabar hon aur hasr ke din unke dushman ho jane wale hon aur un ki ibadat ka inkar kar jane wale hon.

Aur aayaton mein hai ki apna hamayati aur bais-e-izzat jaan kar jinhein yeh pukarte rahe woh toh unki ibadaton ke munkar ho jayenge. Aur unke mukhalif ban jayenge. Khalilullah Alaihis Salam ne bhi yahi farmaya ki aayat (Thumma yaumal-qiyamati yakfuru ba'dukum biba'din wa yal'anu ba'dukum ba'dan wa ma'wakumun-naru wa ma lakum min nasirin 25) (29. Al-Ankabut: 25) yaani qiyamat ke din ek dusron ke munkar ho jayenge. Aur aayat mein hai ki unhein qiyamat ke din hukm hoga ki apne shareekon ko pukaro al-kh. Aur bhi is mazmoon ki bahut si aayatein Kalamullah mein maujood hain. Us din sab ke sab musalman tabe-farman ho jayenge jaise farman hai aayat (Asmi' bihim wa absir yauma ya'tunana lakiniz-zalimun al-yauma fi dalalin mubin 38) (19. Maryam: 38) yaani jis din yeh hamare paas aayenge, us din khoob hi sunne wale, dekhne wale ho jayenge. Aur aayat mein hai (Wa lau tara izil-mujrimuna nakisu ru'usihim 'inda rabbihim rabbana absarna wa sami'na farji'na na'mal salihan inna muqinun 12) (32. As-Sajdah: 12) toh dekhega ki us din gunehgar log apne sar jhukaye keh rahe honge ki اے Allah humne dekh sun liya, al-kh. Aur aayat mein hai ki sab chehre us din Allah Hayy-ul-Qayyum ke samne jhuke hue honge, tabe aur muti honge, zer-e-farman honge. Unke sare buhtan-o-iftra jate rahenge. Sari chalakiyan khatam ho jayenge koi nasir-o-madadgar khada na hoga. Jinhone kufr kiya, unhein unke kufr ki saza milegi aur dusron ko bhi haq se door bhagate rehte the darasal woh khud hi halakat ke daldal mein phans rahe the lekin bewaquf the. Isse maloom hota hai ki kafiron ke azab ke bhi darje honge, jis tarah mominon ke jaza ke darje honge jaise farman-e-Ilahi hai aayat (Qala likullin di'fun wa lakin la ta'lamun 38) (7. Al-A'raf: 38) har ek ke liye dohra azab hai lekin tumhein ilm nahi. Abu Yala mein Hazrat Abdullah se marwi hai ki azab-e-jahannam ke sath hi zehrele saanpon ka dasna barh jayega jo itne bare bare honge jitne bare khajoor ke darakht hote hain. Ibn Abbas R.A se marwi hai ki Arsh tale se paanch nahrein aati hain jinse dozakhiyon ko din raat azab hoga.

Kitab-e-Mubin 

Allah Ta'ala apne mohtaram Rasul Allah ﷺ se khatab kar ke farma rahe hain ki is din ko yaad kar aur is din jo teri sharafat-o-karamat hone wali hai us ka bhi zikr kar. Yeh ayat bhi waisi hi hai jaisi Surah An-Nisa ke shuru ki ayat Fa-kaifa iza ji'na min kulli ummatim bi-shahidin wa ji'na bika ‘ala haula'i shahida yaani kyon-kar guzregi jab ki hum har ummat mein se gawah layenge aur in sab par gawah bana kar khada karenge. Huzoor ﷺ ne ek bar Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) se Surah An-Nisa padhwai jab woh is ayat tak pahunche toh Aap ﷺ ne farmaya bas kar kafi hai. Ibn Masood (R.A) ne dekha ki us waqt Aap ﷺ ki aankhein ashkbar thien ﷺ. 

Phir farmata hai apni is utari hui kitab mein tere samne sab kuch bayan farma diya hai har ilm aur har shay is Quran mein hai. Har halal haram, har ek nafi’ ilm, har bhalai, guzishta ki khabrein, ayindah ke waqiyat, deen-o-dunya, maash-o-ma’ad, sab ke zaroori ahkam aur ahwal is mein maujood hain. Yeh dilon ki hidayat hai, yeh rahmat hai, yeh basharat hai. Imam Awza'i (R.H) farmate hain ki yeh kitab Sunnat-e-Rasul ﷺ ko mila kar har cheez ka bayan hai. 

Is ayat ko upar wali ayat se ghaliban yeh taalluq hai ki jis ne tujh par is kitab ki tabligh farz ki hai aur ise nazil farmaya hai woh Qiyamat ke din tujh se is ki babat sawal karne wala hai jaise farman hai ki ummaton aur rasulon se sab se sawal hoga: Wal-nasalanna allazina ursila ilaihim wa lanasalannal-mursalin. Aur farman hai: Fa-la-nasalannal-lazina ursila ilaihim wa lanasalannal-mursalin. Aur ek jagah hai: Wa-yauvma yunadihim fa-yagulu maza ajabtumul-mursalin. Aur jagah hai: Yauma yajma'ullahur-rusula fa-yaqulu maza ujibtum qalu la ‘ilma lana innaka anta ‘allamul-ghuyub. 

Aur ayat mein hai: Innal-lazi farada ‘alaikal-Qurana la-radduka ila ma’ad yaani jis ne tujh par tabligh-e-Quran farz ki hai, woh tujhe Qiyamat ke din apne paas lautakar apne sonpe hue fareezay ki babat tujh se pursish karne wala hai. Yeh ek qaul bhi is ayat ki tafsir mein hai aur hai bhi ma'qool aur umdah.

Barabar ka badla: Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala apne bandon ko adl-o-insaf ka hukam deta hai aur suluk-o-ehsan ki rehnumai karta hai, go badla lena bhi jaiz hai jaise ayat (wa in ‘aqabtum fa‘aqibum bi-mithli ma ‘uqibtum bihi wala-in sabartum lahuwa khayrun lissabirin) (16. An-Nahl: 126) mein farmaya ke agar badla le sako to barabar barabar ka badla lo lekin agar sabr-o-bardasht kar lo to kya hi kehna, yeh bari mardangi ki baat hai. Aur ayat mein farmaya is ka ajr Khuda ke yahan milega. Ek aur ayat mein hai zakhmron ka qisas hai lekin jo darguzar kar jaye is ke gunahon ki muafi hai.

Pas adl to farz, ehsan nafl aur kalma-e-tauhid ki shahadat bhi adl hai. Zahir batin ki pakeezgi bhi adl hai aur ehsan yeh hai ke paki safayi zahir se bhi zyada ho. Aur fahsha aur munkar yeh hai ke batin mein khot ho aur zahir mein banawat ho. 

Woh silah rahmi ka bhi hukam deta hai. Jaise saaf lafzon mein irshad hai ayat (wa ati dhal-qurba haqqahu wal-miskina wabnas-sabili wa la tubadh-dhir tabdhira) (17. Al-Isra: 26). Rishtedaron, miskinon, musafiron ko un ka haq do aur be-ja kharch na karo. 

Muharramat se woh tumhein rokta hai, buraiyon se mana karta hai, zahiri batini tamam buraiyan haram hain. Logon par zulm-o-ziyadati haram hai. Hadith mein hai ke koi gunah zulm-o-ziyadati aur qat-e-rahmi se barh kar aisa nahi ke duniya mein bhi jaldi hi is ka badla mile aur akhirat mein bhi sakht pakar ho. 

Allah ke yeh ahkham aur yeh nawahi tumhari naseehat ke liye hain, jo achhi aadatain hain, un ka hukam Quran ne diya hai aur jo buri khaslatain logon mein hain un se Allah Ta'ala ne rok diya hai, bad-khulqi aur burai se us ne mamanat kar di hai. Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai behtareen akhlaq Allah ko pasand hain aur bad-khulqi ko woh makruh rakhta hai. 

Aksam bin Saifi ko jab Rasool Allah ﷺ ki babat itlaa hui toh us ne khidmat-e-nabawi mein hazir hone ki than li lekin us ki qaum us ke sar ho gayi aur usay rok liya. Us ne kaha achha mujhe nahi jaane dete toh qasid lao jinhein main wahan bhejun. Do shakhs is khidmat ki anjam-dahi ke liye tayar hue, yahan aa kar unhon ne kaha ke hum Aksam bin Saifi ke qasid hain, woh aap se poochta hai ke aap kaun hain aur kya hain? Aap ne farmaya pehle sawal ka jawab toh yeh hai ke main Muhammad bin Abdullah hoon ﷺ aur doosre sawal ka jawab yeh hai ke main Allah ka banda aur is ka Rasool hoon. 

Phir aap ne yahi ayat unhein parh kar sunayi. Unhon ne kaha dobara parhiye. Aap ne phir parhi, yahan tak ke unhon ne yaad kar li. Phir wapas ja kar Aksam ko khabar di aur kaha apne nasab par us ne koi fakhr nahi kiya, sirf apna aur apne walid ka naam bata diya lekin yeh haqeeqat hai ke hain woh bare nasab wale, Mudar mein aala khandan ke hain aur phir yeh kalmat hamein taleem farmaye jo aap ki zubani hum ne sune. Yeh sun kar Aksam ne kaha woh toh bari achhi aur aala batein sikhate hain aur buri aur sifli baaton se rokte hain.

Mere qabeele ke logon tum Islam ki taraf sabqat karo taake tum doosron par sardari karo aur doosron ke haathon mein dumein ban kar na reh jao. Is ayat ke shaan-e-nuzool mein ek husan hadith Musnad Imam Ahmad mein waarid hui hai. Ibn Abbas Rज़ी Allahu Anhu farmate hain ke Huzoor ﷺ apni anganai mein baithe hue the ke Usman bin Maz'oon aap ke paas se guzre aap ne farmaya baithte nahi ho? Woh baith gaya, aap us ki taraf mutawajje ho kar baatein kar rahe the ke Huzoor ﷺ daf'atan apni nazrein aasmaan ki jaanib uthaen kuch dair ooper hi ko dekhte rahe, phir nigahein aahista aahista neechi keen aur apni daayin jaanib zameen ki taraf dekhne lage aur usi taraf aap ne rukh bhi kar liya aur is tarah sar hilane lage goya kisi se kuch samajh rahe hain aur koi aap se kuch keh raha hai thodi dair tak yehi haalat taari rahi phir aap ne apni nigahein oonchi karni shuru keen, yahan tak ke aasmaan tak aap ki nigahein pahunchin phir aap theek thak ho gaye aur usi pehli baithak par Usman ki taraf mutawajje ho kar baith gaye. Woh ye sab dekh raha tha, us se sabr na ho saka, poocha ke Hazrat aap ke paas kayi baar baithne ka ittefaq hua lekin aaj jaisa manzar to kabhi nahi dekha, aap ne poocha tum ne kya dekha? Us ne kaha yeh ke aap ne apni nigaah aasmaan ki taraf uthayi phir neeche kar li aur apne daayin taraf dekhne lage aur usi taraf ghoom kar baith gaye, mujhe chhod diya, phir is tarah sar hilane lage jaise koi aap se kuch keh raha ho. Aur aap use achhi tarah sun samajh rahe hon. Aap ne farmaya achha tum ne yeh sab kuch dekha? Us ne kaha barabar dekhta hi raha. Aap ne farmaya mere paas Allah ka nazil karda farishta wahi le kar aaya tha us ne kaha Allah ka bheja huwa? Aap ne farmaya haan, haan Allah ka bheja huwa. Poocha phir us ne aap se kya kaha? Aap ne yehi ayat padh sunayi. Hazrat Usman bin Maz'oon Razi Allahu Anhu farmate hain usi waqt mere dil mein iman baith gaya aur Huzoor ﷺ ki mohabbat ne mere dil mein ghar kar liya. Ek aur riwayat mein Hazrat Usman bin Abul Aas Razi Allahu Anhu se marwi hai ke main Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein baitha hua tha jo aap ne apni nigahein ooper ko uthayi aur farmaya Jibrail Alaihis Salam mere paas aaye aur mujhe hukum diya ke main is ayat ko is soorat ki is jagah rakhoon yeh riwayat bhi sahi hai Wallahu A'lam.

Ahad-o-Paiman Ki Hifazat

Allah Ta'ala Musalmanon ko hukum deta hai ke woh ahad-o-paiman ki hifazat karein, qasmon ko pura karein, torein nahi. Qasmon ko na torne ki تاکید (takeed) ki aur ayat mein farmaya ke apni qasmon ka nishana Allah ko na banao. Is se bhi qasmon ki hifazat karne ki تاکید (takeed) maqsood hai aur ayat mein hai ke qasmeh torne ka kaffara hai, qasmon ki puri hifazat karo. Pas in ayton mein yeh hukum hai. 

Aur Bukhari o Muslim ki hadith mein An-Hazrat ﷺ farmate hain, "Wallah! Mein jis cheez par qasam kha loon aur phir is ke khilaf mein behtari dekhoon to Insha'Allah Ta'ala zaroor is naik kaam ko karunga aur apni qasam ka kaffara de doon ga." To mundarja bala ayton aur ahadees mein kuch farq na samjha jaye, woh qasmein aur ahad-o-paiman jo aapas ke muhaiday aur waaday ke taur par hon, un ka pura karna to beshak behad zaroori hai aur jo qasmein raghbat dilane ya rokne ke liye zaban se nikal jayen, woh beshak kaffara de kar toot sakti hain. 

Pas is ayat mein murad Jahiliyat ke zamane jaisi qasmein hain. Chunancha Musnad Ahmad mein hai, Rasulullah ﷺ farmate hain, "Islam mein do jamaton ki aapas mein aik ki qasam koi cheez nahi, haan Jahiliyat mein aisi imdad o ianat ki jo qasmein aapas mein ho chuki hain, Islam un ko aur mazboot karta hai." Is hadith ke pehle jumle ke yeh maani hain ke Islam qabool karne ke baad ab is ki zaroorat nahi ke aik baradari wale doosri baradari ko (qasam ke zariye) pakke ahad karein, kyunke ab Mashrique Maghrib ke Musalman aik doosre ke hamdard o ghamkhwar hain. 

Bukhari Muslim ki aik hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Anas ؓ ke ghar mein Rasul-e-Kareem Alaihil Afdalut Tasleem ne Ansar o Muhajireen mein baham qasmein uthwaiyein. Is se yeh mamnoo bhai bandi murad nahi, yeh to bhai chara tha jis ki bina par aapas mein aik doosre ke waris hote thay. Aakhir mein yeh hukum mansooq ho gaya aur wirsah qareebi rishte daron se مخصوص ho gaya. 

Kehte hain is farman-e-Ilahi se matlab un Musalmanon ko Islam par jama rehne ka hukum dena hai jo Huzoor ﷺ ke haath par bait kar ke Musalmanon ki jamat ki kami aur mushrikon ki jamat ki kasrat dekh kar tum isey tor do. 

Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke jab Yazid bin Muawiyah ki bait log torne lagey to Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar ؓ ne apne tamam gharane ke logon ko jama kiya aur Allah ki taarif kar ke amma baad keh kar farmaya, "Hum ne Yazid ki bait Allah aur Rasul ﷺ ki bait par ki hai aur mein ne Rasulullah ﷺ se suna hai ke har ghaddar ke liye Qiyamat ke din aik jhanda gaara jayega aur elan kiya jayega ke yeh ghaddar hai, falan bin falan ka." 

Allah ke sath shreek karne ke baad sab se bara aur sab se bura ghadr yeh hai ke Allah aur Rasul ki bait kisi ke haath par kar ke phir tor dena. Yaad rakho! Tum mein se koi yeh bura kaam na kare aur is bare mein had se na barhe, warna mujh mein aur us mein judai hai.

Musnad Ahmad mein Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain jo shakhs kisi musalman bhai se koi shart kare aur use pura karne ka irada na rakhta ho to woh misal us shakhs ke hai jo apne parosi ko amn dene ke baad bepanah chhor de phir unhein dhamkata hai jo ahd-o-paiman ki hifazat na karein ke unke is fail se Allah Ta'ala Alim-o-Khabir hai. Makkah mein ek aurat thi jiski aql mein fatoor tha soot katne ke baad, theek-thaak aur mazboot hojane ke baad be-wajah tor-tar kar phir tukde kar deti. Yeh to uski misal hai jo ahd ko mazboot kar ke phir tor de. Yehi baat theek hai ab use jaane dijiye ke waqia mein koi aisi aurat thi bhi ya nahi jo yeh karti ho na karti ho yahan to sirf misal maqsood hai. Ankasah ke maani tukde tukde hai. Mumkin hai ke yeh naqazat ghazalha ka ism-e-masdar ho. Aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke badal ho kan ki kibr ka yaani ankas na ho jam-e-makas ki nakis se. Phir farmata hai ke qasmon ko makr-o-fareeb ka zariya na banao ke apne se baroon ko apni qasmon se itminan dilaao aur apni imandari aur naik niyyati ka sikka bitha kar phir ghaddari aur be-imani kar jao unki kasrat dekh kar jhoote wade kar ke sulah kar lo aur phir moqa pa kar larai shuru kar do aisa na karo. Pas jab ke is halat mein bhi ahd shkani haram kar di to apni jamiyat aur kasrat ke waqt to bad-tor-e-awla haram hui. Bihamdillah hum Surah Anfal mein Hazrat Muawiyah ؓ ka qissa likh aaye hain ke un mein aur Shah-e-Room mein ek muddat tak ke liye sulah-nama hogaya tha is muddat ke khatme ke qareeb Aap ne mujahideen ko sarhad-e-Room ki taraf rawanah kiya ke woh sarhad par parao dalen aur muddat ke khatam hote hi dhawa bol dein taake Romiyon ko tayyari ka moqa na mile. Jab Hazrat Amr bin Anbasah ؓ ko yeh khabar hui to Aap Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Muawiyah ؓ ke paas aaye aur kehne lage Allah Akbar! Aye Muawiyah ahd pura kar ghadr aur bad-ahdi se bach. Main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se suna hai ke jis qaum se ahd moahda hojaye to jab tak ke muddat-e-sulah khatam na hojaye koi gira kholne ki bhi ijazat nahi. Yeh sunte hi Hazrat Muawiyah ؓ ne apne lashkaron ko wapas bulwa liya. Azba se murad aksar hai. Is jumle ka yeh bhi matlab hai ke dekha ke dushman qawi aur zyada hai sulah kar li aur us sulah ko zariya-e-fareeb bana kar unhein ghafil kar ke charh dore aur yeh bhi matlab hai ke ek qaum se moahda kar liya phir dekha ke dusri qaum un se zyada qawi hai, us se mamla kar liya aur agle moahde ko tor diya yeh sab mana hai. Is kasrat se Allah tumhein aazmata hai. Ya yeh ke apne hukum se yaani pabandi-e-wada ke hukum se Allah tumhari aazmaish karta hai aur tum mein sahi faisle Qiyamat ke din woh khud kar dega. Har ek ko uske amaal ka badla dega naikon ko naik, badon ko bad.

Yeh to uski misal hai jo ahd ko mazboot kar ke phir tor de. Yehi baat theek hai ab use jaane dijiye ke waqia mein koi aisi aurat thi bhi ya nahi jo yeh karti ho na karti ho yahan to sirf misal maqsood hai. Ankasah ke maani tukde tukde hai. Mumkin hai ke yeh naqazat ghazalha ka ism-e-masdar ho. Aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke badal ho kan ki kibr ka yaani ankas na ho jam-e-makas ki nakis se. Phir farmata hai ke qasmon ko makr-o-fareeb ka zariya na banao ke apne se baroon ko apni qasmon se itminan dilaao aur apni imandari aur naik niyyati ka sikka bitha kar phir ghaddari aur be-imani kar jao unki kasrat dekh kar jhoote wade kar ke sulah kar lo aur phir moqa pa kar larai shuru kar do aisa na karo. Pas jab ke is halat mein bhi ahd shkani haram kar di to apni jamiyat aur kasrat ke waqt to bad-tor-e-awla haram hui. Bihamdillah hum Surah Anfal mein Hazrat Muawiyah ؓ ka qissa likh aaye hain ke un mein aur Shah-e-Room mein ek muddat tak ke liye sulah-nama hogaya tha is muddat ke khatme ke qareeb Aap ne mujahideen ko sarhad-e-Room ki taraf rawanah kiya ke woh sarhad par parao dalen aur muddat ke khatam hote hi dhawa bol dein taake Romiyon ko tayyari ka moqa na mile. Jab Hazrat Amr bin Anbasah ؓ ko yeh khabar hui to Aap Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Muawiyah ؓ ke paas aaye aur kehne lage Allah Akbar! Aye Muawiyah ahd pura kar ghadr aur bad-ahdi se bach. Main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se suna hai ke jis qaum se ahd moahda hojaye to jab tak ke muddat-e-sulah khatam na hojaye koi gira kholne ki bhi ijazat nahi. Yeh sunte hi Hazrat Muawiyah ؓ ne apne lashkaron ko wapas bulwa liya. Azba se murad aksar hai. Is jumle ka yeh bhi matlab hai ke dekha ke dushman qawi aur zyada hai sulah kar li aur us sulah ko zariya-e-fareeb bana kar unhein ghafil kar ke charh dore aur yeh bhi matlab hai ke ek qaum se moahda kar liya phir dekha ke dusri qaum un se zyada qawi hai, us se mamla kar liya aur agle moahde ko tor diya yeh sab mana hai. Is kasrat se Allah tumhein aazmata hai. Ya yeh ke apne hukum se yaani pabandi-e-wada ke hukum se Allah tumhari aazmaish karta hai aur tum mein sahi faisle Qiyamat ke din woh khud kar dega. Har ek ko uske amaal ka badla dega naikon ko naik, badon ko bad.

Aik mazhab-o-maslak agar Allah chahta toh duniya bhar ka ek hi mazhab-o-maslak hota hai. Jaise farmaya (tarjuma) yani Allah ki chahat hoti toh ae logo tum sab ko woh ek hi giroh kar deta. Ek aur ayat mein hai ke agar tera Rab chahta toh ro-e-zameen ke sab log ba-iman hi hote. Yani un mein muwafiqat yaganaqat hoti. Ikhtilaaf aur bughz bilkul na hota. Tera Rab qadir hai agar chahe toh sab logo ko ek hi ummat kar de lekin yeh toh mutafariq hi rahenge magar jin par tere Rab ka raham ho, isi liye unhe paida kiya hai. Hidayat-o-zalalat usi ke haath hai. Qayamat ke din woh hisab lega, pooch gach karega aur chhote bade, naik bad, kul aamal ka badla dega. Phir musalmanon ko hidayat karta hai ke qasmon ko, ahd-o-paiman ko, makari ka zariya na banao warna sabit qadami ke baad phisal jaoge. Jaise koi seedhi raah se bhatak jaye aur tumhara yeh kaam auron ke bhi raah-e-haq se hat jaane ka sabab ban jayega jis ka badtareen wabaal tum par padega. Kyunki kuffar jab dekhenge ke musalmanon ne ahd kar ke tod diya, wade ka khilaf kiya toh unhe deen par wusooq-o-aitmad na rahega pas woh Islam ko qabool karne se ruk jayenge aur chunke un ke is rukne ka baais chunke tum banoge isliye tumhein bada azab hoga aur sakht saza di jayegi. Allah ko beech mein rakh kar jo wade karo us ki qasme khakar jo ahd-o-paiman hon unhe duniyawi lalach se tod dena ya badal dena tum par haram hai go sari duniya asl ho jaye taham is hurmat ke murtakib na bano. Kyunki duniya heech hai, Allah ke paas jo hai, wahi behtar hai is jaza aur is sawab ki ummeed rakho jo Allah ki is baat par yaqeen rakhe, usi ka talib rahe aur hukm-e-Ilahi ki pabandi ke matahat apne wade ki nigahbaani kare, us ke liye jo ajr-o-sawab Allah ke paas hai woh sari duniya se bahut ziyada aur behtar hai. Ise achhi tarah jaan lo, nadani se aisa na karo ke sawab-e-akhirat zaya ho jaye balki lene ke dene pad jayein. Suno duniya ki naimatein zayil hone wali hain aur akhirat ki naimatein la-zawal aur abdi hain. Mujhe qasam hai jin logo ne duniya mein sabr kiya, main unhein Qayamat ke din un ke behtar-e-aamal ka nihayat aala sila ata farmaunga aur unhein bakhsh dunga.

Kitab-o-Sunnat ke farman-bardar Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala Jalla Shanuhu apne un bando se jo apne dil mein Allah par, uske Rasool ﷺ par iman-e-kamil rakhein aur Kitab-o-Sunnat ki tabadari ke matحت nek amaal karein, wada karta hai ke woh unhein duniya mein bhi behtareen aur pakeeza zindagi ata farmayega. Umdagi se unki umr basar hogi, khwah woh mard hon, khwah aurtein hon, sath hi unhein apne paas Dar-e-Akhirat mein bhi unki nek amaliyon ka behtareen badla ata farmayega. Duniya mein paak aur halal rozi, qanaat, khush-nafsi, saadat, pakeezgi, ibadat ka lutf, itaat ka maza, dil ki thandak, seene ki kushaadgi, sab hi kuch Allah ki taraf se imandar nek amil ko ata hoti hai. Chunancha Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain usne falah hasil kar li jo musalman ho gaya aur barabar sarabar rozi diya gaya aur jo mila us par qanaat naseeb hui aur hadith mein hai jise Islam ki rah dikha di gayi aur jise pet palne ka tukra mayassar ho gaya aur Allah ne uske dil ko qanaat se bhar diya, usne najat pa li (Tirmizi). Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain ke Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala apne momin bando par zulm nahi karta balki unki neki ka badla duniya mein ata farmata hai aur akhirat ki nekiyan bhi unhein deta hai, haan kafir apni nekiyan duniya mein hi kha leta hai akhirat ke liye uske hath mein koi neki baqi nahi rehti.

A'uz ka maqsad Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi ﷺ ki zubani apne momin bandon ko hukum farmata hai ke Quran-e-Kareem ki tilawat se pehle woh A'uz parh liya karein. Yeh hukum farziyat ke taur par nahi. Ibn Jareer waghera ne is par ijma' naqal kiya hai. A'uz ki poori behs ma' ma'ani waghera ke hum apni is tafsir ke shuru mein likh aaye hain falhamdulillah. Is hukum ki maslahat yeh hai ke qari Quran mein ulajhne, ghaor o fikar se ruk jaane aur shaitani waswason mein aane se bach jaye. Isi liye jamoor kehte hain ke qirat shuru karne se pehle A'uz parh liya karein. Kisi ka qaul yeh bhi hai ke khatm-e-qirat ke baad parhe. Unki daleel yehhi ayat hai lekin sahih qaul pehla hi hai aur ahadees ki dalalat bhi is par hai wallahu a'alam. Phir farmata hai ke aimandar mutawakkileen ko woh aise gunahon mein phansa nahi sakta, jinse woh tauba hi na karein. Uski koi hujjat unke samne chal nahi sakti, yeh mukhlis bande uske gahre makr se mehfooz rehte hain. Haan jo uski itaat karein, uske kahe mein aa jayein, use apna dost aur himayati thehra lein. Use Allah ki ibadaton mein shareek karne lagein. Un par to yeh cha jata hai. Yeh matlab bhi ho sakta hai ke "ba" ko sababiya batlayen yaani woh uske farmanbardari ke ba'is Allah ke sath shirk karne lag jayein, yeh ma'ani bhi hain ke woh use apne maal mein, apni aulaad mein shareek-e-ilah thehra lein.

Azali badnaseeb log mushrikon ki aqli, be-thabati aur be-yaqeeni ka bayan ho raha hai ke unhein iman kaise naseeb ho? Yeh to azali badnaseeb hain, nasikh mansookh se ahkaam ki tabdeeli dekh kar bakne lagte hain ke lo sahib un ka buhtan khul gaya, itna nahi jaante ke Qadir-e-Mutlaq Allah jo chahe kare jo irada kare, hukm de, ek hukm ko utha de doosre ko is ki jagah rakh de. Jaise aayat (Ma nansakh min ayatin aw nunsinha nati bi khairin minha aw misliha alam ta'lam ann Allaha 'ala kulli shai'in qadeer) (2. Al-Baqarah: 106) mein farmaya hai. Paak rooh yaani Hazrat Jibreel (Alaihis Salam) ise Allah ki taraf se haqaniyat-o-sadaqat ke adl-o-insaaf ke sath lekar teri jaanib aate hain taaki imandar sabit qadam hojayein, ab utra, mana, phir utra, phir mana, un ke dil Rab ki taraf jhukte rahein, taza taza Kalam-e-Ilahi sunte rahein, musalmanon ke liye hidayat-o-bisharat hojaye, Allah aur Rasool Allah ke manne wale rah-yafta hokar khush hojayein.

Sab se zyada manzil-o-rif'at wala kalam kafaron ki ek buhtan bazi bayan ho rahi hai ke woh kehte hain ke ise yeh Quran ek insan sikhata hai. Quraish ke kisi qabiley ka ek ajmi ghulam tha, Safa pahari ke pas khareedo-farokht kiya karta tha, Huzoor ﷺ kabhi kabhi uske pas baith jaya karte the aur kuch baatein kar liya karte the, yeh shakhs sahi arabi zaban bolne par bhi qadir na tha. Tooti phooti zaban mein ba-mushkil apna matlab ada kar liya karta tha. Is iftara ka jawab Janab-e-Bari deta hai ke woh kya sikhaye ga jo khud bolna nahi janta, ajmi zaban ka admi hai aur yeh Quran to arabi zaban mein hai, phir fasahat-o-balaghat wala, kamal-o-salasat wala, umdah aur aala pakiza aur bala. Ma'ani, matlab, alfaz, waqiat hain. Sab se nirala Bani Israel ki asmani kitabon se bhi zyada manzil-o-rif'at wala. Waq'at aur izzat wala. Tum mein agar zara si aql hoti to yun hatheli par chiragh rakh kar chori karne ko na nikalte, aisa jhoot na bakte, jo bewqoofon ke haq mein bhi na chal sake. Sirat Ibn Ishaq mein hai ke ek nasrani ghulam jise Jabr kaha jata tha jo Bani Hadhrami qabiley ke kisi shakhs ka ghulam tha, uske pas Rasool Allah ﷺ Marwa ke pas baith jaya karte the, is par mushrikeen ne yeh be-par ki urayi ke yeh Quran usi ka sikhaya hua hai iske jawab mein yeh آیت (ayat) utri. Kehte hain ke iska naam Ya'ish tha. Ibn Abbas ؓ kehte hain Makkah Shareef mein ek lohar tha jiska naam Bal'am tha. Yeh ajmi shakhs tha, ise Huzoor ﷺ taleem dete the to Aap ka uske pas ana jana dekh kar Quraish mashhoor karne lage ke yahi shakhs Aap ko kuch sikhata hai aur Aap ise Kalamullah ke naam se apne halqe mein sikhate hain. Kisi ne kaha hai murad is se Salman Farsi hain ؓ lekin yeh qoul to nihayat bouda hai kyunke Hazrat Salman to Madine mein Aap se mile aur yeh آیت (ayat) Makkah mein utri hai. Ubaidullah bin Muslim kehte hain hamare do maqami admi Rum ke rehne wale the jo apni zaban mein apni kitab padhte the. Huzoor ﷺ bhi jate ate kabhi unke pas khade

Irada na ho to baat nahi banti jo Allah ke zikr se munh moore, Allah ki kitab se ghaflat kare, Allah ki baaton par iman laane ka qasd hi na rakhe aise logon ko Allah bhi door daal deta hai unhein deen-e-haq ki taufiq hi nahi hoti akhirat mein sakht dardnak azabon mein phanstey hain. Phir bayan farmaya ke yeh rasool (Alaihis Salam) Allah par jhoot-o-iftra baandhne wale nahi, yeh kaam to badtareen makhlooq ka hai jo mulhid-o-kafir hon unka jhoot logon mein mashhoor hota hai aur An-Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ) to tamam makhlooq se behtar-o-afzal deen-dar, Allah shinas, sachon ke se hain. Sab se zyada kamal ilm-o-iman, amal-o-neeki mein aap ko asl hai. Sachai mein, bhalai mein, yaqeen mein, marifat mein, aap ka sani koi nahi. In kafiron se hi pooch lo yeh bhi aap ke sadaqat ke qayil hain. Aap ke amanat ke madah hain. Aap un mein Muhammad Amin ke mumtaz laqab se mashhoor maroof hain. Shah-e-Room Herqal ne jab Abu Sufyan se An-Hazrat (ﷺ) ki nisbat bahut se sawalat kiye un mein ek yeh bhi tha ke dawa-e-nabuwat se pehle tum ne use kabhi jhoot ki taraf nisbat ki hai? Abu Sufyan ne jawab diya kabhi nahi is par shah ne kaha kaise ho sakta hai ke ek woh shakhs jis ne duniyawi mamlaat mein logon ke bare mein kabhi bhi jhoot ki gandagi se apni zaban kharab na ki ho woh Allah par jhoot baandhne lage.

Iman ke baad kufr pasand log: Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala bayan farmata hai ki jo log iman ke baad kufr karein dekh kar andhe ho jayen phir kufr pe unka seena khul jaye, is par itminan karlein. Yeh Allah ke ghazab mein گرفتار hote hain ki iman ka ilm hasil kar ke phir us se phir gaye aur unhein aakhirat mein bada sakht azaab hoga. Kyunke unhein aakhirat bigaad kar duniya ki mohabbat ki aur sirf duniya talbi ki wajah se Islam par murtad hone ko tarjeeh di chunke unke dil hidayat-e-haqq se khali the, Allah ki taraf se sabit-qadami unhein na mili. Dilon par mohrein lag gayin, nafa ki koi baat samajh mein nahi aati. Kaan aur aankhein bhi bekaar ho gayin na haq sun sakein na dekh sakein. Pas kisi cheez ne unhein koi faida na pohanchaya aur apne anjam se ghafil ho gaye. Yaqinan aise log qayamat ke din apna aur apne hum-khayal logon ka nuqsan karne wale hain. 

Pehli aayat ke darmiyan jin logon ka istisna kiya hai yaani woh jin par jabr kiya jaye aur unke dil iman par jame hue hon, is se murad woh log hain jo ba-sabab maar-peet aur azaaon ke majboor ho kar zaban se mushrikin ki muwafiqat karein lekin unka dil woh na kehta ho balke dil mein Allah par aur uske Rasool par kamil itminan ke sath poora iman ho. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain yeh aayat Ammar bin Yasir (R.A) ke bare mein utri hai jab ki aap ko mushrikin ne azaab karna shuru kiya jab tak ki aap An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath kufr na karein. Pas badal-na-khwasta majbooran aur kalahan aap ne un ki muwafiqat ki, phir Allah ke Nabi ke paas aa kar uzr bayan karne lage. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayat utari. Sha'bi, Qatadah aur Abu Malik bhi yehi kehte hain. 

Ibn Jareer mein hai ki mushrikin ne aap ko pakda aur azaab dene shuru kiye, yahan tak ki aap un ke iradon ke kareeb ho gaye. Phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aa kar is ki shikayat karne lage to aap ne poochha tum apne dil ka haal kaisa pate ho? Jawab diya ki woh to iman par mutma'in hai, jama hua hai. Aap ne farmaya agar woh phir loten toh tum bhi lotna. Baihaqi mein isse bhi ziyada tafseel se hai is mein hai ki aap ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko bura bhala kaha aur un ke maboodon ka zikr khair se kiya phir aap ke paas aa kar apna yeh dukh bayan kiya ki Ya Rasulallah

Pas ulama-e-kram ka ittifaq hai ke jis par jabr-o-ikrah kiya jaye, usay jaiz hai ke apni jaan bachane ke liye unki muwafiqat kar le aur yeh bhi jaiz hai ke aisay mauqa par bhi unki nah maane jaisے ke Hazrat Bilal (R.A) ne kar ke dikhaya ke mushrikon ki aik nah mani halanki woh unhen badtareen taklifen dete thay yahan tak ke sakht garmiyon mein poori tez dhoop mein aap ko lita kar aap ke seene par bhaari wazni patthar rakh diya ke ab bhi shirq karo tou nijat pao lekin aap ne phir bhi unki nah mani saaf inkar kar diya aur Allah ki tauheed Ahad Ahad ke lafz se bayaan farmate rahe balki farmaya karte thay ke "Wallah agar is se bhi ziyada tumhen chubhnay wala koi lafz mere ilm mein hota tou main wahi kehta Allah un se razi rahe aur unhen bhi hamesha razi rakhe." Isi tarah Hazrat Khabeeb bin Zaid Ansari (R.A) ka waqia hai ke jab un se Musailma Kazab ne kaha ke kya tu Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ) ki risalat ki gawahi deta hai? Tou aap ne farmaya haan. Phir us ne aap se pucha ke kya mere Rasoolullah honay ki bhi gawahi deta hai? Tou aap ne farmaya main nahi sunta. Is par is jhoote mudda-e-nabuwat ne un ke jism ke aik uzw ke kaat daalnay ka hukum diya phir yahi sawal jawab hua. Doosra uzw jism kaat gaya yunhi hota raha lekin aap aakhir dam tak isi par qaim rahe, Allah aap se khush ho aur aap ko bhi khush rakhe. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke jo chand log murtad ho gaye thay, unhen Hazrat Ali (R.A) ne aag mein jala diya, jab Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ko yeh waqia maloom hua toh aap ne farmaya main to unhen aag mein nah jalata is liye ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ka farman hai ke Allah ke azaab se tum azaab na karo. Haan beshak main unhen qatl kara deta. Is liye ke farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ) hai ke jo apne deen ko badal de usay qatl kar do. Jab yeh khabar Hazrat Ali (R.A) ko hui tou aap ne farmaya Ibn Abbas ki maan par afsos. Isay Imam Bukhari (R.H) ne bhi warid kiya hai. Musnad mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari (R.A) ke paas Yaman mein Mu'adh bin Jabal (R.A) tashreef laye. Dekha ke aik shakhs un ke paas hai. Pucha yeh kya? Jawab mila ke yeh aik yahudi tha, phir musalman ho gaya ab phir yahudi ho gaya hai. Hum taqreeban do mah se usay islam par laane ki koshish mein hain, tou aap ne farmaya Wallah main baithoonga bhi nahi jab tak ke tum uski gardan na uda do. Yahi faisla hai Allah aur uske Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ka ke jo apne deen se laut jaye usay qatl kar do ya farmaya jo apne deen ko badal de. Yeh waqia Bukhari o Muslim mein bhi hai lekin alfaaz aur hain. Pas afzal aur awla yeh hai ke musalman apne deen par qaim aur sabit qadam rahe go usay qatl bhi kar diya jaye. Chunacha Hafiz Ibn Asakir (R.H) Abdullah bin Huzafah Sahmi Sahabi (R.A) ke tarjuma mein laye hain ke aap ko roomi kuffar ne qaid kar liya aur apne badshah ke paas pahuncha diya, us ne aap se kaha ke tum nasrani ban jao main tumhen apne raaj paat mein shareek kar leta hoon aur apni shehzadi tumhare nikah mein deta hoon.

Sahabi (R.A) ne jawab diya ke yeh to kya agar tu apni tamam baadshahat mujhe de de aur tamam Arab ka raaj bhi mujhe saunp de aur yeh chahe ke main aik ankh jhapakne ke barabar bhi Deen-e-Muhammad se phir jaaun, toh yeh bhi namumkin hai. Baadshah ne kaha phir main tujhe qatal kar doon ga. Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ne jawab diya ke haan yeh tujhe ikhtiyar hai, chunacha usi waqt baadshah ne hukam diya aur unhein saleeb par chadha diya gaya aur teer-andazon ne qareeb se behukam-e-baadshah un ke hath paon aur jism chhedna shuru kiya, baar baar kaha jata tha ke ab bhi nasraniyat qubool kar lo aur aap poore istiqlaal aur sabr se farmate jaate the ke hargiz nahi. Akhir baadshah ne kaha isey suli se utaar lo, phir hukam diya ke peetal ki deig ya peetal ki bani hui gaaye khoob tapa kar aag bana kar lai jaye. Chunacha woh pesh hui, baadshah ne aik aur musalman qaidi ki baabat hukam diya ke isey is mein daal do. Usi waqt Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ki maujudgi mein aap ke dekhte hi dekhte us musalman qaidi ko is mein daal diya gaya, woh maskeen usi waqt char-mar ho kar reh gaye, gosht-posoat jal gaya, haddiyan chamakne lagin. Phir baadshah ne Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) se kaha ke dekho ab bhi hamari maan lo aur hamara mazhab qubool kar lo, warna isi aag ki deig mein usi tarah tumhein bhi daal kar jala diya jayega. Aap ne phir bhi apne imani josh se kaam lekar farmaya ke namumkin hai ke main Allah ke deen ko chhod doon. Usi waqt baadshah ne hukam diya ke unhein charkhi par chadha kar is mein daal do, jab yeh is aag ki deig mein dale jane ke liye charkhi par uthaye gaye to baadshah ne dekha ke un ki ankhon se ansu nikal rahe hain, usi waqt us ne hukam diya ke ruk jao, unhein apne paas bula liya, is liye ke isey ummeed bandh gayi thi ke shayad is azab ko dekh kar ab iske khayalat palat gaye hain, meri maan lega aur mera mazhab qubool kar ke mera damad ban kar meri saltanat ka sajhi ban jayega, lekin baadshah ki yeh tamna aur yeh khayal mehez besood nikla. Hazrat Abdullah bin Huzafah (R.A) ne farmaya ke main sirf is wajah se roya tha ke aaj aik hi jaan hai jise rah-e-haq mein is azab ke sath main qurban kar raha hoon, kaash ke mere rowein rowein mein aik aik jaan hoti ke aaj main sab janein rah-e-Allah usi tarah aik aik kar ke fida karta. Baaz riwayaton mein hai ke aap ko qaid khana mein rakha, khana peena band kar diya, kayi din ke baad sharab aur khanzeir ka gosht bheja lekin aap ne is bhook par bhi us ki taraf tawajjo tak na farmayi. Baadshah ne bulwa bheja aur isey na khane ka sabab دریافت (daryaft) kiya to aap ne jawab diya ke is halat mein yeh mere liye halal to ho gaya hai lekin main tujh jaise dushman ko apne bare mein khush hone ka mauqa dena chahta hi nahi hoon.

Ab baadshah ne kaha accha toh mere sar ka bosa le toh main tujhe aur tere saath ke aur tamam musalman qaidiyon ko riha kar deta hoon, aap ne isko qubool farma liya, iske sar ka bosa le liya aur baadshah ne bhi apna wada poora kiya aur aap ko aur aap ke tamam sathiyein ko chhor diya. Jab Hazrat Abdullah bin Huzafah R.A yahan se azad ho kar Hazrat Umar Farooq R.A ke paas pahuche toh aap ne farmaya: Har musalman par haq hai ke Abdullah bin Huzafah R.A ka matha choome aur main ibtida karta hoon. Yeh farma kar pehle aap ne unke sar par bosa diya.

Baadshah ne bulwa bheja aur isey na khane ka sabab دریافت (daryaft) kiya to aap ne jawab diya ke is halat mein yeh mere liye halal to ho gaya hai lekin main tujh jaise dushman ko apne bare mein khush hone ka mauqa dena chahta hi nahi hoon.

Ab baadshah ne kaha accha toh mere sar ka bosa le toh main tujhe aur tere saath ke aur tamam musalman qaidiyon ko riha kar deta hoon, aap ne isko qubool farma liya, iske sar ka bosa le liya aur baadshah ne bhi apna wada poora kiya aur aap ko aur aap ke tamam sathiyein ko chhor diya. Jab Hazrat Abdullah bin Huzafah R.A yahan se azad ho kar Hazrat Umar Farooq R.A ke paas pahuche toh aap ne farmaya: Har musalman par haq hai ke Abdullah bin Huzafah R.A ka matha choome aur main ibtida karta hoon. Yeh farma kar pehle aap ne unke sar par bosa diya.

Iman ke baad kufr pasand log: Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala bayan farmata hai ki jo log iman ke baad kufr karein dekh kar andhe ho jayen phir kufr pe unka seena khul jaye, is par itminan karlein. Yeh Allah ke ghazab mein گرفتار hote hain ki iman ka ilm hasil kar ke phir us se phir gaye aur unhein aakhirat mein bada sakht azaab hoga. Kyunke unhein aakhirat bigaad kar duniya ki mohabbat ki aur sirf duniya talbi ki wajah se Islam par murtad hone ko tarjeeh di chunke unke dil hidayat-e-haqq se khali the, Allah ki taraf se sabit-qadami unhein na mili. Dilon par mohrein lag gayin, nafa ki koi baat samajh mein nahi aati. Kaan aur aankhein bhi bekaar ho gayin na haq sun sakein na dekh sakein. Pas kisi cheez ne unhein koi faida na pohanchaya aur apne anjam se ghafil ho gaye. Yaqinan aise log qayamat ke din apna aur apne hum-khayal logon ka nuqsan karne wale hain. 

Pehli aayat ke darmiyan jin logon ka istisna kiya hai yaani woh jin par jabr kiya jaye aur unke dil iman par jame hue hon, is se murad woh log hain jo ba-sabab maar-peet aur azaaon ke majboor ho kar zaban se mushrikin ki muwafiqat karein lekin unka dil woh na kehta ho balke dil mein Allah par aur uske Rasool par kamil itminan ke sath poora iman ho. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain yeh aayat Ammar bin Yasir (R.A) ke bare mein utri hai jab ki aap ko mushrikin ne azaab karna shuru kiya jab tak ki aap An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath kufr na karein. Pas badal-na-khwasta majbooran aur kalahan aap ne un ki muwafiqat ki, phir Allah ke Nabi ke paas aa kar uzr bayan karne lage. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayat utari. Sha'bi, Qatadah aur Abu Malik bhi yehi kehte hain. 

Ibn Jareer mein hai ki mushrikin ne aap ko pakda aur azaab dene shuru kiye, yahan tak ki aap un ke iradon ke kareeb ho gaye. Phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aa kar is ki shikayat karne lage to aap ne poochha tum apne dil ka haal kaisa pate ho? Jawab diya ki woh to iman par mutma'in hai, jama hua hai. Aap ne farmaya agar woh phir loten toh tum bhi lotna. Baihaqi mein isse bhi ziyada tafseel se hai is mein hai ki aap ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko bura bhala kaha aur un ke maboodon ka zikr khair se kiya phir aap ke paas aa kar apna yeh dukh bayan kiya ki Ya Rasulallah

Pas ulama-e-kram ka ittifaq hai ke jis par jabr-o-ikrah kiya jaye, usay jaiz hai ke apni jaan bachane ke liye unki muwafiqat kar le aur yeh bhi jaiz hai ke aisay mauqa par bhi unki nah maane jaisے ke Hazrat Bilal (R.A) ne kar ke dikhaya ke mushrikon ki aik nah mani halanki woh unhen badtareen taklifen dete thay yahan tak ke sakht garmiyon mein poori tez dhoop mein aap ko lita kar aap ke seene par bhaari wazni patthar rakh diya ke ab bhi shirq karo tou nijat pao lekin aap ne phir bhi unki nah mani saaf inkar kar diya aur Allah ki tauheed Ahad Ahad ke lafz se bayaan farmate rahe balki farmaya karte thay ke "Wallah agar is se bhi ziyada tumhen chubhnay wala koi lafz mere ilm mein hota tou main wahi kehta Allah un se razi rahe aur unhen bhi hamesha razi rakhe." Isi tarah Hazrat Khabeeb bin Zaid Ansari (R.A) ka waqia hai ke jab un se Musailma Kazab ne kaha ke kya tu Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ) ki risalat ki gawahi deta hai? Tou aap ne farmaya haan. Phir us ne aap se pucha ke kya mere Rasoolullah honay ki bhi gawahi deta hai? Tou aap ne farmaya main nahi sunta. Is par is jhoote mudda-e-nabuwat ne un ke jism ke aik uzw ke kaat daalnay ka hukum diya phir yahi sawal jawab hua. Doosra uzw jism kaat gaya yunhi hota raha lekin aap aakhir dam tak isi par qaim rahe, Allah aap se khush ho aur aap ko bhi khush rakhe. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke jo chand log murtad ho gaye thay, unhen Hazrat Ali (R.A) ne aag mein jala diya, jab Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ko yeh waqia maloom hua toh aap ne farmaya main to unhen aag mein nah jalata is liye ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ka farman hai ke Allah ke azaab se tum azaab na karo. Haan beshak main unhen qatl kara deta. Is liye ke farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ) hai ke jo apne deen ko badal de usay qatl kar do. Jab yeh khabar Hazrat Ali (R.A) ko hui tou aap ne farmaya Ibn Abbas ki maan par afsos. Isay Imam Bukhari (R.H) ne bhi warid kiya hai. Hum taqreeban do mah se usay islam par laane ki koshish mein hain, tou aap ne farmaya Wallah main baithoonga bhi nahi jab tak ke tum uski gardan na uda do. Jaise Quran ne farmaya hai ke yeh log kehte hain ke agar hum hidayat ki pairwi karein toh apni zameen se uchak liye jayenge kya hum ne unhein aman-o-aman ka haram nahi de rakha? Jahan hamari roziyan qism qism ke phoolon ki shakal mein un ke paas charon taraf se khinchi chali aati hain. Yahan bhi irshad hota hai ke umdah aur guzare layak rozi is shehar ke logon ke paas har taraf se aa rahi thi lekin phir bhi yeh Allah ki nematon ke munkar rahe jin mein sab se aala nemat Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ki bisalat thi jaise irshad-e-bari hai ayat (Alam tara ilal-lazina baddalu ni'matallahi kufran wa ahallu qawmahum daral-bawar 28) (14. Ibrahim: 28) kya to ne unhein dekha jinhon ne Allah ki nemat ko kufr se badal diya aur apni qaam ko halakat ki taraf pohncha diya jo jahannam hai jahan yeh dakhil honge aur jo buri qarar gah hai. Un ki is sarkashi ki saza mein donon nematein do zehmaton se badal di gain. Aman khouf se, itminan bhook aur ghabrahat se, unhon ne Allah ke Rasool ki na mani. Aap ke khilaf kamar kas li toh aap ne un ke liye saat qahat-saliyon ki bad-dua di. Jaisi Hazrat Yusuf Alaihis Salam ke zamanah mein thin. Is qahat-sali mein unhon ne oont ke khoon mein lathare hue baal tak khaye. Aman ke baad khouf aaya. Har waqt Rasulullah ﷺ aur aap ke lashkar se khouf-zada rehne lage. Aap ki din dugni taraqi aur aap ke lashkarion ki kasrat ka sunte aur sehme jaate the yahan tak ke bil-akhir Allah ke Paigambar ﷺ ne un ke shehar Makkah par chadahi ki aur ise fateh kar ke wahan qabza kar liya. Yeh un ki bad-a'maliyon ka samra tha kyunke yeh zulm-o-ziyadati par ade hue the aur Allah ke Rasool ﷺ ki takzeeb karte rahe the. Jise Allah Ta'ala ne un mein khud un mein se hi bheja tha jis ehsan ka bayan ayat (Laqad manallahu) al-kh mein farmaya hai aur usi ka bayan ayat (Fattaqul-laha ya ulil-albab, allazina amanu qad anzalallahu ilaikum zikra 10) (65. At-Talaq: 10) mein hai aur usi mani ki ayat (Kama arsalna fikum) mein hai takfurun tak is latife ko bhi na bhooliye ke jaise kufr ki wajah se aman ke baad khouf aaya aur farakhi ke baad bhook aai iman ki wajah se khouf ke baad aman mila aur bhook ke baad hukumat, sardari amarat aur imamat mili. Fa subhanahu ma a'zama shanahu. Salim bin Numair kehte hain hum Hazrat Hafsa zauja-e-mohtarma Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa ﷺ ke sath hajj se lotte hue aa rahe the us waqt Madina Sharif mein Khalifatul-Muminin Hazrat Usman R.A ghare hue thay. Mai sahibah aksar rah chaltun se un ki babat daryaft farmaya karti thin. Do sawaron ko jate hue dekh kar aadmi bheja ke un se Khalifatur-Rasul ka hal pucho. Unhon ne khabar di ke afsos aap shaheed kar

Halal-o-Haram sirf Allah ki taraf se hain. Allah Ta'ala apne momin bando ko apni di hui paak rozi halal karta hai aur shukr karne ki hidayat karta hai. Is liye ke nemato ka data wahi hai, usi liye ibadat ke layiq bhi sirf wahi ek hai, uska koi shareek aur sajhi nahi. Phir un cheezon ka bayan farma raha hai jo us ne musalmano par haram kardi hain jis mein unke deen ka nuqsan bhi hai aur unki duniya ka nuqsan bhi hai jaise az-khud mara hua janwar aur boqt-e-zabih kiya jaye. Lekin jo shakhs unke khane ki taraf bebas, lachar, aajiz, muhtaj, beqarar hojaye aur unhe khale to Allah bakhshish-o-rahmat se kaam lene wala hai. Surah Baqarah mein isi jaisi ayat guzar chuki hai aur wahin iski kamil tafsir bhi bayan kardi ab dobara dohrane ki haajat nahi fa Alhamdulillah. Phir kafiro ke rawayye se musalmano ko rok raha hai ke jis tarah unho ne az-khud apni samajh se hillat-o-hurmat qaim karli hai tum na karo aapas mein tay karliya ke falan ke naam se mansoob janwar hurmat-o-izzat wala hai. Baheera, Saiba, Waseela, Haam waghera to farman hai ke apni zubano se jhoot-moot Allah ke zimme ilzaam rakh kar aap halal haram na thehra lo. Is mein yeh bhi dakhil hai ke koi apni taraf se kisi bid'at ko nikale jiski koi shar'i daleel na ho. Ya Allah ke haram ko halal kare ya mubah ko haram qarar de aur apni raay aur tashbeeh se ahkaam ijaad kare. Lamma tasifu mein ma masdariya hai yaani tum apni zaban se halal haram ka jhoot wasf na ghad lo. Aise log duniya ki falah se akhirat ki nijat se mahroom hojate hain duniya mein go thoda sa faida utha lein lekin marte hi almanaq azabo ka luqma banenge. Yahan kuch aish-o-ishrat karlein wahan bebasi ke sath sakht azab bardasht karne parenge. Jaise farman-e-Ilahi hai Allah par jhoot iftira karne wale nijat se mahroom hain. Duniya mein chahe thoda sa faida utha lein phir hum unke kufr ki wajah se unhe sakht azab chakhayenge.

Dusron se mansoob har cheez haram hai. Upar bayan guzra ke is ummat par murdar, khoon, lahm, khanzeer aur Allah ke siwa dusron ke naam se mansoob karda cheezein haram hain. Phir jo rukhsat is bare mein thi use zahir farma kar jo asani is ummat par ki gayi hai use bayan farmaya. Yahudiyon par unki shariat mein jo haram tha aur jo tang aur harj un par tha use bayan farma raha hai ke humne unki hurmat ki cheezon ko pehle hi se tujhe bata diya hai. Surah An'am ki ayat (Wa 'alal-lazina hadu harramna ma qasasna 'alaika min qablu wa ma zalamnahum wa lakin kanu anfusahum yazlimun - 16. An-Nahl: 118) mein un haram cheezon ka zikr ho chuka hai. Ya'ni Yahudiyon par humne tamam nakhun wale janwaro ko haram kar diya tha aur gaye aur bakri ki charbi ko siwae us charbi ke jo unki peeth par lagi ho ya antriyon par ya haddiyon se mili hui ho, yeh badla tha unki sarkashi ka hum apne farman mein bilkul sache hain. Humne un par koi zulm nahi kiya tha haan woh khud na-insaf the. Unke zulm ki wajah se humne woh pakeeza cheezein jo un par halal thin, haram kar dein. Dusri wajah unka rah-e-haq se auron ko rokna bhi tha. Phir Allah Ta'ala apne is rahm-o-karam ki khabar deta hai jo woh gunehgar momino ke sath karta hai ke udhar usne tauba ki, udhar rahmat ki god uske liye phail gayi. Ba'z salaf ka qaul hai ke jo Allah ki nafarmani karta hai woh jahil hi hota hai. Tauba kehte hain gunah se hat jaane ko aur islah kehte hain ita'at par kamar kas lene ko. Pas jo aisa kare uske gunah aur uski laghzish ke baad bhi Allah use bakhsh deta hai aur us par rahm farmata hai.

Jadd-ul-Anbiya Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam) hidayat ke imam, imam-e-hunafa, walid-e-anbiya, Khalil-ur-Rahman, Rasul Jalla wa 'Ala, Hazrat Ibrahim Alaihis Salatu wat-Taslim ki tareef bayan ho rahi hai aur mushrikon, yahudiyon aur nasraniyon se unhein alag kiya ja raha hai. Ummat-e-ke maana imam ke hain jin ki iqtida ki jaye, qanit kehte hain ita'at-guzar farman-bardار ko, hanif ke maana hain shirk se hat kar tawheed ki taraf aa jane wala. Isi liye farmaya ki woh mushrikon se bezar tha. 

Hazrat Ibn Mas'ud (R.A) se jab ummat qanit ke maana daryaft kiye gaye toh farmaya: Logon ko bhalai sikhane wala aur Allah aur Rasul (ﷺ) ki matahati karne wala. Ibn Umar (R.A) farmate hain ummat ke maana hain logon ke deen ka muallim. 

Ek martaba Hazrat Ibn Mas'ud (R.A) ne farmaya ki Hazrat Mu'adh ummat, qanit aur hanif the, is par kisi ne apne dil mein socha ki Abdullah galti kar gaye aise toh Quran ke mutabiq Hazrat Khalil-ur-Rahman the. Phir zubani kaha ki Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Ibrahim ko ummat farmaya hai toh aap (R.A) ne farmaya: Jante bhi ho ummat ke kya maana? Aur qanit ke kya maana? Ummat kehte hain use jo logon ko bhalai sikhaye aur qanit kehte hain use jo Allah aur uske Rasul ki ita'at mein laga rahe. Beshak Hazrat Mu'adh aise hi the. 

Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain woh tanha ummat the aur tabe-farman the. Woh apne zamane mein tanha muwahid-o-momin the. Baqi tamam log us waqt kafir the. Qatadah farmate hain woh hidayat ke imam the aur Allah ke ghulam the. Phir zubani kaha ki Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Ibrahim ko ummat farmaya hai toh aap ne farmaya: Jante bhi ho

Baqi tamam log us waqt kafir thay. Qatadah farmate hain woh hidayat ke imam thay aur Allah ke ghulam thay. Allah ki naimaton ke qadardan aur shukr guzar thay aur Rabb ke tamam ahkaam ke amil thay jaise khud Allah ne farmaya: Wa Ibrahimal-lazi wafa – woh Ibrahim jis ne poora kiya yaani Allah ke tamam ahkaam ko tasleem kiya aur un par amal baja laya. Us اسے Allah ne mukhtar aur Mustafa bana liya. Jaise farman hai: Wa laqad ataina Ibrahima rushdahu - hum ne pehle hi se Ibrahim ko rushd-o-hidayat de rakhi thi aur hum use khoob jaante thay. Usay hum ne rah-e-mustaqim ki rahbar ki thi, sirf aik Allah wahdahu la sharika lahu ki woh ibadat-o-itaat karte thay aur Allah ki pasandida shariat par qaim thay. Hum ne unhein deen-o-duniya ki khair ka jami banaya tha, apni pakeeza zindagi ke tamam zaroori ausaf-e-hameeda un mein thay. Saath hi akhirat mein bhi nekoon ke sathi aur salahiyat wale thay. Un ka pak zikar duniya mein bhi baqi raha aur akhirat mein bare azeemush-shaan darje milay.
