Jumma ka din har ummat ke liye hafte mein ek din Allah Ta'ala ne aisa muqarrar kiya hai jis mein woh jama ho kar Allah ki ibadat ki khushi manaein. Is ummat ke liye woh din Jumma ka din hai, is liye ke woh chhatta din hai jis mein Allah Ta'ala ne apni makhlooq ka kamal kiya. Aur sari makhlooq paida ho chuki aur apne bandon ko un ki zaroorat ki apni poori na'mat ata farma di. Marwi hai ki Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ki zubani yehi din Bani Israel ke liye muqarrar farmaya gaya tha lekin woh is se hat kar hafte ke din ko le baithe, yeh samjhe ki Jumma ko makhlooq poori ho gayi, hafte ke din Allah ne koi cheez paida nahi ki. Pas Taurat jab utri un par wohi hafte ka din muqarrar huwa aur unhein hukm mila ki ise mazbooti se thame rahein, haan yeh zaroor farma diya gaya tha ki An-Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ) jab bhi aayein toh woh sab ke sab ko chhor kar sirf aap hi ki ittiba karein. Is baat par un se wada bhi le liya tha. Pas hafte ka din unhon ne khud hi apne liye chhanta tha. Aur aap hi Jumma ko chhoda tha. Hazrat Isa bin Maryam (Alaihis Salam) ke zamane tak yeh isi par rahe. Kaha jata hai ki phir aap ne unhein itwar ke din ki taraf dawat di. Ek qaul hai ki aap ne Taurat ki shariat chhodi na thi siwaye ba'z mansookh ahkaam ke aur hafte ke din ki muhafizat aap ne bhi barabar jari rakhi. Jab aap aasman par chadha liye gaye toh aap ke baad Qustunteen badshah ke zamane mein sirf Yahoodiyon ki zid mein aa kar Sakhra se mashriq janib ko apna qibla unhon ne muqarrar kar liya aur hafte ki bajaye itwar ka din muqarrar kar liya. Bukhari o Muslim ki hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain hum sab se aakhir wale hain aur Qiyamat ke din sab se aage wale hain. Haan unhein Kitabullah hum se pehle di gayi. Yeh din bhi Allah ne un par farz kiya lekin un ke ikhtilaf ne unhein kho diya aur Allah Rabbul Izzat ne hamein is ki hidayat di pas yeh sab log hamare peeche peeche hain. Yahood ek din peeche Nasara do din. Aap farmate hain hum se pehle ki ummaton ko Allah ne is din se mehroom kar diya Yahood ne hafte ka din rakha Nasara ne itwar ka aur Jumma hamara huwa. Pas jis tarah dinon ke is aitbaar se woh hamare peeche hain. Isi tarah Qiyamat ke din bhi hamare peeche hi rahenge. Hum duniya ke aitbaar se pichhle hain aur Qiyamat ke aitbaar se pehle hain yani tamam makhlooq mein sab se pehle faisle hamare honge. (Muslim)

Hikmat se murad Kitabullah aur Hadis-e-Rasul (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hai. Allah Ta'ala Rabbul Alamin apne Rasul Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukum farmata hai ke aap Allah ki makhlooq ko is ki taraf bulayein. Hikmat se murad ba-qawl Imam Ibn Jarir (ؒ / Rahimahullah) Kalamullah aur Hadis-e-Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hai. Aur achhe wa'z se murad jis mein dar aur dhamki bhi ho ke log is se nasehat hasil karein aur Allah ke azabon se bachao talab karein. Haan yeh bhi khayal rahe ke agar kisi se munazare ki zaroorat par jaye toh woh narmi aur khush lafzi se ho. Jaise farman hai ayat: (Wala tujadilu ahlal-kitabi illa billati hiya ahsanu illal-lazina zalamu minhum wa qulu amanna billazi unzila ilayna wa unzila ilaykum wa ilahun wa ilahukum wahidun wa nahnu lahu muslimun [29:46]) Ahl-e-Kitab se munazare mujadale ka behtareen tareeqa hi barte karo al-kh. Isi tarah Hazrat Musa (ؑ / Alaihis Salam) ko bhi narmi ka hukum hua tha. Dono bhaiyon ko yeh keh kar Firaun ki taraf bheja gaya tha ke use naram baat kehna taake ibrat hasil kare aur hoshyar ho jaye. Gumrah aur hidayat-yaab sab Allah ke ilm mein hain. Shaqi o Saeed sab is par wazih hain. Wahan likhe ja chuke hain aur tamam kamon ke anjam se faraghat ho chuki hai. Aap toh Allah ki rah ki dawat dete rahein lekin na manne walon ke piche apni jaan halakat mein na daliye. Aap hidayat ke zimmedar nahi hain, aap sirf aagah karne wale hain, aap par paigham ka pohancha dena farz hai. Hisab hum aap lenge. Hidayat aap ke bas ki cheez nahi ke jise mahboob samjhein, hidayat ata kar dein. Logon ke hidayat ke zimmedar aap nahi, yeh Allah ke qabze aur us ke haath ki cheez hai.

Qisas aur husool-e-qisas, qisas mein aur haq ke hasil karne mein barabari aur insaf ka hukm ho raha hai. Imam Ibn Sirin ؒ waghera farmate hain agar koi tum se koi cheez le le toh tum bhi us se usi jaisi le lo. Ibn Zaid ؒ farmate hain ki pehle toh mushrikeen se darguzar karne ka hukm tha. Jab zara haisiyat daar log musalman hue toh unhon ne kaha ki agar Allah ki taraf se badle ki rukhsat hojaye toh hum bhi in kutton se nibad liya karenge is par yeh ayat utri aakhir yeh bhi jihad se mansookh hogayi. Hazrat Ata bin Yasar ؒ farmate hain Surah Nahl poori Makkah Sharif mein utri hai magar is ki teen aakhri aayatein Madina Sharif mein utri hain. Jab ke Jang-e-Uhud mein Hazrat Hamza ؓ shaheed kar diye gaye aur aap ke aza-e-jism bhi shahadat ke baad kaat liye gaye jis par Rasulullah ﷺ ki zaban se besaakhta nikal gaya ki ab jab mujhe Allah Ta'ala in mushrikeen par ghalba de toh main in mein se tees shakhson ke haath pao'n usi tarah kaato'n ga. Musalmanon ke kaan mein jab apne mohtaram Nabi ﷺ ke yeh alfaaz pade toh un ke josh bahut badh gaye aur kehne lage ki Wallah hum in par ghalib aa kar in ki lashon ke woh tukde tukde karenge ki arabon ne kabhi aisa dekha hi na hoga is par yeh aayatein utrin (Seerat Ibn Ishaq). Lekin yeh riwayat mursal hai aur is mein ek rawi aisa bhi hai jin ka naam hi nahi liya gaya, mubham chhodha gaya. Haan doosri sanad se yeh mutassil bhi marwi hai. Bazzar mein hai ki jab Hazrat Hamza bin Abdul Muttalib ؒ shaheed kar diye gaye. Aap paas khade ho kar dekhne lage aah! Is se zyada dil dukhane wala manzar aur kya hoga ki mohtaram chacha ki lash ke tukde aankhon ke samne bikhre pade hain. Aap ki zaban-e-mubarak se nikla ki aap par Allah ki rahmat ho, jahan tak mera ilm hai, main janta hoon ki aap rishte naate ke jodne wale nekiyon ko lapak kar karne wale the. Wallah doosre logon ke dard-o-gham ka khayal na hota toh main toh aap ke is jism ko yunhi chhod deta yahan tak ki aap ko Allah Ta'ala darindon ke peton mein se nikalta ya aur koi aisa hi kalma farmaya jab in mushrikeen ne yeh harkat ki hai toh Wallah main bhi in mein ke sattar shakhson ki yehi buri halat banao'n ga. Isi waqt Hazrat Jibril ؑ wahi lekar aaye aur yeh aayatein utrin toh aap apne qasam ke poora karne se ruk gaye aur qasam ka kaffara ada kar diya. Lekin sanad is ki bhi kamzor hai. Is ke rawi Salih Basheer Marri hain jo aimmah-e-ahl-e-hadith ke nazdeek zaeef hain balki Imam Bukhari ؒ toh unhein Munkar-ul-Hadith kehte hain. Sha'bi aur Ibn Juraij kehte hain ki musalmanon ki zaban se nikla tha ki in logon ne jo hamare shaheedon ke behurmati ki hai aur un ke aza-e-badan kaat diye hain Wallah hum bhi un se is ka badla lekar hi chhodhenge. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne un ke bare mein yeh aayatein utarin. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ki Jang-e-Uhud mein saathe Ansari shaheed hue aur chhah Muhajir ؓ ajmaeen toh Ashab-e-Rasul ﷺ ki zaban se nikal gaya ki jab hum in mushrikeen par ghalba payein toh hum bhi un ke tukde kiye baghair na rahenge.

Chanacha Fath-e-Makkah walay din aik shakhs ne kaha ke aaj ke din ke baad Quresh pehchane bhi na jayenge. Isi waqt nida hui Allah ke Rasool ﷺ tamam logon ko panah detay hain siwaye falan falan ke (jin ke naam liye gaye hain) is par Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ne yeh aayatein nazil farmayein. Nabi ﷺ ne isi waqt farmaya ke hum sabr karte hain aur badla nahi letay. Is ayat-e-karima ki misalein Quran-e-Kareem mein aur bhi bohat si hain. Is mein adl ki mashrooyat bayan hui hai aur afzal tareeqay ki taraf ishara kiya gaya hai. Jaisay ayat (Jazaa'u sayyi'atin bimithliha wa tarhaquhum zillatun ma lahum minal-lahi min 'asim 27) (10. Yunus: 27) mein ke burai ka badla lenay ki rukhsat ata farma kar phir farmaya hai ke jo darkuzar kar lay aur islah kar lay is ka ajr Allah Ta'ala par hai isi tarah ayat (Wal-juruha qisas) mein bhi zakhmon ka badla lenay ki ijazat day kar farmaya hai ke jo ba-taur sadqa maaf kar day yeh maafi is ke gunahon ka kaffara ho jayegi. Isi tarah is ayat mein bhi barabar badla lenay ke jawaz ka zikr farma kar phir irshad huwa hai ke agar sabr kar lo toh yeh bohat hi behtar hai. Phir sabr ki mazeed تاکید ki aur irshad farmaya ke yeh har aik ke bas ka kaam nahi yeh un hi se ho sakta hai jin ki madad par Allah ho aur jinhen is ki janib se taufiq naseeb hui ho. Phir irshad hota hai ke apnay mukhalifin ka gham na kha, un ki qismat mein hi mukhalifat likh di gayi hai na un ke fann-e-fareeb se azurda khatir ho. Allah tujhe kafi hai, wahi tera madadgar hai, wahi tujhe in sab par ghalib karnay wala hai aur un ki makariyon aur chalakiyon se bachanay wala hai. Un ki adaawat aur un ke buray iradetyra kuch nahi bigaad saktay. Malaika aur mujahideen Allah Ta'ala ki madad aur is ki ta'eed hidayat aur is ki taufiq un ke sath hai, jin ke dil Allah ke dar se aur jin ke aamal ehsaan ke jauhar se maal-maal hon. Chanacha jihad ke moqay par Allah Ta'ala ne farishton ki taraf wahi utari thi ke ayat (Anni ma'akum fathabbitu alladhina amanu sa-ulqi fi qulubi alladhina kafaru al-ru'ba fadbribu fauqa al-a'naqi wa adbribu minhum kulla banan 12) (8. Al-Anfal: 12) mein tumharay sath hun pas tum imandaron ko sabit qadam rakho, isi tarah Hazrat Musa ؑ aur Hazrat Harun (Alaihimas Salam) se farmaya tha ayat (Qala la takhafa innani ma'akuma asma'u wa ara 46) (20. Taha: 46) tum khauf na khao main tumharay sath hun, dekhta sunta hun. Ghar mein Rasool-e-Kareem ﷺ ne Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddique ؓ se farmaya tha ayat (Idh yaqulu li-sahibihi la tahzan inna Allaha ma'ana 40) (9. At-Tawbah: 40) gham na karo Allah Ta'ala hamaray sath hai. Pas yeh sath toh khas tha. Aur murad is se ta'eed o nusrat-e-ilahi ka sath hona hai.

Aur aam saath ka bayaan ayat (Wa huwa ma'akum ainama kuntum wallahu bima ta'maloona baseer) aur ayat (Yakoonu min najwa thalathatin illa huwa rabi'uhum wa la khamsatin illa huwa sadisuhum wa la adna min thalika wa la aksara illa huwa ma'ahum aina ma kanoo) [58. Al-Mujadilah: 7] aur ayat (Wa ma yakoonu fi sha'nin) al-kh mein hai ya'ni Allah Ta'ala tumhare saath hai, jahan bhi tum ho aur woh tumhare amaal dekhne wala hai aur jo teen shakhsh koi sargoshi karne lagen un mein chautha Allah Ta'ala hota hai aur paanch mein chhatta woh hota hai aur is se kam-o-besh mein bhi jahan woh hon, Allah un ke saath hota hai aur tum kisi haal mein ho ya tilawat-e-Quran mein ho ya tum aur koi kaam mein lage hue ho hum tum par shahid hote hain pas in ayaton mein saath se murad sunne dekhne ka saath hai. 

Taqwa ke maane hain haram kaamo aur gunah ke kaamo ko Allah ke farmaan par tark kar dene ke. Aur ihsan ke maane hain Parvardigar ki ita'at-o-ibadat ko baja lana. Jin logon mein yeh dono sifatain hon woh Allah Ta'ala ki hifz-o-amaan mein rehte hain, Janab-e-Bari un ki ta'ayeed aur madad farmata rehta hai. Un ke mukhalifein aur dushman un ka kuch nahi bigaad sakte balki Allah Ta'ala unhein un sab par kamyabi ata farmata hai. 

Ibn Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Muhammad bin Hatib (Rahimahullah) se marwi hai Hazrat Usman (R.A) un logon mein se the jo ba-iyman parhezgar aur naik kar hain.

Chanacha Fath-e-Makkah walay din aik shakhs ne kaha ke aaj ke din ke baad Quresh pehchane bhi na jayenge. Isi waqt nida hui Allah ke Rasool ﷺ tamam logon ko panah detay hain siwaye falan falan ke (jin ke naam liye gaye hain) is par Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ne yeh aayatein nazil farmayein. Nabi ﷺ ne isi waqt farmaya ke hum sabr karte hain aur badla nahi letay. Is ayat-e-karima ki misalein Quran-e-Kareem mein aur bhi bohat si hain. Is mein adl ki mashrooyat bayan hui hai aur afzal tareeqay ki taraf ishara kiya gaya hai. Jaisay ayat (Jazaa'u sayyi'atin bimithliha wa tarhaquhum zillatun ma lahum minal-lahi min 'asim 27) (10. Yunus: 27) mein ke burai ka badla lenay ki rukhsat ata farma kar phir farmaya hai ke jo darkuzar kar lay aur islah kar lay is ka ajr Allah Ta'ala par hai isi tarah ayat (Wal-juruha qisas) mein bhi zakhmon ka badla lenay ki ijazat day kar farmaya hai ke jo ba-taur sadqa maaf kar day yeh maafi is ke gunahon ka kaffara ho jayegi. Isi tarah is ayat mein bhi barabar badla lenay ke jawaz ka zikr farma kar phir irshad huwa hai ke agar sabr kar lo toh yeh bohat hi behtar hai. Phir sabr ki mazeed تاکید ki aur irshad farmaya ke yeh har aik ke bas ka kaam nahi yeh un hi se ho sakta hai jin ki madad par Allah ho aur jinhen is ki janib se taufiq naseeb hui ho. Phir irshad hota hai ke apnay mukhalifin ka gham na kha, un ki qismat mein hi mukhalifat likh di gayi hai na un ke fann-e-fareeb se azurda khatir ho. Allah tujhe kafi hai, wahi tera madadgar hai, wahi tujhe in sab par ghalib karnay wala hai aur un ki makariyon aur chalakiyon se bachanay wala hai. Un ki adaawat aur un ke buray iradetyra kuch nahi bigaad saktay. Malaika aur mujahideen Allah Ta'ala ki madad aur is ki ta'eed hidayat aur is ki taufiq un ke sath hai, jin ke dil Allah ke dar se aur jin ke aamal ehsaan ke jauhar se maal-maal hon. Chanacha jihad ke moqay par Allah Ta'ala ne farishton ki taraf wahi utari thi ke ayat (Anni ma'akum fathabbitu alladhina amanu sa-ulqi fi qulubi alladhina kafaru al-ru'ba fadbribu fauqa al-a'naqi wa adbribu minhum kulla banan 12) (8. Al-Anfal: 12) mein tumharay sath hun pas tum imandaron ko sabit qadam rakho, isi tarah Hazrat Musa ؑ aur Hazrat Harun (Alaihimas Salam) se farmaya tha ayat (Qala la takhafa innani ma'akuma asma'u wa ara 46) (20. Taha: 46) tum khauf na khao main tumharay sath hun, dekhta sunta hun. Ghar mein Rasool-e-Kareem ﷺ ne Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddique ؓ se farmaya tha ayat (Idh yaqulu li-sahibihi la tahzan inna Allaha ma'ana 40) (9. At-Tawbah: 40) gham na karo Allah Ta'ala hamaray sath hai. Pas yeh sath toh khas tha. Aur murad is se ta'eed o nusrat-e-ilahi ka sath hona hai.

Aur aam saath ka bayaan ayat (Wa huwa ma'akum ainama kuntum wallahu bima ta'maloona baseer) aur ayat (Yakoonu min najwa thalathatin illa huwa rabi'uhum wa la khamsatin illa huwa sadisuhum wa la adna min thalika wa la aksara illa huwa ma'ahum aina ma kanoo) [58. Al-Mujadilah: 7] aur ayat (Wa ma yakoonu fi sha'nin) al-kh mein hai ya'ni Allah Ta'ala tumhare saath hai, jahan bhi tum ho aur woh tumhare amaal dekhne wala hai aur jo teen shakhsh koi sargoshi karne lagen un mein chautha Allah Ta'ala hota hai aur paanch mein chhatta woh hota hai aur is se kam-o-besh mein bhi jahan woh hon, Allah un ke saath hota hai aur tum kisi haal mein ho ya tilawat-e-Quran mein ho ya tum aur koi kaam mein lage hue ho hum tum par shahid hote hain pas in ayaton mein saath se murad sunne dekhne ka saath hai. 

Taqwa ke maane hain haram kaamo aur gunah ke kaamo ko Allah ke farmaan par tark kar dene ke. Aur ihsan ke maane hain Parvardigar ki ita'at-o-ibadat ko baja lana. Jin logon mein yeh dono sifatain hon woh Allah Ta'ala ki hifz-o-amaan mein rehte hain, Janab-e-Bari un ki ta'ayeed aur madad farmata rehta hai. Un ke mukhalifein aur dushman un ka kuch nahi bigaad sakte balki Allah Ta'ala unhein un sab par kamyabi ata farmata hai. 

Ibn Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Muhammad bin Hatib (Rahimahullah) se marwi hai Hazrat Usman (R.A) un logon mein se the jo ba-iyman parhezgar aur naik kar hain.
